jobs.title: Director, Engineering, Technical Expert Sterile Fill
jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryThe Director Engineering Technical Expert Sterile Fill provides enterprise-level technical leadership for sterile fill engineering across AbbVie’s strategic investment portfolio, with accountability for biologics sterile filling, Annex 1-aligned contamination control, aseptic processing design, barrier technology strategy, equipment / facility interfaces, GMP readiness, validation / CQV integration and technical assurance within Strategic Investments - Engineering.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Director Engineering Technical Expert Sterile Fill provides enterprise-level technical leadership for sterile fill engineering across AbbVie’s strategic investment portfolio, with accountability for biologics sterile filling, Annex 1-aligned contamination control, aseptic processing design, barrier technology strategy, equipment / facility interfaces, GMP readiness, validation / CQV integration and technical assurance within Strategic Investments - Engineering.

The role shapes and governs engineering strategies for strategic investments by setting technical direction, aligning standards and assuring robust execution across priority capital programs, technology platforms and future manufacturing capabilities.

The role leads engineering activities associated with strategic investment programs, including new facility investments, technology platform deployments, capacity expansion, infrastructure enablement, lifecycle asset renewal and capability-building initiatives that materially impact long-term business performance.

The role partners with Strategic Investments leadership, operating sites, quality, EHS, validation / CQV and external engineering partners to make high-quality technical decisions, resolve complex risks and deliver business-aligned engineering outcomes.

Strategic Investments - Engineering Context

Strategic Investments - Engineering provides senior technical leadership, engineering governance, standards ownership and execution assurance across AbbVie’s strategic investment portfolio.

The organization supports strategic capital programs including new manufacturing facilities, technology platform deployments, capacity expansion, infrastructure enablement, lifecycle asset renewal and future capability investments.

Strategic Investments - Engineering roles are expected to establish clear technical direction, drive enterprise alignment, transfer lessons learned and enable consistent, high-quality engineering delivery across the strategic investment portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Investments - Engineering Governance and Standards

  • Establish, maintain and deploy global engineering standards, technical practices and governance expectations for biologics sterile fill engineering, Annex 1-aligned contamination control strategy, aseptic processing, barrier technologies, equipment / facility interfaces, GMP readiness, validation / CQV integration and technical assurance.
  • Drive consistent application of technical standards, design principles, lessons learned and engineering playbooks across regions, sites and capital projects.
  • Ensure discipline strategies directly support AbbVie’s strategic investment priorities, future manufacturing capability requirements and major capital program objectives.
  • Provide governance and escalation for technical decisions with material safety, quality, compliance, cost, schedule, operability or lifecycle impact.

Strategic Investment Leadership and Execution Support

  • Provide senior engineering leadership for strategic capital investments, including new facility builds, technology platform deployments, capacity projects, infrastructure enablement, lifecycle asset renewal and future capability investments.
  • Support front-end engineering, facility concept development, investment option evaluation, manufacturing capability assessments and site / platform planning activities.
  • Partner with Strategic Investments and project leadership to ensure technical assumptions, deliverables, risks and resource needs are integrated into capital program plans.
  • Apply enterprise lessons learned and strategic investment standards to improve project quality, decision speed, reliability and readiness across the portfolio.

Sterile Filling, Biologics Manufacturing and Annex 1 Compliance

  • Provide senior technical leadership for sterile filling of biologics and parenteral products, including vial, syringe, cartridge and bulk sterile transfer interfaces where relevant to strategic investment scope.
  • Ensure facility, equipment and process design decisions are aligned with EU GMP Annex 1 expectations for sterile medicinal products, including contamination control strategy, quality risk management, cleanroom classification, barrier technology and aseptic process control.
  • Govern technical strategy for isolators, restricted access barrier systems, Grade A critical zones, Grade B / C / D background environments, unidirectional airflow, first-air protection, glove systems, transfer systems and aseptic interventions.
  • Lead engineering input to contamination control strategy development, ensuring critical control points are embedded across facility design, equipment, utilities, personnel flows, material flows, cleaning, disinfection, environmental monitoring and maintenance access.
  • Partner with Quality, MS&T, Validation / CQV and Operations to ensure aseptic process simulations, media fill strategy, filter integrity testing, sterile filtration, container closure integrity, environmental monitoring and viable / non-viable particle control are considered in design and readiness decisions.
  • Provide technical challenge and risk-based decision support for interventions, line set-up, lyophilization interfaces, stopper / component handling, depyrogenation, sterilization, single-use systems, CIP / SIP interfaces and biologics product protection requirements.
  • Ensure sterile fill investment programs are designed for inspection readiness, robust contamination prevention, operational maintainability, product sterility assurance and reliable long-term biologics manufacturing performance.

Technical Leadership and Delivery

  • Lead technical decision-making for biologics sterile fill engineering, aseptic processing design, Annex 1 compliance expectations, contamination control strategy, barrier technology selection, equipment / facility interfaces, GMP readiness, validation / CQV integration and technical assurance across strategic investment programs and technology platforms.
  • Ensure engineering deliverables support safety, quality, compliance, operability, maintainability, reliability, sustainability and operational readiness.
  • Coordinate technical input from project teams, site SMEs, external engineering partners, vendors and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Drive timely resolution of technical issues and ensure disciplined escalation when decisions have material project, portfolio, enterprise or business impact.

Cross-Functional Integration

  • Partner with Strategic Investments, manufacturing operations, quality, validation / CQV, EHS, site engineering, MS&T, supply chain, finance and related engineering disciplines.
  • Ensure discipline decisions are integrated with strategic investment objectives, manufacturing strategy, capacity planning, technology platform deployment, regulatory expectations and site handover needs.
  • Facilitate collaboration across regions, sites and project teams to avoid fragmented solutions and drive consistency across strategic investments.
  • Represent Strategic Investments - Engineering in technical reviews, project forums and risk discussions relevant to assigned scope.

Capability Building and Continuous Improvement

  • Share engineering best practices, lessons learned and technical knowledge across sites, regions and projects.
  • Build capability through coaching, mentoring, technical review discipline and development of reusable engineering practices.
  • Promote a culture of engineering excellence, safety, quality, reliability, collaboration, accountability and proactive risk management.
  • Support continuous improvement of Strategic Investments - Engineering standards, templates, knowledge management and project delivery approaches.

Strategic Investments - Engineering Leadership Expectations

  • Collaborate across the enterprise engineering community to identify, develop and deploy best practices, technical standards, lessons learned and capability-building initiatives.
  • Promote consistency, quality, reliability, sustainability and project delivery performance across the strategic investment portfolio.
  • Support long-range strategic investment planning, manufacturing strategy and future capability development.
  • Build technical capability through coaching, mentoring, standards governance, knowledge management and cross-functional collaboration.

Stakeholder Interfaces

Strategic Investments: Investment planning, portfolio alignment, technical assumptions, front-end engineering, strategic capital program support and executive decision enablement.

Manufacturing Sites and Operations: Network needs, site readiness, operability, maintainability, startup, handover and operational performance support.

Quality, Validation / CQV and EHS: Compliance expectations, validation strategy, qualification readiness, safety, risk review and inspection readiness interfaces.

Strategic Investments - Engineering Disciplines: Cross-discipline technical integration, standards, design reviews, technical issue resolution and strategic investment lessons learned.

External Engineering Partners, EPCM Firms, Vendors and OEMs: Technical oversight, deliverable review, issue escalation, supplier alignment and execution quality.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science or a relevant technical discipline required; advanced degree preferred where relevant.
  • Typically 12+ to 15+ years of relevant engineering, manufacturing, capital project, technical operations or regulated manufacturing experience.
  • Demonstrated technical capability in biologics sterile filling, aseptic processing, Annex 1 contamination control expectations, isolators / RABS, cleanroom interfaces, sterile filtration, environmental monitoring, GMP readiness, validation / CQV integration and technical assurance.
  • Experience supporting pharmaceutical, biopharmaceutical, medical device, API, peptides, biologics, sterile or similarly regulated manufacturing environments preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate across global functions, strategic investment teams, manufacturing sites, project teams, suppliers, vendors and external engineering partners.
  • Strong communication, risk management, technical judgment, stakeholder engagement and structured problem-solving skills.

Technical Competencies

  • Biologics sterile fill-finish systems
  • EU GMP Annex 1 contamination control strategy, aseptic processing and sterility assurance
  • Equipment / facility interfaces
  • Strategic investment portfolio support
  • Strategic investment manufacturing readiness and sterile operations support
  • Strategic capital investment leadership
  • Engineering governance and standards
  • Technical risk management
  • Project execution support
  • Stakeholder management
  • Vendor / partner technical coordination
  • GMP and regulated manufacturing awareness
  • Isolator / RABS design, Grade A critical zones, background classification and aseptic intervention strategy
  • Operational readiness and handover support

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic thinking and enterprise mindset
  • Matrix leadership and influence without direct authority
  • Clear technical communication and executive-ready recommendations
  • Risk-based decision making and issue escalation
  • Collaboration across functions, sites, regions and external partners
  • Capability building, mentoring and knowledge sharing
  • Continuous improvement and commitment to safety, quality and compliance

Working Relationships

This role works globally with Strategic Investments, Strategic Investments - Engineering disciplines, manufacturing sites, quality, validation / CQV, EHS, operations, MS&T, supply chain, finance, external engineering firms, technology vendors and equipment suppliers. The role is expected to operate as a senior technical leader across multiple strategic investment programs and technology platforms, setting direction, strengthening technical governance and enabling high-quality capital delivery.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. Senior Software Engineer, Tax Engineering

Tax Engineering sits at the intersection of every trade, every payment, and every product Coinbase ships. When a user buys Bitcoin, sells an equity, earns staking rewards, or redeems an Advisor-managed strategy, Tax Engineering is in the critical path, calculating cost basis, tracking gain/loss, determining withholding obligations, and producing compliance reporting across every product line and legal entity globally. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Tax team within the Consumer & Business group, you'll build the extensible primitives that make each new Coinbase launch possible, where scale and accuracy are both non-negotiable.

  • Own the design and delivery of backend systems for cost basis tracking, gain/loss calculation, withholding automation, and tax reporting infrastructure
  • Build new pipelines for broker reporting, automated withholding, and clearing integrations with partners as Coinbase expands into equities, margin, and options
  • Partner with Product, Design, Tax, Trading, and Positions teams to take ambiguous problems from scoping through production rollout
  • Drive an extensible tax architecture so every new product launch can plug into shared primitives without bespoke rework
  • Strengthen engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, and technical mentorship across the team

  • 6+ years of backend software engineering experience building and operating production systems with high-quality, well-tested code
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals, with experience designing high-throughput services and data pipelines where correctness is critical

jobs.description:
Overview

Groups is a leading outpatient provider specializing in substance use disorder (SUD) treatment. We are committed to supporting underserved communities hit hardest by the opioid crisis. Since 2014, our local care teams have guided hundreds of thousands of individuals on their path to recovery, helping them reclaim their purpose and dignity through compassionate, collaborative care.

Our evidence-based approach combines medication, group therapy, and personalized support, delivered online and in person by local providers. Founded on the belief that recovery extends beyond the traditional office visit, Groups helps members build a foundation for long-term recovery and the fulfilling lives they want and deserve.

Together with our community partners, public agencies, and health plans, we are raising the bar in addiction health care—and we’re just getting started.

Groups is changing lives. Join us.

At Groups, the Recovery Access Specialist has a critical role within the Groups’ organization - serving as the first touchpoint with all our members in the member intake process and acting as a member liaison for all prospective member and current member calls.

Schedule: Monday - Friday 3p-11p EST

Pay: $19.00 - $21.00/hr

Responsibilities

Essential Functions:

  • Answering all calls within established guidelines in a welcoming, energetic manner.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of organizational structure and criteria to prospective and current members.
  • Provide educated answers to clinical questions, identify/assist caller needs, ensure all requests are followed through and completed.
  • Initiate client Biopsychosocial Assessment by utilizing motivational interviewing techniques to determine each caller's eligibility for Groups’ program.
  • Schedule initial intake appointment utilizing EMR.
  • Facilitate seamless client intake; coordinate client no-shows with clinic coordinators.
  • Provide a positive experience that demonstrates our unique culture and values to develop a therapeutic rapport with clients.

Other Duties and Responsibilities:

  • You will be required to work a minimum of 3 company holidays per year which you will be paid time and a half.
  • You will be required to work a minimum of 2 company mental health days per year
  • Other duties as assigned based on the business needs.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • A friendly but clear phone communication style.
  • A strong communicator: you possess the ability to communicate effectively on the phone with clarity and warmth
  • Critical thinking and judgment skills - you can read between the lines to determine if an issue requires special or urgent attention.
  • Enthusiasm to learn the best practices to treat opioid dependency.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong telecommunication skills and comfort while working in multiple IT systems, applications and tools.
  • Strong customer service orientation required.
  • A people person: You enjoy connecting with people from diverse backgrounds and help people feel at ease
  • Compassionate: you have empathy for those trying to navigate a difficult health situation and are dedicated to helping improve their experience through your stewardship
  • Organized: you feel confident handling a high volume of incoming calls efficiently but thoroughly address each one as if it were the most important caller of the day
  • Exceptionally positive: you believe that practicing patience and employing a positive attitude will help improve any situation
  • Passionate about our mission: you are looking to join a mission-driven team and culture, and are willing to go above and beyond to get the job done.
  • Ability to work independently under general supervision.
  • Ability to understand and adhere to the Code of Conduct.

Qualifications

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's degree preferred
  • Minimum 1-year experience in human services/healthcare or customer service professional role; retail, medical, or hospitality experience preferred.
  • Access to reliable internet and telephone services, specifically a 10M download and 5M upload package or highe,r as well as a strong WiFi signal from your remote work location.
  • Must meet pre-employment requirements and maintain all applicable state and job-related guidelines for background screening. Depending on state-specific requirements, this may include fingerprinting, drug testing, health screening, CPR/Basic First Aid, and license/credential verifications.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for actively practicing, US-licensed physicians (MD/DO) living outside the US, with an active, unrestricted US medical license, to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. On this project, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, apply to take part!

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for US-licensed physicians living outside the US who are looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around clinical practice. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This opportunity is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid ​

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

You decide when and how much to contribute. For this project, tasks are estimated at around 10–20 hours per week during active phases. Tasks are submitted within the project timeline and need to meet the listed acceptance criteria to be approved.

Earnings are per approved task, at a flat rate set to about $35/hr equivalent based on estimated task time. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the base rate. QA and adjudication tasks are paid at a higher rate.

About Us:

Kooth is a fast-growing, mission-driven organisation transforming access to digital mental health support across the UK and US. Listed on the London Stock Exchange (AIM: KOO), our mission is to create welcoming, accessible spaces for personalised mental health care that helps young people thrive.

With 25 years of experience, Kooth has become a trusted leader in digital mental health, working alongside the NHS, government partners, and local communities to make high-quality support more accessible to young people.

Building on this foundation, we've expanded Soluna, our innovative digital mental health platform, across both the US and UK. First launched in California in 2024, Soluna has since expanded into New Jersey and Michigan. In September 2026, we reached another exciting milestone with the launch of Soluna by Kooth in the UK, bringing together our experience and innovation across both markets. Through professional mental health support, moderated peer communities, and self-guided tools, we're helping young people access the support they need, when they need it.

At Kooth, we're more than a digital mental health platform. We're purpose-driven, people-centred, and grounded in our values: Alongside You, Flexible, Compassionate, Committed, and Safe. If you're looking for meaningful work with measurable impact, you'll find it here.

Learn more at Kooth and Soluna.

What We’re Looking For:

The Kooth Engagement Lead is responsible for driving awareness, uptake, and sustained usage of Soluna by Kooth (for children and young people) and Qwell (for adults, where applicable).

Operating primarily through a digital and virtual-first community engagement strategy, this role acts as the dedicated Engagement Lead for specific contracted areas, while also collaborating flexibly across local, regional, and national levels. You will build repeatable, scalable engagement pathways through live virtual sessions, webinars, asynchronous resources, pre-recorded content, and self-serve toolkits across both youth and professional/referrer audiences.

Beyond direct engagement delivery, you will play an active role in elevating outreach approach, quality and team best practice.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

Virtual Engagement & Outreach (CYP & Education)

  • Digital Assembly & Session Delivery: Plan and deliver engaging, high-impact virtual assemblies and presentations directly to children and young people (CYP) in secondary schools, colleges, and higher education settings.
  • Selective In-Person Outreach: Deliver high-value in-person engagement (such as major community events or Freshers' Fairs) on an occasional, strategic basis where maximum impact is guaranteed.

Professional, Referrer & Community System Integration

  • Flexible Delivery Models for Professionals: Promote Soluna and Qwell through adaptive formats including live virtual delivery, pre-recorded material , and self-serve partner toolkits to fit around the scheduling demands of educators, healthcare staff, and community leaders.
  • Educator & Staff Upskilling: Deliver concise virtual awareness sessions and asynchronous resources to teaching staff, school leaders, and pastoral teams to encourage signposting and service uptake.
  • Healthcare & Community Referral Pathways: Drive service uptake and signposting for Soluna and Qwell by partnering with key healthcare and community referrers including GP surgeries, CAMHS, A&E, Family Hubs, and local leaders to embed both platforms into local care pathways.
  • Parent & Carer/ Trusted Adult Awareness: Deliver virtual information sessions and distribute digital communications to build trust and awareness among parents and carers. Ensure that parents and carers/ trusted adult resources are embedded within referrer
  • Regional Network & Stakeholder Representation: Represent the organisation at critical regional network meetings to present Soluna and Qwell, liaising with Line Managers and Relationship Managers to ensure appropriate service representation.

Webinar Strategy & Delivery

  • National & Regional Webinar Hosting: Co-host and deliver national and regional webinars targeting young people, parents/carers, educators, and healthcare professionals as a core channel of virtual strategy delivery.
  • Webinar Content Adaptation: Tailor webinar content and interactive features to suit specific audience needs, commissioner priorities, and contract campaign themes.

Strategic Alignment, Cross-Regional Support & Commissioner Collaboration

  • Dedicated Contract Lead & Cross-Regional Delivery: Serve as the main engagement contact for dedicated contract areas while working flexibly across regions and nationally to share best practice, support peer contracts, and deliver multi-region initiatives.
  • Commercial & System Alignment: Collaborate closely with internal teams, particularly the Commercial team, to ensure local engagement plans align with commissioner KPIs, priorities, and regional population goals.
  • Reporting & Reviews: Prepare clear, data-led engagement summaries and reports; present findings directly during quarterly commissioner review meetings.
  • Target & Contact Sourcing: Proactively source and verify new contacts across healthcare, education, and third-sector organisations, ensuring key stakeholders are captured directly within company systems.

Practice Development & Team Collaboration

  • Active Practice Development: Actively participate in practice development groups, trial innovative virtual delivery methods, refine presentation materials, and contribute to continuous service improvement across the engagement team.
  • Team Contribution: Engage actively in team meetings, sharing local insights, peer-mentoring, and fostering a collaborative team culture.

CRM & Operational Excellence

  • Data & CRM Hygiene: Maintain up-to-date, accurate records of all outreach, contact sourcing, and engagement activities in HubSpot and designated internal tracking tools.
  • Data-Driven Strategy: Analyse monthly performance data to refine and adapt virtual outreach approaches in agreement with your Line Manager.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Breakdown of Focus

  • Direct CYP Outreach & Webinars (Virtual-First & Digital Toolkits): 45%
    Delivering live virtual assemblies, national/regional webinars, pre-recorded promotional rollouts, and digital student campaigns.
  • Referrer & System Upskilling (Education, Health, Community): 30%
    Delivering live virtual training, professional webinars, pre-recorded briefings, and self-serve toolkits to school staff, primary care/GP teams, CAMHS, Family Hubs, and community leaders.
  • Strategic Alignment, Commissioner Reporting & Commercial Co-working: 15%
    Quarterly review reporting, cross-regional project support, partner meeting presentations, and strategy alignment with Commercial colleagues.
  • Practice Development & Team Participation: 5%
    Actively contributing to practice development initiatives, trialling new outreach methods, and participating in team meetings.
  • CRM, Data & Administration (HubSpot): 5%
    Sourcing contacts, recording engagement metrics, maintaining database hygiene, and monthly planning.

Requirements

What You’ll Bring:

  • Proven experience in virtual delivery, online training, webinar hosting, or public speaking to diverse audiences (young people, educators, healthcare professionals).
  • Ability to design and utilise flexible delivery models (live virtual, webinars, pre-recorded modules, and self-serve toolkits) tailored to both youth and professional referrer audiences.
  • Adaptability to manage dedicated contract responsibilities while seamlessly collaborating across regional and national projects.
  • A collaborative mindset with a desire to contribute actively to team meetings and practice development groups.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to build rapport and drive engagement in a remote environment.
  • Strong organisational skills with experience using a CRM system.
  • Experience or strong understanding of the education, youth work, mental health, or community healthcare sectors.
  • Capability to understand contract KPIs and translate data into actionable outreach strategies and clear reports.
  • Proficient and excited by the latest tech and virtual interactive tools.

Desirable:

  • Understanding of safeguarding protocols, digital health platforms, or NHS/Local Authority commissioning structures.
  • Experience working alongside Commercial or Business Development teams to support contract delivery.

Benefits

  • What You’ll Get:
  • Compensation: The base salary for this role is up to £28,860 annually. We’re committed to transparency and value our candidates time, which is why we share salary ranges in all states—regardless of local requirements. Final compensation will be based on a variety of factors, including your education, experience, skills, and overall alignment with the role.

The EAP offers 24/7 telephone mental health support and access to GP consultations, ensuring your mental and physical health are taken care of.

    • Flexible Working: Embrace the flexibility of remote working, allowing you to create a work-life balance that suits your needs and maximizes your productivity.

About BOI

BOI is the AI partner that Walmart, Coca-Cola, and Mastercard call when AI needs to drive growth, not just savings. We rebuild how work gets done, starting from the outcomes each team exists to deliver: agents do the work, people own the judgment, and the capacity it frees goes to growth. We bring together the unusually strong in frontier enterprise AI, then give them the ownership to make it happen. If you're looking for a comfortable place to hide, we're not it. If you want to build the future of enterprise AI with people who will make you better: welcome home.

Your Role

Own the Technical Build

  • Own the architecture and engineering quality of every client build, from first prototype to production in the client's environment.
  • Shape solution architecture across models, clouds and platforms, and make build, buy or configure calls you can defend to a client CTO. Our clients run on Azure, AWS and Google Cloud. We're independent of every vendor, so the answer is whatever is best for the client.
  • Set the engineering standards every build meets: evaluation of AI outputs, security and data governance, observability, and production reliability.
  • Build the reusable components, patterns and internal products that let each engagement start further ahead than the last.

Lead with Clients

  • Sit with client CTOs, CIOs and business executives as BOI's senior technical voice. Explain technical choices in terms of cost, risk and value, so non-technical leaders can decide.
  • Lead client security, compliance and procurement reviews, and get our systems approved to run in their environments.
  • Work forward deployed: get into client environments early, build alongside their teams, and keep building as the relationship grows.

Shape What We Sell

  • Scope and estimate builds for proposals with our Directors of Applied AI, so what we sell can be built on time and to standard.
  • Turn what we've built into case studies, reusable IP and technical thought leadership.

Build the Team

  • Lead, coach and grow our engineering team, roughly doubling it over the next year. Set high standards, give direct feedback, and give credit generously.
  • Run AI-first ways of working across engineering, with your own tools and workflows as the example.
  • Help build BOI like an owner, alongside our leadership team in the US and Europe.

What We Look For

We are deliberately not for everyone. We look for a specific combination of qualities:

  • You've shipped AI systems to production at enterprise scale, inside environments with real security, compliance and data constraints.
  • You've led engineering in a consultancy, agency or other project-based environment. You're comfortable with work that changes shape every few months and with stacks you didn't choose.
  • You've founded a company or been early at a startup. You can build the team as well as the system, and you make good decisions before everything is known.
  • You explain technical choices to non-technical executives in plain language, and they leave the room ready to decide.

What We Offer

  • You'll set the technical direction of a growing AI company and shape how BOI builds in every market we work in.
  • You'll build compounding skills at the frontier of AI while others are still catching up.
  • What your team builds goes live in client systems within weeks, and you see the value it creates.
  • We're independent of every vendor, so you work across every model and cloud, building with whatever is best and swapping it when something better ships.
  • You get the freedom to prototype, experiment, and push boundaries on what's possible with AI.

Benefits

We also offer comprehensive health benefits, 401(k), 25 days PTO, hybrid working (if based out of NYC), professional development support, and the opportunity to work alongside some of the world's leading AI practitioners on high-impact enterprise transformations.

BOI is an equal opportunity employer: we celebrate diversity and welcome all backgrounds and identities.

jobs.description:
Logistics at full potential.

At GXO, we’re constantly looking for talented individuals at all levels who can deliver the caliber of service our company requires. You know that a positive work environment creates happy employees, which boosts productivity and dedication. On our team, you’ll have the support to excel at work and the resources to build a career you can be proud of.

Logistics at full potential

Strong leadership, management, and customer service are at the heart of our operations at GXO Logistics. As the Trade Compliance Senior Manager, you will lead and support the Director, Trade Compliance in the implementation and enhancement of GXO’s global trade compliance program while serving as the lead subject matter expert for the United States.

This role acts as a key regional subject matter expert, providing guidance to the business and ensuring compliance frameworks are effectively implemented and maintained.

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level, come join us at GXO!

Pay, benefits and more.

We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and more.

What you’ll do on a typical day:

  • Lead the establishment and ongoing enhancement of export/import compliance standards, guidelines and monitoring procedures for GXO’s operations in the USA and in partnership with the Director, Trade Compliance and external trade compliance counsel.
  • Drive the implementation and effectiveness of ITAR / EAR, import, and customs compliance control policies, procedures, and resources through training, communication, and process improvements.
  • Proactively identify and address compliance risks, driving continuous improvement initiatives and implementing sustainable solutions.
  • Partner with operational leadership, customers and functional teams to implement practical and effective trade compliance controls.
  • Maintain compliance with DDTC registration and reporting requirements, working with internal stakeholders and external counsel as required.
  • Oversee compliance with ITAR and EAR regulated operations, driving risk mitigation and process improvements.
  • Monitor and interpret regulatory developments (ITAR, EAR, customs, sanctions), ensuring the business remains informed and compliant.
  • Provide operational and reporting support for queries related to ACE.
  • Support business units with import, export, sanctions and customs compliance matters.
  • Support the standardization of trade compliance processes and assist with trade compliance-related matters relevant to the North/South American offices.
  • Review and enhance Restricted Party Screening and Enhanced Due Diligence processes, identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Support internal investigations into potential trade compliance issues and coordinate corrective actions where required.
  • Support and assist with other aspects of the Compliance team work as required, such as compliance audits and visits, reviews, awareness and training on the GXO Code of Business Ethics and its associated policies, anti-bribery and anti-trust.
  • The role will require travel primarily within the USA.

What you need to succeed at GXO:

At a minimum, you’ll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience
  • 7-10 years of work experience in U.S. import/export regulations and trade compliance.
  • Strong expertise in U.S. customs software and systems, ACE and EEI filings.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders across operational, commercial and corporate functions.
  • Experience with Mexico and Canadian customs frameworks.
  • Advanced knowledge of export regulations, ITAR and EAR and customs regulations.
  • Advanced knowledge about United States economic sanctions regulations, with particular emphasis on the Office of Foreign Assets (OFAC) sanctions and general knowledge about U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry Security (BIS) and U.S. State Department, Directorate of Defense Trade Controls (DDTC) export control regulations, Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA)
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Travel Requirement: up to 25% primarily within the United States.

It’d be great if you also have:

  • Free trade qualification experience (USMCA and IMMEX)
  • Knowledge of the logistics and / or supply chain business
  • Experience working with 3PL customers on import and export issues
  • Knowledge of FAR and DEFAR compliance

We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.

GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer including Disabled/Veterans.

GXO adheres to CDC, OSHA and state and local requirements regarding COVID safety. All employees and visitors are expected to comply with GXO policies which are in place to safeguard our employees and customers.

All applicants who receive a conditional offer of employment may be required to take and pass a pre-employment drug test.

  • 100% Remote: Enjoy the freedom to work from anywhere within your country of residence—be it a co-working space, your home office, or even your dining room table. The choice is yours. Just don’t ask to work in our office (we don’t have one).

  • Equity: Every role in our company comes with valuable stock options in a fast-growing and profitable company. This ensures we all share in the company’s success.

  • Values-Driven Leadership: Our Core Values are not just words we’ve written to make us feel good. We leverage them daily when making strategic and tactical decisions.

  • Professional Growth: Our rapid growth offers unparalleled learning and development opportunities, along with a multitude of career advancement opportunities.

  • Annual Paid Leave: The specific amounts vary by country and are aligned with country and/or contract-specific norms.

  • Geographic Specific Benefits: As an international employer, we offer different country-specific benefits such as Health Insurance and Pensions in countries where these perks are customary. The specifics depend on the country of the applicant.

  • Dynamic Team Culture: As a global company with team members in over 40 countries, our diverse and international culture fuels our innovation and creativity, providing a key pillar to our success (and making it a lot of fun to work here).

Thank you for your interest. If you apply for this role, you will receive an email from our Talent Acquisition team after your application has been reviewed alongside the qualifications for this role and the qualifications of others who have applied.

jobs.excerpt: About Us At Rovia Clinical Research, we’re on a mission to bring innovative treatments to patients, improving the health and lives of our local patient communities.
jobs.description:
About Us

At Rovia Clinical Research, we’re on a mission to bring innovative treatments to patients, improving the health and lives of our local patient communities. We believe in building a workplace where people feel supported, valued, and excited to grow their careers. Whether you’re just starting out or looking for a new path, you’ll be part of a team that truly works together and makes an impact.Our team is driven by our core values: People First, Humility, Integrity, One Team, and Results Accountability.

Position Summary:

The Clinical Research Regulatory Specialist will work as an integral member of the research staff by maintaining day-to-day regulatory tasks within the site network, assisting with the execution of clinical studies in accordance with the protocol, contract scope of work, ICH/GCP, sponsor, CRO, Rovia SOPs, and any relevant local guidelines and regulations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Performs startup activities including IRB submissions, regulatory documentation, vendor and training access, etc.
  • Assists with the management of Rovia’s eRegulatory platform Florence, including creating study binders, filing startup and maintenance documents, performing quality checks, monitoring investigator and site credentials, etc.
  • Completes regulatory documentation such as Financial Disclosure Forms (FDFs), Protocol Signature Pages (PSPs), FDA 1572s, and Investigative Brochure Signature Pages.
  • Routes regulatory documents to research staff and investigators to obtain signatures and follow up as necessary.
  • Works collaboratively with investigators and research staff to complete outstanding documents.
  • Returns regulatory documents and credentials to the sponsor/CRO in a timely manner.
  • Creates delegation of authority logs and adjusts as needed throughout the study duration.
  • Creates training logs.
  • Performs reviews of the Investigator Site Files (ISFs) for completion and accuracy.
  • Gathers documents requested during Site Selection Visits (SSVs) including copies of research staff/investigators curriculum vitae (CVs), medical licenses (MLs), Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training certificates, Rovia SOPs, site equipment calibration logs, etc.
  • Creates investigator curriculum vitaes (CVs) and updates on a biannual basis or as requested.
  • Obtains and maintains valid medical licenses for all investigators.
  • Participates in the development of company SOPs and Guidance Documents (GDs) as needed.
  • Creates and submits continuing reviews, protocol deviations, and any other ongoing IRB submissions.
  • May perform other job-related duties as requested or required.

Skills/Abilities:

  • Sound knowledge of medical terminology.
  • Sound knowledge of ICH/GCP, Regulatory requirements, FDA and HIPAA policies and practices.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to interact effectively with clinicians, patients, administrators, auxiliary personnel, regulators, monitors, and sponsors.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality.
  • Strong written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills.
  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office, Microsoft Excel, and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Ability to meet multiple and changing deadlines
  • Ability to consult numerous sources for information to prepare documents.
  • Fluent in spoken and written English.

Education/Experience:

  • High school diploma required, bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • 1-2 years of clinical research experience with an emphasis in regulatory and QA.
  • License/certification status with CEUs, as applicable.
  • Current GCP certification.

Position Summary...

What you'll do...

Role summary:
The Manager, Supply Chain Management oversees the efficient flow of merchandise through distribution networks and fulfillment centers by resolving operational issues and analyzing data to enhance network performance. This role involves collaborating with stakeholders to optimize supply chain execution, managing exceptions, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The position requires leadership in supervising teams, fostering accountability, and ensuring compliance with company policies. The manager also champions innovation to reduce costs and improve processes while maintaining strong relationships across the supply chain to support business objectives and deliver consistent results.
About the team:
The Inbound Supplier Performance team is a strategic partner across the end-to-end inbound supply chain, focused on optimizing freight flow, strengthening supplier performance, and enabling reliable execution. We collaborate across Replenishment, Operations, Transportation, suppliers, and carriers to identify barriers, resolve systemic challenges, and improve service to our stores and customers. Our team drives operational excellence through proactive issue resolution, data-informed decision-making, process improvement, and strong cross-functional partnerships.   • Collaborate with suppliers and cross-functional partners to address performance gaps, strengthen reliability, and optimize service outcomes.

jobs.excerpt: Curious Minds.  Bold Ideas.  Extraordinary Impact.
jobs.description:
Curious Minds. Bold Ideas. Extraordinary Impact.

We're transforming financial services through bold innovation and relentless execution. You bring the ideas and drive. We'll build what's next — together.

nCino is hiring a Senior Functional Consultant to lead delivery of its commercial banking solutions at community and regional financial institutions. This role calls for real commercial lending experience, since the consultant advises clients on lending best practices using nCino and stays current on banking regulations. Day to day, the consultant leads projects, turns business requirements into functional designs, partners with technical teams, and runs product demos for client teams. The consultant also keeps stakeholders, from executives to end users, aligned through status updates and risk assessments.

The ideal candidate has spent meaningful time in commercial lending and understands how loans move through origination, how credit decisions get made, and what regulators expect. This person is comfortable running projects independently and can explain complex topics to any audience. The candidate is a natural problem solver who takes on challenges head-on, finds answers independently, and enjoys learning new things and digging into functional problems with technology. Experience with Salesforce or agile delivery is a plus.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary liaison between clients and the technical team, translating business requirements into solution designs and detailed functional specifications to drive measurable business value within the scope of the project. Escalate program-related issues and concerns promptly and professionally to maintain project momentum and ensure customer satisfaction.

  • Utilize knowledge of the banking industry and nCino best practices to offer strategic consulting to customers. Provide insight on industry trends and regulatory requirements to help clients stay ahead of the curve.

  • Identify innovative and efficient solutions to complex problems, enhancing the value and impact of nCino implementations. Conduct benchmarking and analysis to recommend best practices and improvements.

  • Demonstrate expertise in the nCino product, including its technical functionality and high-level data model. Guide customers in leveraging the product's capabilities to meet their specific needs and objectives, ensuring optimal utilization and satisfaction. Conduct in-depth product demonstrations and training sessions to showcase nCino's features. Provide ongoing support and troubleshooting to address any issues that arise and advocating internally for product gap resolutions on behalf of customers.

  • Drive the vision and adoption of nCino across financial institutions (FIs) by fostering relationships with key stakeholders at all levels, from executives to individual contributors. Champion the benefits and features of nCino to encourage widespread adoption.

  • Provide comprehensive project status updates and risk assessments to peers and senior management. Prepare detailed reports and presentations that highlight project progress, potential risks, and mitigation strategies.

  • Deliver clear, actionable insights that facilitate informed decision-making. Ensure transparent and consistent communication across all project stakeholders, fostering a collaborative environment.

  • Utilize project management tools and methodologies to track progress and manage resources effectively. jobs.excerpt: About the companyPaid per approved task, about $60/hr equivalent.
jobs.description:
About the company

Paid per approved task, about $60/hr equivalent. One flat rate for every approved task.

Built to fit around a clinical practice:

  • Tasks estimated at about 10–20 hrs/week while the project is active; you choose when and how much to contribute
  • Contribute anytime, from anywhere
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All reviewers are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for actively practicing, US-licensed physicians (MD/DO) living outside the US, with an active, unrestricted US medical license, to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. On this project, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, apply to take part!

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for US-licensed physicians living outside the US who are looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around clinical practice. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This opportunity is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid ​

How to apply

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Project time expectations

You decide when and how much to contribute. For this project, tasks are estimated at around 10–20 hours per week during active phases. This is an estimate, not a minimum or a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks are submitted within the project timeline and need to meet the listed acceptance criteria to be approved.

Earnings

Earnings are per approved task, at a flat rate set to about $60/hr equivalent based on estimated task time. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the base rate. QA and adjudication tasks are paid at a higher rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved.
  • Incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks. Terms are shared in the project guidelines.

jobs.description:
Overview

The Senior People Operations Compliance Analyst supports the organization’s People Operations Compliance priorities by analyzing regulatory and client-driven requirements and coordinating assigned compliance initiatives. This role partners with the People Team, Legal, and cross-functional stakeholders to apply and enhance established compliance frameworks, controls, and processes that support regulatory, contractual, and audit readiness. The role proactively identifies potential compliance risks, researches evolving legal and client requirements, recommends practical solutions using established guidance and precedent, and escalates complex or high-risk matters as appropriate.

Responsibilities

Emerging Risk & Regulatory Strategy

  • Monitor, analyze, and interpret evolving regulatory requirements and industry trends across U.S. and international jurisdictions.
  • Support assessment and implementation of compliance requirements in emerging areas, including:
    • AI and automated decision-making in hiring and other employment-related processes.
    • Restrictive covenants and worker classification.
    • Wage and hour regulations.
    • Employee data privacy, accessibility, and recording keeping obligations.
    • FCRA and background check compliance.
    • Translate complex regulatory requirements into practical policies, controls, and operational guidance.

Client Compliance & Risk Mitigation

  • Partner with Legal, Client Services, and business stakeholders to review and assess client-driven compliance requirements, including background check standards, contract language review, and contractual obligations.
  • Review client contracts, RFPs, and regulatory flow-down requirements to identify People-related compliance obligations and operational impacts.
  • Assess client requirements against applicable federal, state, and local employment laws and advise on compliant implementation strategies.
  • Support audits, client inquiries, and compliance attestations by maintaining documentation, controls, and evidence of compliance.
  • Assess complex or high-risk compliance matters and propose practical solutions to mitigate legal, operational, and contractual risk.
  • Analyze root causes of compliance issues and implement sustainable, scalable processes for remediation.
  • Strengthen audit readiness through improved documentation, controls, and process consistency.

Compliance Governance & Control Design

  • Contribute to the design of People compliance frameworks, including policies, standards, and internal controls.
  • Evaluate existing People processes (e.g., hiring, onboarding, transfers, terminations, and other data management processes) to identify compliance risks and control gaps.
  • Promote standardization, documentation, and control design aligned to audit requirements.

Compliance Programs & Strategic Initiatives:

  • Coordinate assigned cross-functional compliance initiatives under the general direction of People Operations Compliance leadership by completing tasks such as:
    • Support the development and implementation of updates to policies and processes across applicable jurisdictions.
    • Coordinate enhancements to existing compliance programs and policies.
    • Conduct assigned risk assessments across People processes and geographies.
    • Track deliverables, document findings, and escalate issues that require leadership review.
  • Partner with the People Team, TA, Legal, and business leaders to ensure consistent interpretation and application of compliance standards.
  • Contribute to the creation and maintenance of global People policies and procedures to ensure clarity, consistency, and compliance with legal requirements.
  • Promotes consistent implementation of People Team policies across all business units and locations, identifying discrepancies and resolving gaps as appropriate.
  • Prioritize work based on risk exposure, regulatory urgency, and organizational impact.

Compliance Process Automation & Scale

  • Document compliance requirements and partner with People Data & Tech, People Operations, and IT stakeholders to support the implementation and testing of automated compliance workflows and controls.
  • Integrate compliance requirements into HR technology, data governance, and employee lifecycle processes.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort while improving accuracy, consistency, and auditability.

Other:

  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined on annual Performance Plan.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent experience. Focus in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field highly preferred.
  • 5-7 years of progressive experience in People compliance, employment law, or related governance/risk roles.
  • PHR/SPHR, SHRM-CP/SHRM-SCP certifications are highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex compliance initiatives, regulatory implementations, or audit engagement support.
  • Demonstrated experience of laws across all 50 US states; working knowledge of Canada, Mexico, and Australia with exposure to global compliance strongly preferred.
  • Experience working with HRIS and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS); UKG Pro and iCIMS preferred.
  • Project management skills with ability to manage stakeholders and work cross-functionally through influence.
  • Highly effective communication, collaboration, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Presents information and ideas in a thoughtful and compelling manner; is clear and concise in verbal and written communications.
  • Experience using database management, and advanced features in Excel (pivot tables, V-look ups) and manipulating large data sets.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and communicate in a fast-paced environment.
  • Shares information freely and speaks openly and honestly.
  • Seeks to understand the perspectives of others.

Cognitive / Mental Requirements

  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to proactively assess issues, problem-solve, and make sound, data-informed recommendations.
  • Advanced experience using database management, advanced Excel functionality (e.g., pivot tables, V-look ups) to analyze, validate, and manage large, complex data sets.
  • Technically proficient in MS Office Suite and Outlook and pulling data from multiple sources.
  • Excellent communication with others to exchange information.
  • Completing tasks with a high degree of latitude.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
  • Making timely decisions, escalating where applicable.
  • Remembering and adhering to processes and protocols.
  • Applying established protocols in a timely manner.
  • Ensuring the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned with high level of detail orientation.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

jobs.description:
Category: Technology

Location:


About Slash

Slash is a hi-tech startup studio with a mission to build tech AI-powered products and scalable digital platforms that create real-world impact. Since 2016, we’ve partnered with ambitious enterprises and government organizations to design, engineer, and launch cutting-edge solutions — with Generative AI at the core of what we do.

We specialize in AI-powered application delivery, from product design and high-performance engineering to DevOps and AI operations. Headquartered in Singapore, our global team and clients operate R&D hubs across Southeast Asia. We are a team of entrepreneurs, engineers, and product builders dedicated to solving complex technical challenges and turning bold ideas into impactful technology.

About our Client

Our client’s product is an AI voice-sensing device, a breakthrough wearable that detects the gap between what someone says and how their voice actually sounds. Rooted in Pythagorean acoustic physics and the Navarasa framework, the system functions as a state detector rather than a conventional emotion labeler. The team is a small, fast-moving team building at the intersection of emotion labeling, ancient wisdom, and measurable science.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Machine Learning Engineer to take complete ownership of our full AI stack. Your primary responsibility will be expanding our speech emotion recognition (SER) model into a physics-based harmonic vocal state engine, alongside building and maintaining our dual-instance production LLM infrastructure. In this role, you will work directly with the Founder and Lead Developer with zero bureaucracy or committee oversight. We need an engineer who excels at owning problems end-to-end.

Key Responsibilities

1. Harmonic Vocal State Engine (Audio & Physics)

  • Extend our inherited 30-class speech emotion recognition (SER) model, dataset, checkpoints, and pipeline into a physics-based harmonic detection system using Fourier-derived acoustic analysis and the Navarasa framework.

  • Design and implement an in-house model validation methodology from scratch using approaches like Gemini's emotion labeling API, cross-validation on open datasets (IEMOCAP, RAVDESS), or custom ground-truth evaluation pipelines.

2. LLM Infrastructure & Operations

  • Deploy and manage a dual-instance vLLM setup on GCP (g2-standard-24 instance): GPU 0: Llama 3.1 8B for fast-lane prompts; GPU 1: Qwen 2.5 32B for reasoning-heavy prompts.

  • Own prompt engineering, output validation, Pydantic schema enforcement, retry logic, and quality monitoring across 42 production prompts.

  • Handle infrastructure scaling and migrations independently without reliance on third-party vendors.

3. Model Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Build evaluation pipelines to detect and catch regressions before users experience them.

  • Continuously optimize and refine model performance as real-world audio accumulates from our device.


Requirements

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Audio Signal Processing:Strong proficiency in the frequency domain (FFT, Fourier analysis, spectral features) and practical experience with audio processing libraries like librosa or torchaudio.

  • Audio ML Frameworks:Hands-on experience with modern audio ML models (wav2vec2, HuBERT, WavLM) and a deep understanding of training, evaluating, and fine-tuning SER models.

Core Tech Stack:

  • PyTorch & Python:Direct experience handling model checkpoints and training loops; ability to write clean, modular, maintainable production-level code.

Infrastructure & MLOps:

  • GCP & vLLM:Experience managing cloud infrastructure and direct experience deploying and serving models via vLLM.

  • Methodology & Communication:Proven ability to design rigorous evaluation frameworks and strong written English skills for an async-first team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing or building physics-based audio analysis systems.

  • Familiarity with the Navarasa framework, acoustic physics, or classical music/acoustic theory systems.

  • Experience using FastAPI for inference API layers.

  • Prior experience replacing or migrating away from third-party AI benchmarks or providers.

  • Genuine personal interest in sound, acoustic physics, consciousness, or the intersection of emotions and modern ML.

Hiring Process (Take-Home Assessment)

We do not conduct whiteboard interviews. Our technical evaluation is a 48-Hour Practical Assessment consisting of two deliverables:

  • SER Model Assessment:Review our inherited SER validation report and dataset documentation, providing your strategy for validation.

  • Architecture Assessment:Provide a 1-page technical evaluation of a Python file from our harmonic engine, detailing its architecture and roadmap.

This is a remote position.

Customer Success Manager

Job Description

Our client is looking for aCustomer Success Managerto oversee the student experience and serve as the primary point of contact for enrolled professionals throughout their journey. They operate in healthcare education and international career transition and have expanded their services beyond training to include licensing guidance, career preparation, and access to specialized professional partners.

This person will act as the connection between students and the internal operations team, ensuring that every client remains informed, engaged, accountable, and supported. The Customer Success Manager will proactively monitor progress, coordinate solutions across departments, and resolve most day to day concerns independently without requiring founder involvement.

The ideal candidate combines empathy with accountability, communicates confidently in both English and Portuguese, and is passionate about providing a personalized, concierge level experience. Success in this position will directly contribute to student satisfaction, retention, program completion, payment compliance, referrals, and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

Student Relationship Management
  • Serve as the dedicated relationship manager and primary contact for assigned students after enrollment.
  • Build trusted relationships by understanding each student’s goals, timeline, current status, and long term career objectives.
  • Respond to student messages promptly and provide same day answers whenever possible.

Client Onboarding
  • Lead each student’s initial onboarding and introduce the overall program roadmap, expectations, timelines, communication channels, and relevant departments.
  • Collect missing documents and address initial questions.
  • Conduct a second onboarding follow up to confirm that initial tasks have been completed.
  • Review upcoming milestones and introduce additional services, resources, or partners when appropriate.

Biweekly Student Success Check Ins
  • Contact every active student proactively at least once every two weeks.
  • Review academic, licensing, documentation, career, and immigration related progress.
  • Ask whether the student needs additional assistance.
  • Identify concerns, obstacles, or disengagement before they escalate.

Student Journey Planning
  • Own each student’s journey from enrollment through program completion.
  • Develop and maintain an individualized Student Success Roadmap based on the student’s goals and timeline.
  • Identify upcoming milestones, dependencies, and required actions.
  • Help students remain on track toward licensing, program completion, and career objectives.

Progress and Milestone Tracking
  • Maintain accurate records of enrollment stages, academic progress, completed exams, pending requirements, and licensing milestones.
  • Monitor documentation, fellowship participation, graduation status, and applicable immigration milestones.
  • Follow up on missing assignments, forms, payments, or other outstanding actions.
  • Confirm that required documents are submitted on time.
  • Keep accurate timelines for each active student.

Cross Functional Coordination
  • Coordinate communication between Admissions, Academic Coordination, Licensing, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Faculty, Compliance, and the Executive Team.
  • Ensure that all relevant departments understand each student’s needs and pending actions.
  • Contact the appropriate department when additional information or specialized assistance is needed.
  • Follow up internally until open matters are fully resolved.

Issue Resolution

  • Investigate student questions and concerns before they become larger problems.
  • Coordinate practical solutions with the appropriate departments.
  • Resolve routine matters independently and escalate urgent or complex cases appropriately.
  • Follow up with students until each issue is fully closed.
  • Document recurring concerns and recommend improvements to internal processes.

Student Accountability and Engagement

  • Remind students about deadlines, assignments, exams, documentation, and scheduled activities.
  • Encourage course participation and consistent engagement.
  • Motivate students during challenging phases of their journey.
  • Balance empathy with clear expectations and accountability.
  • Reinforce the connection between current responsibilities and each student’s long term goals.

Immigration Journey Coordination
  • Monitor immigration related action items without providing legal advice.
  • Confirm that students have connected with the appropriate immigration attorneys or legal partners.
  • Encourage students to begin planning early when immigration steps could affect their overall timeline.
  • Coordinate meetings with internal teams and immigration partners when necessary.
  • Follow up on pending actions and escalate delays that may affect the student’s roadmap.

Business Setup and Professional Integration
  • Identify students interested in opening or operating a business in the United States.
  • Coordinate introductions to accounting, legal, business, and other professional partners.
  • Work with Operations to arrange meetings with partners in the United States and Brazil.
  • Help students understand administrative next steps based on information provided by qualified partners.
  • Follow up on implementation progress without providing legal, accounting, or immigration advice.

Career Development and Opportunity Management
  • Identify networking, fellowship, conference, speaking, mentorship, and professional development opportunities aligned with each student’s goals.
  • Connect students with relevant alumni, faculty members, mentors, and strategic partners.

Community Engagement and Recognition
  • Share relevant updates about the United States healthcare and aesthetics industries.
  • Recognize student publications, certifications, licenses, clinic openings, promotions, awards, and professional milestones.
  • Share approved student success stories with the broader community.
  • Encourage connections and networking among students and alumni.
  • Strengthen students’ sense of belonging throughout the program.

Client Appreciation
  • Maintain an accurate birthday and milestone calendar.
  • Coordinate gifts with Operations and ensure orders are requested at least 15 days in advance.

Risk Management
  • Monitor warning signs such as low engagement, missed classes, incomplete documentation, payment difficulties, communication gaps, dissatisfaction, or repeated delays.
  • Create recovery plans before concerns escalate.
  • Coordinate internal support and monitor whether the recovery plan is working.

CRM and Documentation
  • Update the CRM after every relevant student interaction.
  • Log calls, emails, meetings, notes, decisions, commitments, and follow up actions.
  • Ensure another team member could understand the complete status of a student by reviewing the CRM record.

Reporting and Continuous Improvement
  • Prepare weekly updates covering active students, new concerns, unresolved matters, and urgent escalations.
  • Prepare biweekly reports covering student progress, at risk cases, program completion, wins, testimonials, and escalated matters.
  • Support monthly reporting on retention, satisfaction trends, recurring operational issues, and improvement opportunities.

Requirements

​

Requirements
  • Professional fluency in both English and Portuguese, written and spoken.
  • Previous experience in Customer Success, Client Success, Account Management, Student Services, Client Relations, Case Management, or another client facing function.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple students, clients, or accounts simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organization, prioritization, time management, and follow through.
  • Proactive problem solving skills and the ability to anticipate issues.
  • High emotional intelligence and the ability to communicate with empathy and professionalism.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate documentation habits.
  • Experience working with CRM platforms and productivity tools.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace, including Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, and Drive.
  • Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with multiple internal teams.
  • Ability to handle sensitive client situations with discretion.
  • Commitment to delivering a premium and highly personalized client experience.
  • Comfort working in a fast paced environment where priorities may change.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, Healthcare Administration, Education, International Relations, or a related field is preferred.
  • Experience supporting students, healthcare professionals, international clients, or individuals navigating complex multistep processes is highly desirable.
  • Experience in healthcare, education, immigration services, licensing, professional training, or international career transition programs is preferred.
  • Previous experience in a startup, growing company, or fast paced organization is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of the United States healthcare, aesthetics, professional licensing, or education industries is a plus.
  • Professional proficiency in Spanish is a plus.

Benefits

Benefits

  • 100% remote opportunity for candidates located in Latin America.

  • Opportunity to collaborate with operations, education, licensing, career, and professional service teams.

Who We Are:

Clearwave Corporation is an innovative healthcare technology company based in Atlanta, Georgia that provides a complete patient-engagement platform for specialty practices. Clearwave is committed to superior client onboarding and ongoing client success with an unsurpassed client-partner relationship.

Overview

Clearwave is the AI Patient Engagement Platform for healthcare organizations that must adapt and scale with leaner operational teams. Founded in 2004 and based in Atlanta, Georgia, Clearwave serves more than 5,000 healthcare locations with AI Agents that work alongside client staff to drive collections, reduce administrative workload and create a seamless patient experience.

The Client Success Manager (CSM) is a critical part of Clearwave’s growth strategy. Once a client is live and out of implementation, the CSM owns the relationship and the results: driving deeper adoption, proving measurable outcomes and protecting account health. We are looking for a natural customer advocate who is data-minded, comfortable in front of executives, and energized by a fast-paced environment.
