  • Adoption and outcomes. Drive continued adoption across modules, locations and workflows after go-live, including Voice, Clinical Intake, Reschedule Assist and Payments, guided by success plans tied to client objectives and Clearwave benchmarks.
  • Client relationships. Serve as the trusted partner for a book of 30 to 40 clients, building relationships with practice administrators, executives, operations and revenue cycle leaders, front office teams and IT.
  • Reporting and business reviews. Build and present performance dashboards and business reviews that translate portal data into business value, with revenue impact first, operational efficiency second and patient experience as the enabler of both.
  • Account health and risk. Maintain account health scores, investigate meaningful drops, flag at-risk accounts early, and coordinate with Account Management when a client is evaluating a competitor.
  • Enterprise accounts. Grow to manage enterprise and multi-location accounts within the first year, with a structured ramp, including enterprise rollups, and understand how each client’s EMR and PM System environment shapes workflows and results.
  • Growth partnership. Identify and qualify expansion opportunities and hand them to Account Management or Sales with context. Provide usage and outcome insight ahead of renewals, which Account Management leads along with pricing.
  • Collaboration. Advocate for clients across Implementation, Support, Product, Sales and Marketing. Bring the voice of the client to Product, and partner with Marketing on references, case studies and webinars.
  • Ways of working. Use AI-enabled tools to prepare for client calls and analyze performance and handle client data in line with HIPAA and Clearwave’s PHI policy.

What Success Looks Like

Success is measured by adoption and outcome improvement across the book, account health movement, client satisfaction and executive engagement, qualified expansion opportunities, the quality of insight supporting renewals and the accuracy of Salesforce and health score data.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of two (2) years in a Customer Success Manager role, or 5+ years in a related client-facing SaaS role, with a proven record of driving post-sale adoption and measurable client outcomes. Healthcare SaaS experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong business acumen, experience with or demonstrated aptitude for executive-level presentations and analytical comfort turning data into a clear story. Salesforce experience is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills, with poise and tact in high-pressure situations. Self-directed and organized in a remote, team-based environment.
  • Willingness to travel 10% to 25%.
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited 4-year college or university, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

  • 5+ years of healthcare experience with strong knowledge of the patient intake and patient access process.
  • Familiarity with EMR and PM System platforms, revenue cycle workflows, and HIPAA. Experience with enterprise or multi-location clients.

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans

  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully

  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

We operate lean, with a small senior leadership team supported by a distributed team of junior specialists working under structured systems and processes.

The Role

We're looking for a Director of Growth to own demand generation end-to-end. This role is structured as part-time (targeting roughly half-time) as a matter of capital discipline at our stage — but we're open to a different arrangement for the right person. What matters most is not the hours on a calendar, but that our India-based marketing team has a consistent, engaged source of direction and does not go without leadership day to day.

You'll bring 5-10 years of hands-on experience, set the standard for quality and craft, and manage a cadre of junior marketers already in place, with full ownership of the function and no layer of leadership above you other than Vulcury's President.

This is a senior leadership role, not just an individual contributor position. You will both execute at a high level and manage junior team members executing under your direction, spanning the full demand generation funnel — marketing, sales oversight, and everything in between. You'll support growth needs across our core consultancy, our internal spinout ventures, and potentially client engagements as our services expand.

Schedule note:Because our junior marketing team is based in India, this role requires regular, dependable overlap with India business hours — not occasional, but a standing part of the job. In practice, this means being comfortable logging on in the early morning or staying online into the late evening (US time) on a recurring basis to hold live check-ins, reviews, and coaching sessions with the team. The India team's need for consistent direction is the fixed point of this role; the exact hours structure around it can flex.

Compensation

We pay market rate, prorated to the agreed time commitment, with potential equity upside for the right candidate.


Requirements

What We're Looking For
  • 5-10 years of marketing and/or sales experience, with demonstrated ability to manage people and not just campaigns or accounts
  • Experience owning both marketing execution and sales pipeline oversight — a true full-funnel operator
  • Experience in B2B strongly preferred
  • Background or genuine fluency in one or more of: supply chain/manufacturing, venture studios/consulting, or finance/hedge funds — through prior work, education, or adjacent experience
  • Proven ability to build and run demand generation operations across multiple channels simultaneously (not a single-channel specialist)
  • Comfortable working with data — segmentation, tracking, attribution, funnel conversion — not just creative execution
  • Strong written communication; capable of producing and reviewing blog and content work directly
  • Able to operate with autonomy in a lean, fast-moving, AI-augmented team structure with minimal traditional middle management
  • Willing and able to provide consistent, ongoing direction to a team on India business hours— comfortable anchoring recurring check-ins to early mornings or late evenings (US time)

Nice to Have
  • Experience marketing and selling for a holding company, venture studio, or multi-business-line organization
  • Prior experience managing distributed or international teams, particularly across US-India time zones
  • Familiarity with CRM/marketing automation tooling and AI-assisted workflows

Benefits

VP of Strategic Finance

Competitive compensation: $230,000–$300,000 + equity

Why You Should Choose Steno

When you join Steno, you're not just joining a finance team - you're joining a company that:

  • Wins together – Stock options included. When Steno grows, you grow.
  • Invests in you – Premium Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage — options for you and your family, with generous employer contributions toward premiums.
  • Supports your wellbeing – Wellness and mental health benefits to be used among employees and families.
  • Operates with integrity – We value long-term partnerships over short-term wins.
  • Constantly innovates with technology at our core – We are a modern organization solving real problems in an industry that needs a revolutionary approach.
  • Gives you room to build – You own your domain, drive your own agenda, and serve as a true thought partner to leadership.

Why Strategic Finance at Steno Is Different

Steno is an operationally complex business, and the financials are always a downstream read on what’s happening upstream. That means the interesting questions don’t live in the P&L — they live in how jobs get scheduled, how providers get paid, how firms get invoiced, how sales teams get deployed, and how product usage ladders up to revenue. You will be the person who diagnoses across all of it. It's a strategic, high-impact role where you:

  • Own the full FP&A cycle — reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis — with the narrative depth that helps leadership understand not just what happened, but why, and what it means for next quarter.
  • Act as the company’s internal consulting bench — pick up the ambiguous, cross-functional problems that don’t yet have an owner and run them from problem framing to decision to implementation.
  • Diagnose beyond the model — when something moves in the P&L, trace it back to what actually happened in the business: a comp plan change, a service delivery constraint, a product decision, a team restructure.
  • Drive action, not just insight — use data to inform real-time decisions on staffing, pipeline performance, pricing, and resource allocation.
  • Connect the dots across the company — surface the insights that span teams before anyone thinks to ask for them.
  • Build with a systems mindset — evaluate tools, data infrastructure, and processes with an eye toward scalability, integration, and downstream impact.
  • Lead the company’s highest-stakes analytical work — unit economics, investment cases, new business models, and deep dives that shape company direction.
  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to the SVP of Finance — pressure-test assumptions, flag second-order impacts, and bring rigor to decisions that span the business.

You'll report directly to Dayna Shi, SVP of Finance, and work cross-functionally across the organization. There is no ceiling on the impact you can have.

The ideal candidate brings 8+ years of experience spanning FP&A and Business Operations, including time in investment banking, management consulting, or a BizOps / Strategy & Operations seat at a scaling company. They have a track record of owning the FP&A cycle end-to-end — reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and board-level narrative — at a company with real operational complexity. They operate with deep analytical rigor and have experience running ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives from framing through to decision.

This person thinks in systems, communicates complex analysis with clarity, and has a bias toward operational action. Experience in SaaS, legal tech, or marketplace businesses is highly valued, as is familiarity with tools like Looker, dbt, or Snowflake

Who You Are

You are genuinely curious about how every part of the business works, and you have learned to read financial outcomes through a business-first lens. When revenue is down, your first question isn’t “what changed in the model?” — it’s “what happened in the business that the P&L can’t show me?” That answer might live in Ops (a service delivery constraint, a throughput issue), in GTM (a territory change, a comp plan that shifted rep behavior), in Product (a change that affected how clients experience the service), or in a people decision made two quarters ago. You know the P&L is a lagging report on decisions that were already made — and you’ve built the instinct to work backwards from the number to the real cause.

You think like an internal consultant. You’re the person other leaders pull in when a problem is messy, cross-functional, and doesn’t have an obvious owner — because you can frame the question, build the analytical case, align the stakeholders, and see the work through to a decision. You distinguish leading indicators from lagging ones instinctively. When you build a model or a report, you don’t stop at the dashboard — you use it to change how a team operates.

You also think in systems. When a new tool is being evaluated or a new business unit is being modeled, you’re already considering how it connects to the broader ecosystem, who needs to be involved, and how to set things up for success. You are comfortable operating in environments where the infrastructure is evolving and the process is still being built — you see that as an opportunity to create something better.

jobs.excerpt: About SparkSpark is a science-driven, philanthropically funded non-profit that accelerates progress on unsolved climate challenges.
jobs.description:
About Spark

Spark is a science-driven, philanthropically funded non-profit that accelerates progress on unsolved climate challenges. Our goal is to enable a safer climate by filling targeted gaps in current climate actions. We look around the corner at the key blind spots that pose big climate risks or offer big climate opportunities, like major sources of unabated emissions. Then we work to speed up the development of the fields needed to address those challenges.
We are a team of scientists, policy experts, innovators, and systems thinkers working to build today’s foundations for the comprehensive climate solutions we will need tomorrow. Rather than betting on individual pathways or innovations, we work to grow a field as a whole so that the most effective science and solutions can be surfaced and scaled. We use a large suite of field-building tools to support new research, markets, policies, and talent development, through both in-house initiatives and building broader coalitions. We are currently focused on super pollutants from agriculture (specifically methane and nitrous oxide), warming-induced greenhouse gas emissions, and methane removal.
Spark’s impact is made possible by a community of generous and pioneering individuals, foundations, and organizations that share our vision for a safer climate future.

Position Summary

Spark Climate Solutions seeks an experienced agricultural policy leader with experience working across party lines to drive U.S. policy strategy and execution for Spark's agriculture program areas: Livestock Enteric Methane Mitigation and Agricultural Nitrogen Transformation. The policy remit spans a range of agricultural issues with potential climate implications, including policies and approaches that support agricultural innovation, research, and development.
At Spark, policy plays a critical role in accelerating the fields we work in. For example, to advance public research funding for methane removal, Spark supported the development and introduction of the bipartisan Methane Removal Research and Innovation Act (MRRIA) in the House, which would establish the first dedicated federal methane removal research program at DOE; the Livestock Enteric Program helped advance the Innovative Feed Act, now included in the Senate Agriculture Committee's Farm Bill draft, which would establish a new, faster regulatory pathway for methane-reducing feed additives.
This role combines policy strategy and original policy development (drafting proposals, legislative language, and analytical memos) with active coalition and stakeholder engagement across federal agencies, Congress, trade associations, and producer groups. Specifically, this role will focus on:
  1. Translation of the programs’ science and field needs into a viable and actionable long-term policy strategy for current and future Congresses and administrations.
  2. U.S. federal policy development for approaches that include methane and nitrous oxide mitigation from crop and livestock systems, including research, development, demonstration, deployment, and de-risking proposals.

jobs.description:
About OpenMined

OpenMined is a 501(c)(3) non-profit foundation that brings together leading minds in AI, security, and privacy technology to develop open-source solutions that transform how data can be accessed and shared. Founded in 2017, we've grown into a global community of over 18,000 members working to ensure that privacy protection and AI innovation reinforce each other rather than undermine one another. We are driven by a simple challenge: the most valuable data for solving humanity's greatest challenges remains locked away due to privacy concerns, and we can change that through technology rather than compromise.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own how OpenMined plans, tracks, and ships its most ambitious work. You'll work most closely with Ronnie Falcon, Chief Product Officer, and you'll be the person accountable for timelines, dependencies, and delivery across our product, engineering, research, and partnerships teams.

OpenMined runs several high-stakes efforts at once. ScreamingFace is an open-source toolkit for composing multiple LLMs into systems that beat any single frontier model, with a public leaderboard and a research fellowship. AI Oversight builds privacy-preserving infrastructure that lets AI labs, auditors, and safety institutes run evaluations without exposing models or data, with pilots alongside frontier labs. These efforts span multiple teams, tools, and funders, and they move fast under real research uncertainty.

Our product leads decide what to build, and our tech leads decide how it's built. You'll own when and in what order it gets delivered. That means turning goals into milestones with real dates, keeping roadmaps current rather than rewriting them once a year, and making our tools a source of truth people trust. It also means telling leadership early when a date is about to slip and what the options are.

This is a technical role. You'll work daily with engineers and researchers on distributed systems, LLM infrastructure, and privacy-enhancing technologies. You don't need to write production code, but you need to understand the work well enough to break it down, spot risk, and challenge an estimate.

We're an AI-native team. Our engineers ship with AI coding agents, our main codebase releases several times a week, and our tools and habits keep evolving as AI does. We're looking for a seasoned technical program manager who has built and run project management practices for teams like this. You'll bring years of hands-on experience, use AI to make planning, tracking, and reporting faster and lighter, and help OpenMined become a team that is excellent at project management, not one that depends on a single person to do it.

This is an independent contractor engagement, roughly a full-time commitment, with an initial 12-month term we expect to renew. You set your own schedule, but we need your working hours to overlap substantially with US Eastern business hours (your local time within about one hour of ET).

Responsibilities

  • Own delivery end to end for OpenMined's flagship initiatives (ScreamingFace and AI Oversight), from quarterly goals to milestones, dependencies, and release dates.
  • Design, run, and keep improving our project management practice for an AI-native team: planning, tracking, status reporting, and retros built around how engineers work with AI agents today, and updated as those tools change.
  • Build AI into how we manage projects: use and build AI agents and automations that draft status updates, summarize Linear, GitHub, and meeting activity, flag risks and stale work, and keep plans current with little manual upkeep.
  • Make the whole team better at project management: set standards and templates, coach product and engineering leads, and grow project management skills across the team, laying the groundwork for future project management hires.
  • Turn quarterly OKRs into dated, sequenced plans with product and engineering leads, and keep them current as research results and priorities shift.
  • Run a living product roadmap that is reviewed on a regular cadence and can feed grant proposals and funder reports without a last-minute rewrite.
  • Be the single accountable owner for cross-team dependencies when one initiative spans several boards, teams, or external partners, and chase down blockers yourself before they cause a slip.
  • Own our project management tooling (Linear for engineering, Asana for cross-functional work): set conventions, cut noise, and make sure status in the tools matches reality.
  • Connect code to plans: make sure work in GitHub links to Linear issues across all active repos, and keep PR review, release status, and repo ownership visible.
  • Track and report progress on milestones, cycle time, and OKR key results to leadership, and flag slipping dates early with clear trade-off options.
  • Coordinate external deliverables such as partner pilots, program launches (e.g., our research fellowship), and grant milestones, so commitments to partners and funders are met.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 7+ years of technical project or program management, delivering complex software with product and engineering teams. Transferable experience, such as a software engineering background, will also be considered.
  • Built or rebuilt a project management practice: set up planning cadences, tooling, and standards that a team kept using, earned buy-in through credibility rather than heavy process, and raised others' project management skills.
  • Has shaped project management for AI-native teams: worked with engineers who build with AI coding agents, and changed processes as those workflows evolved.
  • Uses AI in their own project management work every day: has built or set up AI agents, automations, or workflows for status reporting, risk detection, planning, or tracker hygiene, and can show concrete results.
  • Delivered under continuous shipping and technical uncertainty: R&D, ML/AI, infrastructure, or developer platforms with frequent releases and changing plans.
  • Technical foundation: a computer science or other technical degree, or 3+ years working as a software engineer. Comfortable reading code, PRs, and architecture docs.
  • Deep, hands-on use of engineering trackers such as Linear, Jira, and GitHub. You've designed a team's workflow, not only used one.
  • Clear, concise communication, written and spoken: you can explain status, risk, and trade-offs to engineers, executives, and funders.

Preferred

  • Experience working on a fully remote, distributed team.
  • Has mentored or managed other project or program managers, or helped hire them.
  • Experience with LLMs, AI evaluation, AI safety, or privacy-enhancing technologies.
  • Experience at an early-stage startup or research lab where you built the delivery process from scratch.
  • Experience managing grant-funded or partner-funded deliverables, such as reporting milestones to funders.
  • Experience coordinating with external partners on pilots or integrations (e.g., AI labs, research institutions, government).
  • Open-source project experience, as a contributor or as a project or release manager.

Compensation

  • Contract fee: $127,000 - $159,000 USD annualized, invoiced monthly.
  • Actual offers will be determined based on the candidate's skills, level of experience, and location.

Benefits

  • Mission-Driven Work: Be part of a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, focused on social impact rather than profit, offering the chance to make a meaningful difference in the world.
  • Open Source Contribution: Make a real impact by contributing to an Open Source project that benefits a broad community.
  • Collaborative Global Team: Join a dynamic, international team that values collaboration and diversity.
  • Flexible Work Hours: Enjoy the autonomy to structure your work hours around what best fits your life and productivity.
  • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely within the location requirements for this role.

jobs.description:
About OpenMined

OpenMined is a 501(c)(3) non-profit foundation that brings together leading minds in AI, security, and privacy technology to develop open-source solutions that transform how data can be accessed and shared. Founded in 2017, we've grown into a global community of over 18,000 members working to ensure that privacy protection and AI innovation reinforce each other rather than undermine one another. We are driven by a simple challenge: the most valuable data for solving humanity's greatest challenges remains locked away due to privacy concerns, and we can change that through technology rather than compromise.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own how OpenMined plans, tracks, and ships its most ambitious work. You'll work most closely with Ronnie Falcon, Chief Product Officer, and you'll be the person accountable for timelines, dependencies, and delivery across our product, engineering, research, and partnerships teams.

OpenMined runs several high-stakes efforts at once. ScreamingFace is an open-source toolkit for composing multiple LLMs into systems that beat any single frontier model, with a public leaderboard and a research fellowship. AI Oversight builds privacy-preserving infrastructure that lets AI labs, auditors, and safety institutes run evaluations without exposing models or data, with pilots alongside frontier labs. These efforts span multiple teams, tools, and funders, and they move fast under real research uncertainty.

Our product leads decide what to build, and our tech leads decide how it's built. You'll own when and in what order it gets delivered. That means turning goals into milestones with real dates, keeping roadmaps current rather than rewriting them once a year, and making our tools a source of truth people trust. It also means telling leadership early when a date is about to slip and what the options are.

This is a technical role. You'll work daily with engineers and researchers on distributed systems, LLM infrastructure, and privacy-enhancing technologies. You don't need to write production code, but you need to understand the work well enough to break it down, spot risk, and challenge an estimate.

We're an AI-native team. Our engineers ship with AI coding agents, our main codebase releases several times a week, and our tools and habits keep evolving as AI does. We're looking for a seasoned technical program manager who has built and run project management practices for teams like this. You'll bring years of hands-on experience, use AI to make planning, tracking, and reporting faster and lighter, and help OpenMined become a team that is excellent at project management, not one that depends on a single person to do it.

This is an independent contractor engagement, roughly a full-time commitment, with an initial 12-month term we expect to renew. You set your own schedule, but we need your working hours to overlap substantially with US Eastern business hours (your local time between one hour behind and two hours ahead of ET).

Responsibilities

  • Own delivery end to end for OpenMined's flagship initiatives (ScreamingFace and AI Oversight), from quarterly goals to milestones, dependencies, and release dates.
  • Design, run, and keep improving our project management practice for an AI-native team: planning, tracking, status reporting, and retros built around how engineers work with AI agents today, and updated as those tools change.
  • Build AI into how we manage projects: use and build AI agents and automations that draft status updates, summarize Linear, GitHub, and meeting activity, flag risks and stale work, and keep plans current with little manual upkeep.
  • Make the whole team better at project management: set standards and templates, coach product and engineering leads, and grow project management skills across the team, laying the groundwork for future project management hires.
  • Turn quarterly OKRs into dated, sequenced plans with product and engineering leads, and keep them current as research results and priorities shift.
  • Run a living product roadmap that is reviewed on a regular cadence and can feed grant proposals and funder reports without a last-minute rewrite.
  • Be the single accountable owner for cross-team dependencies when one initiative spans several boards, teams, or external partners, and chase down blockers yourself before they cause a slip.
  • Own our project management tooling (Linear for engineering, Asana for cross-functional work): set conventions, cut noise, and make sure status in the tools matches reality.
  • Connect code to plans: make sure work in GitHub links to Linear issues across all active repos, and keep PR review, release status, and repo ownership visible.
  • Track and report progress on milestones, cycle time, and OKR key results to leadership, and flag slipping dates early with clear trade-off options.
  • Coordinate external deliverables such as partner pilots, program launches (e.g., our research fellowship), and grant milestones, so commitments to partners and funders are met.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 7+ years of technical project or program management, delivering complex software with product and engineering teams. Transferable experience, such as a software engineering background, will also be considered.
  • Built or rebuilt a project management practice: set up planning cadences, tooling, and standards that a team kept using, earned buy-in through credibility rather than heavy process, and raised others' project management skills.
  • Has shaped project management for AI-native teams: worked with engineers who build with AI coding agents, and changed processes as those workflows evolved.
  • Uses AI in their own project management work every day: has built or set up AI agents, automations, or workflows for status reporting, risk detection, planning, or tracker hygiene, and can show concrete results.
  • Delivered under continuous shipping and technical uncertainty: R&D, ML/AI, infrastructure, or developer platforms with frequent releases and changing plans.
  • Technical foundation: a computer science or other technical degree, or 3+ years working as a software engineer. Comfortable reading code, PRs, and architecture docs.
  • Deep, hands-on use of engineering trackers such as Linear, Jira, and GitHub. You've designed a team's workflow, not only used one.
  • Clear, concise communication, written and spoken: you can explain status, risk, and trade-offs to engineers, executives, and funders.

Preferred

  • Experience working on a fully remote, distributed team.
  • Has mentored or managed other project or program managers, or helped hire them.
  • Experience with LLMs, AI evaluation, AI safety, or privacy-enhancing technologies.
  • Experience at an early-stage startup or research lab where you built the delivery process from scratch.
  • Experience managing grant-funded or partner-funded deliverables, such as reporting milestones to funders.
  • Experience coordinating with external partners on pilots or integrations (e.g., AI labs, research institutions, government).
  • Open-source project experience, as a contributor or as a project or release manager.

Compensation

  • Contract fee: $76,000 - $96,000 USD annualized, invoiced monthly.
  • Actual offers will be determined based on the candidate's skills, level of experience, and location.

  • Collaborative Global Team: Join a dynamic, international team that values collaboration and diversity.

AI is reshaping how Walmart builds technology, serves customers and associates, operates the business, and makes decisions. As Senior Director of Product Management for the Enterprise AI Platform, you will define the product vision, strategy, and execution for one of the foundational platforms powering Walmart’s AI transformation.

This role requires more than traditional product management. You will need to understand where AI technology is heading, determine which capabilities should become durable enterprise platform primitives, and translate rapidly changing technology into a coherent product strategy. You will work closely with senior engineering leaders, architects, AI teams, infrastructure teams, governance and security partners, and business leaders to make decisions spanning models, infrastructure, developer experience, safety, economics, and platform architecture.

The ideal leader combines strong product judgment, meaningful technical depth, deep understanding of the AI ecosystem, strategic thinking, storytelling, executive influence, financial discipline, and a bias for action. You will bring clarity to ambiguity, stay grounded in customer and engineering realities, raise the bar continuously, and operate with the ownership of an entrepreneur and the maturity of an enterprise leader.

What You’ll Do

  • Define the product vision and strategy: Establish the long-term direction for Walmart’s Enterprise AI Platform and translate Walmart’s AI ambitions into clear product priorities, platform capabilities, and investment decisions.
  • Build for the evolution of AI: Anticipate shifts across foundation models, multimodal AI, agents, inference technologies, orchestration, and AI infrastructure, and ensure the platform evolves ahead of enterprise demand.
  • Create durable platform abstractions: Determine where common capabilities should exist across models, providers, infrastructure, lifecycle management, governance, and developer workflows so teams can move faster while preserving flexibility and optionality.
  • Drive model and infrastructure optionality: Enable teams to use the right models and infrastructure based on capability, quality, performance, cost, availability, and risk while minimizing unnecessary provider or technology lock-in.
  • Create a world-class developer experience: Simplify how engineers, data scientists, and product teams discover AI capabilities, onboard, experiment, evaluate, deploy, observe, and operate AI workloads from development through production.
  • Make cost a first-class product consideration: Build platform capabilities and product mechanisms that help teams understand and optimize model consumption, infrastructure utilization, unit economics, capacity, and cost-performance tradeoffs.
  • Embed safety and governance into the platform: Partner with AI Governance, Security, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, and Risk teams to make enterprise controls, observability, and guardrails scalable and easy for engineering teams to adopt.
  • Make the safe path the easiest path: Create platform defaults and paved roads that improve speed, reliability, security, governance, and cost efficiency at the same time.
  • Own the AI ecosystem strategy: Continuously evaluate commercial models, open models, infrastructure providers, emerging AI technologies, and open-source ecosystems. Determine where Walmart should build, buy, partner, integrate, or standardize.
  • Separate durable trends from hype: Develop informed perspectives on emerging AI technologies and identify which changes materially affect Walmart’s platform strategy and which do not.
  • Understand customers deeply: Build strong relationships with engineering, product, data science, and business teams. Use customer feedback, product telemetry, adoption data, and direct engagement to identify friction and shape the roadmap.
  • Drive adoption through product value: Build a platform teams choose because it makes them faster and more effective. Identify barriers to adoption and systematically remove them.
  • Partner deeply with Engineering: Operate as a strategic counterpart to engineering leadership and engage credibly on architecture, APIs, inference, MLOps, orchestration, reliability, observability, capacity, and developer workflows.
  • Turn ambiguity into direction: Frame complex problems, establish principles, evaluate tradeoffs, make decisions with incomplete information, and move teams from ambiguity to execution.
  • Tell a compelling platform story: Translate complex technical concepts into clear narratives for engineers, product teams, senior executives, and business leaders, connecting platform investments to enterprise strategy and measurable outcomes.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly: Balance foundational investments, customer needs, technology evolution, reliability, technical debt, safety, cost, and strategic bets while keeping the organization focused on the areas of highest enterprise leverage.
  • Measure product outcomes: Establish metrics spanning adoption, onboarding, developer productivity, reliability, performance, utilization, cost efficiency, governance coverage, customer satisfaction, and business impact.
  • Lead across organizational boundaries: Align Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Governance, Security, Data, Finance, Procurement, and business teams around common priorities and decisions.
  • Build a high-performing product organization: Recruit and develop strong product leaders and create a culture of customer focus, technical curiosity, ownership, intellectual honesty, urgency, and high standards.

What You’ll Bring

  • Extensive product leadership experience building and scaling AI/ML platforms, developer platforms, cloud platforms, infrastructure products, or other highly technical enterprise platforms.
  • Demonstrated success defining platform strategy and translating it into roadmaps, technical capabilities, operating mechanisms, adoption, and measurable outcomes.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for actively practicing, US-licensed physicians (MD/DO) living outside the US, with an active, unrestricted US medical license, to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. On this project, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, apply to take part!

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for US-licensed physicians living outside the US who are looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around clinical practice. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This opportunity is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid ​

How to apply

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Project time expectations

You decide when and how much to contribute. For this project, tasks are estimated at around 10–20 hours per week during active phases. This is an estimate, not a minimum or a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks are submitted within the project timeline and need to meet the listed acceptance criteria to be approved.

Earnings

Earnings are per approved task, at a flat rate set to about $35/hr equivalent based on estimated task time. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the base rate. QA and adjudication tasks are paid at a higher rate.

And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team

Upstart’s Secured Lending organization is building the first-line risk and control infrastructure that will support the next stage of growth across home equity line of credit, auto direct, and auto indirect dealer products. The team helps ensure secured lending products operate with clear governance, durable controls, high-quality execution, and readiness for bank partner and regulatory review.

Asset Quality & Model Oversight is responsible for monitoring portfolio-wide trends across loan salability, asset quality, and model performance. This function looks across the portfolio over time — tracking performance against investor and bank partner thresholds, interpreting model execution patterns, identifying systemic risk, and escalating findings before they become repurchase events, partner concerns, or examination issues.

As the Senior Manager, Asset Quality & Model Oversight at Upstart, you will own this function end-to-end, reporting directly to the Head of Secured Lending. You will lead a small team of analysts and partner closely with Credit Risk, Capital Markets, Model Risk Management, Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Operations, and bank partners to establish the methodology, monitoring cadence, governance materials, and reporting routines that keep Upstart’s secured lending portfolio within risk appetite and exam-ready.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Lead the secured lending asset quality and loan salability function across home equity line of credit, auto direct, and auto indirect dealer channels, setting the review methodology, operating cadence, reporting standards, and escalation routines for a small team of asset quality analysts.
  • Monitor portfolio-level salability risk across secured lending channels — tracking eligibility adherence trends, defect patterns, collateral documentation quality, and exception concentrations; escalate repurchase and put-back risk to Capital Markets and bank partners before they affect loan sale execution or partner commitments.
  • Monitor asset quality and portfolio performance indicators tied to salability, including early payment defaults, delinquency, loss severity, prepayment, non-performing loan trends, exception patterns, and threshold breaches.
  • Evaluate origination and channel quality across secured lending programs, including collateral documentation completeness, lien perfection, override trends, pricing consistency, dealer or partner performance, concentration risk, and potential fair lending exposure.
  • Own first-line model implementation and performance oversight for secured lending models, including production model monitoring, threshold tracking, version control, use-case boundaries, model inventory updates, change impact assessment, and escalation of performance degradation or out-of-bounds behavior.
  • Translate loan review findings, portfolio trends, and model performance signals into action by identifying root causes, defining remediation plans, tracking issue closure, and escalating risks before they affect loan sale execution, partner commitments, or regulatory readiness.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in financial services risk management, compliance, credit operations, asset quality, model governance, or a related control function supporting secured or asset-backed consumer lending products.
  • Experience with loan-level quality review, loan salability oversight, investor delivery, repurchase or put-back risk, bank partner audits, collateral documentation review, or pre-sale quality control in a regulated lending environment.
  • Experience monitoring portfolio performance and asset quality indicators across multiple origination channels, including early payment default, delinquency, prepayment, loss severity, non-performing loan trends, credit policy exceptions, threshold breaches, or channel-level pricing and fair lending patterns.
  • Experience with first-line model oversight, production model monitoring, model implementation governance, model inventory documentation, or model performance escalation processes.
  • Experience leading analysts, managing a review function, or owning cross-functional risk, compliance, credit, asset quality, or operations programs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with auto indirect or dealer channel lending dynamics, including pricing discretion, dealer markup, and fair lending considerations relevant to indirect origination channels; ability to partner with fair lending oversight functions to interpret and escalate channel-level findings.
  • Knowledge of secured lending and secondary-market quality expectations, including exposure to first mortgage or asset-backed lending frameworks such as investor eligibility standards, collateral documentation, lien perfection, representations and warranties, defect remediation, trailing performance thresholds, and repurchase or make-whole risk.
  • Knowledge of consumer lending and fair lending requirements relevant to secured products, including Equal Credit Opportunity Act/Regulation B, Unfair, Deceptive, or Abusive Acts or Practices, Fair Credit Reporting Act, TILA/Regulation Z, dealer markup oversight, adverse action, or credit decisioning controls.
  • Ability to evaluate production model execution, validation outputs, fair lending review outputs, underwriting accuracy, pricing consistency, and performance trends against approved thresholds.
  • Skilled in producing exam-ready policy documents, governance materials, issue tracking, executive summaries, and bank partner reporting.
  • Risk or compliance certification, such as Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager, Financial Risk Manager, or equivalent credential.

Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range
$172,100—$238,300 USD

What you'll love

At Upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly
  • Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)

  • Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements

  • Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City

jobs.description:
About Kindsight:

Kindsight builds technology that helps fundraisers make a difference. For decades, Kindsight has supported the education, healthcare, and nonprofit sectors with fundraising tools and the largest charitable giving database on the market. And as the giving sector evolves, so does Kindsight. As the leader in fundraising intelligence, Kindsight leverages real-time data and AI to help thousands of organizations around the world identify, manage, and engage with donors - at any scale. With purpose-built CRMs that corral all of that donor information and campaign tracking into one place, donor prospect research tools that offer proactive insights and real-time donor intel, and generative AI that creates personalized, meaningful content drafts at scale, Kindsight’s product suite is truly changing the game for donor fundraising.

Position Summary:

Own the enablement program for the revenue team (sales, CS, and BDR). This role turns how the revenue team operates into repeatable, measurable practices. You will partner across Sales, CS, BDR, and RevOps to make sure the team is fluent in the tools and processes we depend on today, and continuously improving the ones that slow them down. New-hire enablement is a core part of the scope: getting every new revenue hire productive faster.

What You'll Own

  • Enablement on current processes and tools

  • Build and deliver training programs on our core tools: Salesforce, Gong, CPQ, and other systems in the daily workflow.

  • Design and maintain process documentation for the sales, CS, and BDR motions.

  • Run regular training refreshers, office hours, and Q&A sessions on tools, processes, and best practices.

  • Partner with Sales, CS, and BDR leadership on ongoing skills development, playbook adoption, and methodology consistency.

  • Own administration, content curation, and optimization of the LMS so the revenue team has seamless, on-demand access to high-impact training materials.

  • Process improvement for a more efficient org

  • Identify friction and inefficiencies in day-to-day revenue workflows through direct observation and feedback loops with the field.

  • Partner with RevOps and the systems team to translate process improvements into systems changes, and translate systems changes into training and adoption.

  • Measure the impact of enablement work: proficiency, time-to-productivity, and adoption of new processes.

  • Own the enablement content library: keep it current, discoverable, and actually used.

  • Playbooks, methodology, and ongoing skills

  • Develop and maintain sales playbooks: value messaging, discovery frameworks, objection handling, and competitive positioning.

  • Partner with revenue leadership to establish and refine the sales methodologies that best fit our team's motion.

  • Run evergreen skills programs across the revenue team: prospecting, discovery, negotiation, closing, and other core selling and CS skills.

  • Design and deliver product enablement refreshers so the team stays current on our offering and how to position it.

  • New-hire enablement

  • Design and run the onboarding program for new revenue hires across sales, CS, and BDR.

  • Build role-specific curricula, certification checkpoints, and clear graduation criteria.

  • Track ramp time and drive it down as programs mature.

  • Partner with hiring managers on ramp expectations and manager-led enablement handoffs.

What We're Looking For

  • 4 to 6 years in Sales Enablement, Revenue Enablement, or a related training/enablement role at a B2B SaaS company.

  • Track record of running structured onboarding programs and measuring ramp outcomes.

  • Strong facilitation and instructional design skills; can build effective training from a blank page.

  • Salesforce and Gong fluency at a user-training level; ability to become the deepest internal expert on how a rep should actually use these tools day-to-day.

  • Comfortable with CPQ processes, or willing to become expert quickly.

  • Ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, CS, BDR, RevOps, and Product.

  • Strong written and verbal communication; can turn a complex process into a clean playbook or short training video.

  • Data-informed: measures enablement work against business outcomes, not just training-completion counts.

  • Comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) to accelerate content creation, documentation, and program design.

  • Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with common sales methodologies (MEDDIC, Sandler, Command of the Message, or similar).

  • Experience with an LMS or enablement content platform (Highspot, Seismic, Mindtickle, LearnUpon, or similar).

  • Prior experience partnering with a RevOps or systems team on process changes.

  • Experience enabling both new-business motions and CS/renewal motions.

Compensation Range:$110,000-130,000 CAD OTE annually, based on experience, market benchmarks and role complexity. We aim to offer fair, competitive pay that reflects your skills and the market.

jobs.description:
Thank you for considering Tailscale. If this job description resonates with you, please apply. Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic!

About Tailscale

Tailscale is making safe connection effortless by delivering software that makes it easy to securely interconnect people and their devices, no matter where they are. From hobbyists to multinational corporations, teams of every size use Tailscale each day to protect their networks, share access to internal tools, and more. We're building a future for the Internet that's easy, sensible, and safe, like it used to be. Founded in 2019 and fully distributed, we're backed by Accel, CRV, Insight, Heavybit, and Uncork Capital.

About the Role

As we grow, integrations are becoming an increasingly important part of how customers build with Tailscale. We're looking for an Integration Partnerships Lead to help identify, develop, and launch the technical partnerships that extend our products and make Tailscale more valuable alongside the tools our customers already use.

This is a hands-on technical partnerships role at the intersection of Sales Engineering and Partner Development. You'll work directly with technology partners, customers, Product, and Engineering to identify integration opportunities, understand technical requirements, design solutions, establish the partnership, and help take integrations from concept through launch and adoption.

You'll initially focus on integrations across Aperture, Privileged Access Management (PAM), and VPN, working with partners across AI, security, identity, infrastructure, developer tools, and adjacent technologies.

We're looking for someone who can move comfortably between a technical architecture conversation and a commercial partnership discussion. You should be able to understand how two products work together, explain the customer value, navigate APIs and integration requirements, build relationships with technical and business stakeholders, and drive both organizations toward a successful launch.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and develop high-value technology and integration partnerships based on customer needs, product priorities, and market opportunities.
  • Own partner opportunities from initial outreach and technical discovery through solution design, commercial alignment, launch, and ongoing adoption.
  • Lead technical discovery with partners and customers to understand architectures, APIs, authentication, security requirements, data flows, and integration use cases.
  • Work closely with Product and Engineering to assess technical feasibility, define integration requirements, and determine the right implementation approach.
  • Build trusted relationships across partner Product, Engineering, Sales, and Business Development teams while serving as the primary point of contact at Tailscale.
  • Develop the technical and business case for integrations, including customer value, use cases, implementation requirements, and commercial opportunity.
  • Partner with Legal and Finance on agreements, pricing, packaging, licensing, and revenue-sharing structures where appropriate.
  • Collaborate with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Marketing, and Customer Success to launch integrations and drive customer and partner adoption.
  • Bring customer, partner, and market feedback back to Product and Engineering to help inform future integration priorities.
  • Help establish repeatable approaches for evaluating, building, launching, and scaling technology partnerships as the ecosystem grows.

What We Are Looking For

  • 7+ years of experience across Sales Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Technical Partnerships, Partner Engineering, Technology Alliances, Partner Sales, or technical Business Development in B2B software.
  • Strong technical fluency across APIs, authentication, cloud infrastructure, networking, security, developer platforms, or modern SaaS integrations.
  • Experience leading technical discovery and translating customer or partner requirements into practical integration solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to explain complex technical concepts to both engineering teams and business stakeholders.
  • Experience developing technology partnerships from initial opportunity through technical validation, commercial agreement, and launch.
  • Strong commercial instincts with experience identifying customer value, building business cases, negotiating, and navigating complex partner organizations.
  • Ability to influence Product and Engineering teams without formal authority while maintaining credibility with technical stakeholders.
  • Comfort operating independently in a fast-moving environment where the solution, partnership model, or playbook may not yet exist.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with developer infrastructure, networking, cybersecurity, identity, cloud infrastructure, AI/LLM platforms, or developer tools.
  • Experience working with APIs, SDKs, OAuth/OIDC, SSO, identity providers, webhooks, connectors, or other common integration patterns.
  • Experience in a product-led or developer-first company.
  • Experience with ISV, technology alliance, marketplace, OEM, or cloud partner ecosystems.
  • Experience working with both emerging technology companies and large enterprise partners.

Reporting Structure

This role reports to Kevin Kotecki, President and CRO, and will work closely with Avery Pennarun (Co-Founder & CEO), David Carney (Co-Founder & CSO), Product, Engineering, Sales, and Solutions Engineering to develop and launch Tailscale's most important technology integrations.

As a company, we strive to maintain fair and equitable compensation practices within our team across all roles and all levels. Tailscale's compensation package includes base salary, equity, and comprehensive benefits. The salary range displayed on each job posting represents the target range for a new hire's base salary. Individual offers may vary based on experience and skill set.

US Pay Range
$300,000—$300,000 USD

What We Offer

  • An inclusive, flexible environment where you can be your authentic self. We recognize the impact of diverse voices and backgrounds on the growth of our people, product, and company. And that flexibility in how and when you work empowers our team to integrate work and life.
  • A competitive total compensation package. This includes a base salary, an equity incentive plan and variable commission (for quota-based roles).
  • Comprehensive group benefits with no waiting period. Take advantage of coverage for health, vision, dental, and more for you and your family!
  • Remote first company—most of our teams work fully remotely. Enjoy a change of scenery wherever you can get wifi, participate in virtual and in-person social events, and leverage our corporate co-working program to visit WeWork (or other similar spaces near you). Some roles require in-office collaboration depending on team needs, which will be clearly noted in the job description.
  • Employer-funded retirement contributions. Tailscale will match your retirement contributions dollar-for-dollar, up to a maximum annual employer contribution equal to 0.75% of your eligible compensation.
  • Connect with other Tailscalars IRL. Attend our annual company retreat, participate in team off-sites, and collaborate in person with teammates across Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, and Singapore. We support intentional in-person connection through team travel and distributed collaboration.
  • Support for your personal and professional development. Grow your career thoughtfully with $1500 USD annually for professional development, or take advantage of mentorship, coaching, and internal promotion opportunities.
  • Paid time off and a healthy work-life integration. Our flexible, paid time off program supports you for any situation life throws your way, whether moving homes or travelling the world!
  • A build-your-own home office setup. You choose your own company-owned laptop (Mac or PC), receive a monthly home internet reimbursement, and $500 USD to customize your workstation to make it your own.
  • Paid parental leave program. We care about your life outside of work and encourage new parents to take advantage of parental leave top-ups (20 weeks for birthing parents, 16 weeks for non-birthing parents).

jobs.description:
Director, Global Regulatory & Compliance Operations

Company: Irth, LLC
Location: Columbus, OH (Hybrid) or Remote – US
Employment Type: Full-time, Exempt
Reports To: Chief Financial Officer / Chief Operating Officer / General Counsel

About Irth

Irth provides SaaS solutions that help utilities, pipelines, telecommunications providers, and other critical infrastructure operators protect their assets, manage risk, and improve field operations.

Serving customers across North America and internationally, Irth has teams in the United States, Canada, and India. Our technology supports organizations operating in highly regulated environments where security, reliability, compliance, and operational excellence are essential.

Position Summary

Irth is seeking a strategic and hands-on Director, Global Regulatory & Compliance Operations to build, lead, and continuously improve the company's enterprise-wide compliance program.

This role will oversee regulatory and corporate compliance across all jurisdictions in which Irth operates or serves customers. Key areas of responsibility include corporate and entity governance, data privacy, anti-corruption and ethics, AI governance, information security compliance frameworks, and customer contractual compliance obligations.

The Director will translate complex regulatory requirements into practical, scalable policies, processes, controls, and reporting mechanisms that support business growth while managing enterprise risk.

This position will work cross-functionally with Finance, Legal, IT/Security, Product, Engineering, Human Resources, and Commercial teams and serve as Irth's central point of accountability for global compliance readiness.

Key Responsibilities

1. Enterprise Compliance Program Leadership

  • Design, implement, and manage a global enterprise compliance framework, including policies, procedures, internal controls, risk assessments, monitoring, and reporting.
  • Maintain an enterprise-wide regulatory obligations register and compliance calendar covering the United States, Canada, India, and other applicable jurisdictions.
  • Establish compliance metrics

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Law, Finance, Information Management, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in regulatory compliance, risk management, corporate governance, or a related discipline, including at least 3 years in a leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multi-jurisdictional compliance programs, ideally covering North America and India.
  • Working knowledge of global data privacy laws and regulations, including GDPR, PIPEDA, Quebec Law 25, and applicable US state privacy laws.
  • Knowledge of anti-bribery and anti-corruption (ABAC/FCPA) requirements and corporate entity governance.
  • Experience owning or leading SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar compliance audits and attestations.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to establish, implement, and scale compliance processes and programs from the ground up.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence executive leadership and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor (JD) or relevant professional certifications, such as CIPP/CIPM, CCEP, CRCM, or CISA.
  • Experience working in a SaaS or technology company, preferably within a private equity-backed or high-growth environment.
  • Familiarity with AI governance frameworks and emerging regulatory requirements, including NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF), ISO 42001, and the EU AI Act.
  • Exposure to regulatory environments involving utilities, energy, pipelines, telecommunications, or other critical infrastructure industries.
  • Experience implementing or administering governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) platforms, such as Vanta, Drata, or OneTrust.

What Success Looks Like – First 12 Months

Within the first 12 months, the Director, Global Regulatory & Compliance Operations will have:

  • Global Compliance Infrastructure: Established and implemented a comprehensive global regulatory obligations register and compliance calendar covering all applicable jurisdictions, with no missed statutory or regulatory filings.
  • Privacy and AI Governance: Documented and operationalized enterprise privacy and AI governance programs, including policies, procedures, ownership, and appropriate controls.
  • Compliance Training: Achieved 100% completion of required compliance training across all regions and employee populations.
  • Customer Compliance Readiness: Established a standardized, repeatable process for responding to customer security assessments, compliance questionnaires, RFPs, and contractual compliance requirements.
  • Security Framework Ownership: Established Compliance as the accountable owner of SOC 2 and other applicable security compliance frameworks and attestations, with clear coordination and evidence handoffs from IT/Security, clean audit results, and no control gaps attributable to breakdowns in ownership or coordination.
  • Executive Reporting: Implemented regular compliance risk reporting to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT), providing visibility into regulatory developments, enterprise compliance status, control effectiveness, and remediation progress.

AI Use in Hiring

As part of our hiring process, this role may use artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist in reviewing and screening applications. These tools support, but do not replace, human judgment in hiring decisions.

Role Type

This is a New position.

Compensation

The salary range for this role is USD $ 175K. This range reflects the base salary only and does not include any other compensation components like OTE. Any offers made are dependent on factors including and not limited to experience, skills, and location.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Join a dynamic, growing company with a strong reputation in its industry.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Comprehensive health plan options, including medical, dental, and vision coverage.
  • 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Flexible PTO policy plus company-paid holidays.
  • Additional benefits, including life insurance, pet insurance, and employee discounts and perks programs.
  • Generous one-time work-from-home stipend to help you set up your home workspace.
  • Company events and opportunities to connect, including monthly team lunches, volunteer outings, and quarterly gatherings.
  • Hybrid employees have access to complimentary snacks, beverages, and coffee at our Columbus, Ohio office.

Health care is constantly changing, and at Banner Health, we are at the front of that change. We are leading health care to make the experience the best it can be. We want to change the lives of those in our care – and the people who choose to take on this challenge. If changing health care for the better sounds like something you want to be part of, we want to hear from you.


Banner is seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Referral Specialist . This role focuses on supporting Banner-ordered referrals while leveraging extensive knowledge of Cerner's referral management tool and a strong understanding of insurance requirements and authorization processes.


Duties: You will support Banner ordered referrals.

Location: REMOTE

Hours: Monday – Friday 8am-5pm

Training: Training and ongoing support will be provided by peers in a similar position

Within Banner Health Corporate, you will have the opportunity to apply your unique experience and expertise in support of a nationally-recognized healthcare leader. We offer stimulating and rewarding careers in a wide array of disciplines. Whether your background is in Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Managed Care Programs or Public Relations, you'll find many options for contributing to our award-winning patient care.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position is responsible for coordinating referral orders for a continuation of treatment, such as specialty services and diagnostic testing within a primary care practice. This position provides all pertinent clinical information needed for the payor authorization and the facility or specialist prior to the services being rendered. The position is responsible for tracking and managing all referrals with the intention and outcome to close any patient care gaps, along with providing documentation to promote team awareness.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Schedules appointments for specialty physician services and diagnostic testing per provider request and communicates with the patient on a timely basis for all scheduling requirements

2. Acts as a liaison between patients, providers and staff members for patients’ referral and follow up needs. Provides prompt and professional service for the patients by assisting in educating patient/family and assisting patients with external resources when needed.

3. Provides all pertinent clinical information needed for the payor authorization, the facility or specialist prior to the services being rendered by verifying coverage, obtaining authorization and communicating with receiving facilities

4. Tracks and manages all referrals by monitoring outstanding referrals at 30/60/90 day intervals and following up with patients if appointments are not kept

5. Applies knowledge of medical terminology and maintains up to date knowledge of insurance environment. Utilizes internal and external resources to seek knowledge about regulations regarding various payor sources

6. Collaborates with outside referral sources and other community resources. Maintains an updated list of community resources and networks with colleagues to develop additional referral sources

7. This position has frequent communications with patients, physicians, staff, and third party payers. The position must work with and understand the concepts of managed health care and be able to prioritize tasks within established guidelines with moderate supervision



MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

High school diploma/GED or equivalent working knowledge.

Possesses 1 year of direct patient interaction/experience in a medical, insurance, or healthcare related industry.


Knowledge of HIPAA regulations. Strong customer service focus and willingness to problem solve. Effective verbal and written communication skills and the ability to manage competing priorities. Must be proficient with commonly used office software.


PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Previous knowledge of managed care concepts. Working knowledge of medical terminology and ICD-9 and CPT codes.

Additional related education and/or experience preferred.



Estimated Pay Range:
