jobs.title: Senior Vice President, Managed Services (Remote US)
jobs.excerpt: Atmosera empowers businesses to redefine what's possible with modern technology and human expertise.
jobs.description:
Atmosera empowers businesses to redefine what's possible with modern technology and human expertise. Our exceptional experience across Applications, Data & AI, DevOps, Security, and the Microsoft Azure platform enables organizations to accelerate innovation, enhance security, and optimize operational agility. As a Microsoft Partner with seven specializations, GitHub AI Partner of the Year, a member of the GitHub Advisory Board, and a member of the prestigious Microsoft Intelligent Security Association (MISA), Atmosera expertly delivers cutting-edge, integrated solutions that deliver business value.
Atmosera is a private equity-backed Microsoft partner focused on Azure, with roughly 200 people across the U.S. and LATAM. We are growing our direct go-to-market, investing in commercial leadership, and sharpening how we operate.

The Role

    You own Atmosera's managed services business, built on recurring revenue and long-term client relationships, and report directly to the CEO. This is a P&L role, not a service delivery role: you own monthly recurring revenue, net revenue retention, gross margin, and the client relationships that produce them, building on a strong operational foundation to lead the commercial direction of the business.

    This role is fully remote within the U.S., with travel for client visits, leadership meetings, and other business needs.

    What You Will Lead

    Three functional leaders report to you. You will partner with them to grow the business and develop the team.

    • Service Operations: The 24x7 delivery engine for managed Azure environments.

    • Client Success: Account health, renewals, and expansion across the managed client base.

    How You Will Partner

    • Executive peers: The SVP, Professional Services Delivery, the SVP, Technology, and the Chief Revenue Officer.

    • Security: The CISO sets security standards and audits against them. Your organization is accountable for meeting those standards.

    • Product: Product, including AMP (the platform our managed services run on), sits in the Technology organization, and Managed Services is its primary internal client. You define service requirements, set roadmap priorities with Product, and approve new capabilities before they reach clients.

Your Impact

    Commercial direction: Set the growth strategy for managed services and, with the CRO, protect margin and cost to serve as the business scales.

    Client journey and experience: Own the managed client's experience from onboarding through renewal and expansion, including a clean handoff from Professional Services projects.

    Retention and expansion: Own key client relationships and difficult service conversations, and build Client Success into a source of expansion revenue as well as retention.

    Operational and security standards: Ensure reliable delivery that meets the CISO's standards.

    AI-enabled operations: Use automation, AI, and the AMP roadmap to improve margin, service quality, and the client experience.

    People leadership: Lead, develop, and retain a leadership team across the U.S. and LATAM.

The Judgement This Role Requires

    This role calls for sound judgment where there is no playbook. Examples of decisions you will own:

  • Client recovery: A key client has had a difficult quarter. You weigh credits, a contract change, or holding the line against renewal, margin, and precedent.

    • Deal margin: A deal is taking shape on terms that miss target margin. You work with the CRO on a structure that wins the deal and protects the business.

    • Out-of-scope requests: A client asks for meaningful out-of-scope work. Sometimes the right answer is yes, at no charge; knowing when is part of the job.

    • Client audits: An enterprise client's auditorsare reviewing our controls. You represent the company in the room.

    • Delivery model: We deliver from teams in the U.S. and LATAM. When clients have questions about how and where their work is done, you lead those conversations.

What Success Looks Like

    We measure success by results and alignment. Here is how we define a win for this role over the first year:

    After 90 Days

    The Foundation: Understand the client portfolio, renewal base, service economics, operational and security performance, and talent. Set the net revenue retention baseline within 60 days.

    The Integration: Build trusted relationships with the CEO, your leadership team, peers, the CISO, and Finance, with shared clarity on decision rights, handoffs, and escalation paths.

    The Contribution: Put visibility in place across recurring revenue, retention, margin, client health, and security standards, with plans in motion for at-risk accounts.

    After 1 Year

    Your Impact: Net revenue retention has improved against your 60-day baseline, managed gross margin has held or improved, and client retention is at or above target. Client Success contributes expansion revenue, and Security Operations meets the CISO's standards on patching, remediation, and access reviews, with clean client audits.

    Your Growth: Your leadership team is growing in scope, with clear development paths and succession across the U.S. and LATAM.

    Your Influence: AMP roadmap priorities are set with Product around Managed Services requirements for margin and client value, and Managed Services is recognized by clients, employees, and Microsoft for client value and commercial discipline.

The Skill Matrix

    Required Skills (The Non-Negotiables)

    P&L Ownership: P&L ownership of a managed services, hosting, or IT services business of $15M or more, with direct accountability for recurring revenue retention and gross margin.

    Client Leadership: Executive-level ownership of enterprise client relationships, including renewals and difficult service conversations, and a record of improving the client experience across the full lifecycle.

    Change Leadership: Leading an organization through significant change, such as an integration, a platform migration, or a new delivery model.

    People Leadership: A strong record of building, developing, and retaining leadership teams.

    Cloud Managed Services: Fluency in cloud managed services; Azure strongly preferred.

    Communication: Executive-level communication, including the judgment to surface difficult issues early and build confidence without overpromising.

How We Show Up

    These 'Core Three' represent the heartbeat of Atmosera. They are the behaviors and attributes we align to every day, defining how we interact, solve problems, and celebrate our wins together. This is simply who we are at our best. For our leaders, that means candid debate, shared ownership of outcomes, and close partnership with the CEO and peers.

    Humble (Low Ego, High Impact): We share credit easily, admit when we are wrong, seek the strongest answer rather than personal recognition, and treat feedback and mistakes as data for growth.

    Hungry (Internal Drive): We hold a high standard, look for the next opportunity to improve performance and client value, and take action to build something better than what exists today.

    Mindful (Intentional Awareness): We are conscious of our impact on people and the business. We listen carefully, consider second-order effects, distinguish urgency from importance, and respond with empathy and situational awareness.

Our Interview Process

    We value your time and aim for transparency. The process may vary slightly, but candidates can typically expect:

    Talent Screen (30 minutes): A conversation about your background, the scope of the P&L and organizations you have led, and the mission of the role.

    Impact & Attributes Assessment (60 minutes w/ CEO): A discussion focused on leadership approach, change leadership, trust, accountability, and alignment with Humble, Hungry, and Mindful behaviors.

    Collaborator Loop (60 minutes w/ Internal Stakeholders & Peers): Conversations with key partners focused on managed services economics, client relationships, commercial trade-offs, and cross-functional partnership. A presentation or work sample may be included if communicated in advance.

    Final Alignment (Onsite Interview in Portland w/ Executive Leadership): A closing conversation with executive leadership regarding role expectations, mutual alignment, and next steps.

We value our employees and are committed to providing a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support your well-being and financial security. Here's what you can look forward to:

Financial Security & Growth:

About the Company

At Rezilient, we’re redefining what primary care looks like, making it more accessible, seamless, and patient-centered than ever before. Through our innovative CloudClinic model, we combine virtual provider visits with smart, tech-enabled infrastructure to deliver timely, personalized care. By removing traditional barriers to access and continuously expanding our specialty offerings, we’re building a healthcare experience that’s as convenient as it is comprehensive.

About the Role

Rezilient is seeking a Senior Security Engineer to serve as a hands-on, senior individual contributor supporting our information security programs. This role is responsible for protecting the systems, data, and infrastructure that power Rezilient’s CloudClinic model, with a particular focus on safeguarding protected health information (PHI) and personally identifiable information (PII) across our cloud platform, clinical environments, and corporate systems.

You will design, build, and operate the technical security controls that keep Rezilient secure, from cloud and application security to identity and access management, endpoint protection, detection, and incident response. Working closely with Engineering, Product, IT, Clinical Operations, and our Security & Compliance team, you will embed security into how we build and run our platform, and provide the technical evidence and expertise that support frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA/HITECH, and HITRUST.

This is a senior IC role for an engineer who can move comfortably between architecture and execution. The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise, sound judgment, and the ability to translate security needs into practical solutions that enable a fast-moving healthcare technology company to grow safely.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud & Infrastructure Security

  • Design, implement, and maintain security controls across Rezilient’s cloud infrastructure, including network security, encryption, secrets management, logging, and configuration hardening.
  • Build and manage security guardrails using infrastructure as code, cloud-native security tools, and automated policy enforcement.
  • Continuously assess cloud environments for misconfigurations, excessive permissions, and exposure risks, and drive remediation with Engineering.
  • Ensure PHI and PII are protected at rest and in transit, with appropriate data classification, access restrictions, and retention controls.

Application & Product Security

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to embed security into the software development lifecycle, from design through release.
  • Lead threat modeling and security design reviews for new features, integrations, infrastructure, and architecture decisions.
  • Own application security tooling and processes, including static and dynamic analysis, dependency and container scanning, and secure code review.
  • Establish secure development standards and coach engineers on secure coding practices and common vulnerability classes.
  • Assess the security of third-party integrations, APIs, and EHR and partner data exchanges that handle patient data.

Identity, Access & Endpoint Security

  • Partner with IT to design and enforce identity and access management controls, including SSO, MFA, role-based access, least privilege, and access reviews.

Detection, Response & Vulnerability Management

  • Build and tune security monitoring, logging, and alerting to detect suspicious activity across cloud, application, identity, and endpoint layers.
  • Serve as a technical lead during security incidents, coordinating investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
  • Develop and maintain incident response runbooks and lead tabletop exercises with cross-functional teams.
  • Own the vulnerability management program, including scanning, prioritization, remediation tracking, and coordination of penetration tests.
  • Monitor the threat landscape relevant to healthcare and cloud environments and proactively adapt defenses.

Security Governance & Compliance Support

  • Produce evidence for technical controls for SOC 2, HIPAA/HITECH, HITRUST, and related frameworks.
  • Support audits, risk assessments, and remediation efforts with technical expertise, documentation, and control testing.
  • Contribute to security policies, standards, and procedures, ensuring they are technically sound and practical to operate.

Technical Leadership & Security Culture

  • Act as a trusted security advisor to Engineering, Product, IT, and leadership, translating technical risk into clear business impact and recommendations.
  • Automate security processes and reduce manual work through scripting, tooling, and integration.
  • Contribute to security awareness efforts with practical, role-specific guidance for engineers and staff.
  • Help shape the long-term information security roadmap and mentor team members as the security function grows.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in information security, security engineering, or a closely related technical role, ideally in healthcare, digital health, or SaaS/cloud environments.
  • Deep hands-on experience securing AWS cloud environments, including IAM, networking, encryption, logging, and cloud-native security services.
  • Strong background in application security, including threat modeling, secure code review, and security testing tools within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with identity and access management, endpoint security, and security monitoring or SIEM tools.
  • Proven experience leading or supporting incident response and vulnerability management programs.
  • Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA/HITECH, HITRUST, ISO 27001/27002, or NIST CSF, and experience providing technical evidence for audits.
  • Proficiency in scripting or programming (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) and experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform).
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical risks to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfort operating as a senior individual contributor in a fast-moving startup environment with broad ownership.
  • Experience protecting PHI or other regulated data is strongly preferred.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, GIAC (e.g., GCIH, GCLD, GWAPT), or cloud security certifications are a plus.

Benefits

At Rezilient Health, we're on a mission to make humane healthcare truly abundant, and we invest in the people who make that possible. This is a high-impact role where your ideas directly shape how care is delivered, within a supportive, collaborative, and diverse team that believes healthcare is fundamentally a human experience. We back that commitment with a robust total rewards package:

  • Meaningful ownership through stock options, allowing you to share directly in the value you help create as we grow
  • Competitive base compensation
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage options, with Rezilient contributing toward your premiums
  • Complimentary access to Rezilient's clinical programs for you and your household members, the same connected care we deliver to our patients
  • 401(k) retirement plan to support your long-term financial well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off, so you can recharge without counting days
  • Dedicated Paid Sick Leave, separate from your FTO, for when health needs come first
  • 11 paid company holidays each year
  • Paid family leave to support you through life's biggest moments
  • Optional ancillary benefits, including life insurance, disability coverage, and a Health Savings Account (HSA)

jobs.description:
We are hiring for two roles. Apply for the role that matches your experience.
  • Customer Outcomes & Advice Quality Assessor: £35,000. Reports to the Senior Customer Outcomes & Advice Quality Assessor.
  • Senior Customer Outcomes & Advice Quality Assessor: £40,000. Reports to the Operational Compliance Manager.
Location: Fully remote
Hours: 39 hours per week, Monday to Friday. Flexible hours contract.

Our Mission

At Mojo Mortgages, we’re on a mission to become the largest and most disruptive mortgage broker in the UK. We’re a fast-moving, ever-evolving fintech. We’ll get there by transforming the mortgage journey so everyone can approach it with confidence. Change is constant here, and so is our drive to work smarter, think bigger and raise the bar.
Quality assurance is central to that mission. By holding our advice to the highest standards, we build lasting trust with our customers. We make sure our advice is always clear, accurate and in their best interest. This is a place for people who embrace challenge, hold themselves to a high standard and use technology to do their work better. We celebrate those who bring passion, accountability and fresh ideas.
At the heart of everything we do are our behaviours: care personally, challenge directly, put people first, keep exploring, love what you do, and always be accountable. If that sounds like you, we want you on the journey with us.

The Roles

Both roles assess mortgage advice and listen to calls. The Senior role does that and also leads the team.
Every individual case assessment is made by an assessor using their own judgement. You will work in a small, dedicated team where your eye for detail and analytical skills are central to the integrity of our mortgage advice. Your assessments give us confidence that customers receive clear, accurate advice. Your insight helps us keep raising the standard.

Key Responsibilities

What Both Roles Do
  • Assess advice. Assess mortgage advice against our internal standards, the FCA Consumer Duty and the Conduct Rules, meeting the T&C Scheme sampling requirements. Listen to calls as part of every assessment.
  • Own your output. Complete your agreed monthly volume to the quality and turnaround standards set by the Operational Compliance Manager. Flag risks early.
  • Give clear feedback. Record every outcome with specific, evidence-based feedback that Mortgage Experts and Sales Managers can act on without re-listening or re-working the case.
  • Stand behind your decisions. Apply the scoring criteria consistently. Explain your reasoning in calibration and defend your decisions on appeal.
  • Drive improvement. Escalate compliance risks promptly, find the root causes, and highlight routine checks that could be automated.

How the Two Roles Differ

Customer Outcomes & Advice Quality Assessor (£35,000)
  • No line management. You focus on your own assessments.
  • Review ID&V referrals. Review Smartsearch referrals, decide what additional verification checks are needed, and escalate any PEP or sanctions list matches to Risk & Compliance.
Senior Customer Outcomes & Advice Quality Assessor (£40,000)
  • Line manage four QA assessors. Set objectives, track the team’s output against the monthly requirement, and raise people concerns with the Operational Compliance Manager and HR.
  • Spend about 70% of your time assessing, including the most complex and highest-risk cases.
  • Lead calibration and coach assessors. Make clear, defensible scoring decisions. Coach through feedback, side-by-side reviews and “check the checker” assessments.
  • Manage the appeals process. Appeals are decided by someone other than the original assessor, so the Operational Compliance Manager or another senior assessor decides any appeal against your own assessments.
  • Produce monthly MI. Analyse failure trends and recommend action.
  • Set the risk-based case selection approach. Prioritise high-risk cases and cover all advice areas in line with the T&C framework.
  • Support T&C oversight. Help the Operational Compliance Manager maintain the Adviser Competence framework and RAG status records, and advise where our QA framework needs to change.
  • Be the voice of QA. Represent QA with Operations, Sales and Risk & Compliance, and help shape tooling, process and the T&C Scheme.

Who We’re Looking For

You embody our behaviours. You are meticulous, self-driven and confident in your own judgement. You give direct feedback that builds trust between QA, Mortgage Experts and Sales Managers, and you work at pace without letting accuracy slip. For the Senior role, you are also a fair, supportive line manager who brings others with you.

Qualifications (both roles)
  • CeMAP 1, 2 & 3 or equivalent.
  • Hold, or be able to obtain, the competence status needed to assess advice and sign off assessments under our T&C Scheme.
Experience
  • Customer Outcomes & Advice Quality Assessor: A minimum of 2 years’ experience as a QA assessor in financial services, ideally in mortgage advice, with a track record of meeting volume and quality expectations.
  • Senior Customer Outcomes & Advice Quality Assessor: We would expect 3+ years as a QA assessor or QA lead in UK mortgage advice, or equivalent experience gained at Mojo. This must include line managing a team, leading calibration, handling appeals and coaching others.
Skills (both roles)
  • Sound knowledge of FCA mortgage advice requirements, with the confidence to explain and defend scoring decisions on complex cases.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under pressure.
  • Experience of, or appetite to learn, AI and automated tools, with the judgement to test their outputs.
  • Comfortable with change.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Google Sheets, Docs and Slides.
Additional skills (Senior role)
  • Expert FCA knowledge, including T&C, high-risk cases, vulnerable customers and conduct breach investigations.
  • Strong analytical skills and the credibility to influence stakeholders at all levels of seniority.

Benefits

  • Remote working
  • Basic Salary of up to £40k
  • Work from anywhere in the world for up to 22 days per year
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays (up to 28 days with length of service)
  • Pension via Aviva (Pension match up to 5%)
  • Sick pay and sick pay insurance
  • Wellness programme from Able Futures
  • Critical Illness cover & Subsidised private medical insurance
  • Death in service Policy
  • Enhanced Maternity, primary adoption & Enhanced paternity & secondary adoption pay
  • Compassionate leave
  • Long service awards up to £5000

jobs.excerpt: About Ajaia Ajaia is an AI implementation consultancy and product studio.
jobs.description:
About Ajaia
Ajaia is an AI implementation consultancy and product studio. We help organizations move from AI experimentation to measurable return on investment across four practices: AI Strategy and Advisory, Workforce Training and Enablement, Process Optimization, and Custom AI Development. Our work sits with executives and the people who do the actual work, and it is judged on whether something changed in production, not on whether a pilot looked good in a deck.

Position Overview
Ajaia is hiring a Digital Product Designer to run discovery and design on client engagements and on Ajaia’s own product suite. You will talk to the people who actually do the work, watch what they do rather than only what they say, and turn that into journeys, wireframes, and prototypes an engineer can build from. You will test the design against real users before a line of production code is written, and you will hold the standard for how everything Ajaia ships looks and behaves.

This is a hands-on seat: you do the research and the design yourself, rather than handing off between the two.

This is a fully remote role. Discovery, user testing, and collaboration with clients and engineers all happen online.

Compensation: $10,000 to $14,000 base, depending on experience, plus a performance bonus of up to 100% of base salary.

How we expect you to work
AI use is a core execution requirement at Ajaia, not optional tooling. You will use AI tools daily to move from interview notes to synthesis, from synthesis to wireframe, and from wireframe to something clickable. You are judged on what you keep from that process, not on how much of it AI produced.

Staying current with new design and prototyping tools is part of the job, and so is knowing when a shortcut needs your hand back on it before a user ever sees it.

What you will do

  • Run discovery on client engagements: interview the people doing the work, watch them do it over screen-share, and find the gap between what they say and what they actually do.
  • Talk to users of Ajaia’s own products the same way. The product suite is not exempt from the same rigor client work gets.
  • Synthesize findings into what people actually need, stated separately from what they asked for, with the evidence for each.
  • Design the solution: user journeys, wireframes, and prototypes that an engineer can build from without guessing.
  • Decide where a human has to sign off inside a workflow, and design that checkpoint into the product rather than bolting it on afterward.
  • Test designs with real users before code exists, not after.
  • Push back on a stakeholder’s feature list when the evidence points somewhere else, and explain why in terms they can act on.
  • Own the design standard across Ajaia’s product suite so a designer joining engagement three does not have to reinvent decisions made on engagement one.
  • Prototype with AI tools as a default, not a novelty. Know when the AI-native path saves real time and when it produces something you have to rebuild by hand anyway.
  • Hand off design work in a state an engineer can actually start from, and stay involved enough during the build to catch it when implementation drifts from the intent.

Requirements

  • Runs discovery yourself: interviews, usability testing, and reading behavioral data.
  • Moves from synthesis to a working prototype fast.
  • Designs the human checkpoints into a workflow rather than bolting them on later.
  • Comfortable holding your ground when the evidence points somewhere a stakeholder does not expect.
  • AI fluent: uses AI daily to research, synthesize, and prototype, and can tell good output from slop.
  • Comfortable working directly alongside engineers through build.
  • No minimum years required. We hire on the work.
  • Fully remote, and comfortable running interviews and user testing over video.
  • A bachelor’s degree is preferred and is not a requirement.

Nice to have

  • A public portfolio or case studies we can look at before we meet.
  • Experience designing AI-native workflows, including where a human checkpoint belongs.
  • Consulting, agency, or professional services experience with concurrent clients.
  • Comfort with lightweight front-end implementation.

Benefits

Competitive benefits.

  • Consolidate supplier spend and implement purchasing strategies such as blanket orders, long-term agreements, kanban, and vendor-managed inventory.
  • Negotiate supplier pricing, lead times, payment terms, capacity commitments, and commercial and contractual terms.
  • Manage supplier contracts, renewals, compliance, pricing changes, and long-term agreements.
  • Identify, qualify, and onboard suppliers in partnership with Quality and Engineering.
  • Monitor supplier delivery, quality, cost, and commercial performance and drive corrective actions when necessary.
  • Develop supply chain risk mitigation plans addressing single-source suppliers, long-lead components, supplier financial health, and geographic concentration.
  • Own procurement cost performance and track negotiated, consolidation, and supplier requalification savings.
  • Establish and report procurement and supplier performance metrics, including on-time delivery, quality, savings, buyer productivity, and supplier qualification timelines.

  • Strong contract negotiation experience covering pricing, lead times, capacity commitments, and commercial terms.
  • Working knowledge of regulated quality systems, such as ISO 13485 or FDA 21 CFR Part 820.

jobs.description:
This role is part of our Central M&A Team at saas.group.

What is saas.group?

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella.Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.

Profile Overview

Our Investment Team deploys $50M+ of capital a year into niche, bootstrapped PLG software companies across North America and Western Europe. These are capital-efficient, founder-built businesses that most funds overlook because they are too small, too founder-owned or too unconventional. We see the opportunity, and we operate what we buy.

We're hiring an Associate Director, Investments to sit in the principal seat. You'll report to our Head of M&A, work alongside an existing Associate Director and have significant exposure to our C-suite. As deal captain, you qualify the opportunity, make the first offer, build the investment case, set the price, negotiate with the founder, run diligence and take the deal to close. You won't be building pitch books or playing a supporting role, and you won't wait years to lead a deal of your own. Your judgement decides where our capital goes.

If you bring the commercial diligence skills or deal instincts of a lower mid-market PE or M&A team, and you want to own outcomes rather than advise on them, this is your role. You'll work directly with founders, our C-suite and the operators who scale the businesses you buy.

Your impact in the first 6-12 months will be:

  • Own early-stage qualification: take new opportunities from first call to a non-binding offer quickly, kill weak ones early and turn the strongest into IC-ready investment cases.
  • Earn the trust of founders, our C-suite and the operating teams who will run the businesses you buy.
  • Step in as deal captain on your first live transactions and drive them from LOI to signed SPA.

Your responsibilities

  • Capital allocation: Underwrite every deal you lead. Form a clear view on value, risk and returns, write the investment memo and defend your recommendation in front of our Investment Committee.
  • Qualification and offers: Qualify new opportunities fast, kill weak ones early and issue non-binding offers on the ones worth pursuing. You set the price and structure that frame the deal all the way to LOI.
  • Deal captaincy: Own the process end to end, from first call and non-binding offer through LOI, diligence and SPA to closing. You set the timeline, run the workstreams and own the outcome.
  • Commercial due diligence: Lead our in-house CDD. Size the market, map the competition, define the right to win and get to the truth on quality of revenue: retention, concentration, pricing power and the durability of growth.
  • Financial and commercial modelling: Build models from a blank sheet: ARR bridges, cohort and retention analysis, unit economics, scenarios, valuation and returns.
  • Negotiation: Lead negotiations with founders and their advisors on price, structure and key terms, landing deals that work for the seller and for our returns.
  • Diligence leadership: Run the full DD process across internal experts (finance, tech, product, marketing, legal, people) and external legal, financial and tax advisors, and turn their findings into decisions.
  • Stakeholder leadership: Represent saas.group to sellers, brokers and advisors, and work hand in hand with our C-suite, leadership and the operators who take over after closing.
  • Coaching: Develop the junior members of the team as a hands-on player-coach.

What You bring to the table

  • 6+ years of professional experience after university, with a strong track record in transactions, strategy or both.
  • Training at a top-tier firm or team in one or more of:
    • Private equity: lower mid-market transactions, typically sub-$10M EBITDA, ideally in software or tech-enabled services.
    • Strategy consulting: MBB (McKinsey, BCG, Bain) or leading strategy firms such as Roland Berger, Oliver Wyman, Kearney, L.E.K. Consulting, OC&C, Simon-Kucher or Arthur D. Little.
    • Big Four strategy and deals: Strategy& (PwC), EY-Parthenon, Deloitte (Monitor Deloitte / M&A) or KPMG Deal Advisory, especially in commercial due diligence.
    • Corporate development / in-house M&A: ideally at a high-velocity aggregator or buy-and-build strategic.
    • Investment banking: M&A advisory at mid-market or tech-focused boutique banks, ideally on lower mid-market transactions with enterprise values below $50M.
  • An investor's mindset: you think like an owner, form a point of view quickly and back it with numbers.
  • Live deal experience: you know what it takes to get a deal over the line, and ideally you've led workstreams or been the day-to-day deal lead.
  • Excellent financial modelling and valuation skills: you build from a blank sheet and can defend every assumption.
  • A player-coach approach: you have experience developing junior talent and enjoy doing it.
  • Real commercial due diligence experience: market sizing, competitive analysis, customer and expert interviews, and quality-of-revenue work.
  • Presence: you can negotiate with founders selling their life's work and hold your ground with the C-suite and advisors.
  • Rigorous project management: you keep multiple parties, timelines and documents moving without dropping the ball.
  • A genuine interest in software and SaaS business models. A software background is an advantage but not a requirement.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken; additional European languages are a plus.
  • Real AI fluency and the drive to put it to work: you already use AI tools (Claude especially) day to day and look for ways they can speed up research, analysis, modelling and diligence workflows.

What’s in it for You

  • Principal seat, real ownership: You'll lead deals and allocate capital as a principal, not an advisor, then watch the companies you bought grow inside our portfolio.
  • Deal flow and exposure: $50M+ deployed every year across two continents, with direct access to our C-suite and Investment Committee from day one.
  • Ultimate flexibility: We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
  • Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
  • Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
  • Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.
  • Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

Agent OS is the shared runtime, context, memory, action, trust, and evaluation layer behind role-specific AI experiences across Atlas, office, field, voice, mobile, and future product surfaces. This is not a collection of chatbots. It is the platform that lets agents help contractors run their businesses with the right evidence, permissions, approvals, and audit trails.

You will help build the core engineering primitives behind that platform: agent runtime, typed tools, context and memory assembly, trust and approval flows, evaluation infrastructure, and production observability. You are not building one agent for one product surface. You are building the platform that product teams use to build many agents safely.

You will work on a small, senior AI platform team and partner closely with Product, Architecture, Security, Data Platform, Atlas, and domain engineering teams.


What you’ll do

  • Agent runtime and workflow execution: Build the runtime for role-specific agents, tool use, delegation, pause/resume, durable checkpoints, retries, and failure recovery. Agents must resume safely without losing state or duplicating side effects.
  • Typed tools and action contracts: Build deterministic controls around non-deterministic reasoning: governed reads, proposed writes, precondition checks, business invariants, scoped permissions, idempotency, audit trails, and rollback.
  • Context and memory systems: Build tenant-scoped context assembly, retrieval, freshness controls, provenance, transcripts, artifacts, tool results, and replayable evidence. ServiceTitan systems of record stay authoritative; memory provides context and coordination.
  • Trust and approval infrastructure: Build human-in-the-loop gates, approval thresholds, reversibility, tenant policy enforcement, and audit history for financial, contractual, dispatch, warranty, and compliance-sensitive workflows.
  • Evaluation and observability: Build offline and online evals, scenario libraries, simulation, trajectory review, regression detection, cost and latency telemetry, and autonomy promotion gates.
  • Reusable capability platform: Help product teams package prompts, tools, context requirements, policies, evals, rollout controls, ownership, and rollback into governed capabilities for owners, CSRs, dispatchers, technicians, managers, and back-office teams.
  • Model and inference architecture: Make practical tradeoffs across latency, cost, quality, structured outputs, caching, fallback behavior, provider choice, and model routing behind a shared platform layer.

The Paid Media Manager will independently lead account strategy for a select few of their own clients, while also working closely with Senior Paid Media Managers and Associate Directors to support on account strategy & tactical execution for larger clients as needed. jobs.excerpt: OUS Treasury Operations AnalystLet’s be unstoppable together!
jobs.description:
OUS Treasury Operations Analyst

Let’s be unstoppable together!

Circana is a leading provider of technology, AI, and data solutions for consumer packaged goods companies, manufacturers, and retailers. Our predictive analytics and Liquid Data® platform help clients measure market share, uncover consumer behavior, and drive growth—powered by six decades of expertise and an expansive, high-quality data set.

At Circana, we are fueled by our passion for continuous learning and growth, we seek and share feedback freely, and we celebrate victories both big and small in an environment that is flexible and accommodating to our work and personal lives.  We’re a global company dedicated to fostering inclusivity and belonging. We value and celebrate the unique experiences, cultures, and viewpoints that each individual brings. By embracing a wide range of backgrounds, skills, expertise, and beyond, we create a stronger, more innovative environment for our employees, clients, and communities. With us, you can always bring your full self to work.  Join our inclusive, committed team to be a challenger, own outcomes, and stay curious together. Circana is proud to be Certified™ by Great Place To Work®. This prestigious award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Circana. Learn more at

Role Overview

The Treasury team is part of Circana’s global Finance and Strategy organization and manages a broad range of operational and strategic activities, including cash management, banking, liquidity planning, capital structure, and financial risk management. The team supports approximately 25 countries and partners closely with Controllership, Tax, Legal, and Financial Planning & Analysis.

As the OUS Treasury Operations Analyst, you will serve as the primary resource for daily Treasury Operations outside the United States. You will independently manage core cash processes, including daily cash positioning, Treasury transactions, forecasting, reporting, banking administration, and operational controls across a complex international environment.

You will review and interpret cash activity, identify liquidity or operational concerns, and recommend improvements to cash visibility, forecast accuracy, processes, and controls. The role requires close partnership with the OUS Treasury Operations Manager, local Controllers, global banking partners, and teams across Controllership, Tax, Legal, and FP&A.

This role reports to the OUS Treasury Operations Manager and supports Treasury activities across approximately 25 countries. The OUS and US Analysts will cross-train and provide backup coverage for one another.

Job Responsibilities

  • Prepare and review daily OUS cash positioning, analyzing cash movements and identifying liquidity risks, funding needs, or unusual activity requiring escalation.
  • Execute Treasury transactions, including wires, ACH payments, and intercompany transfers, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to authorization and control requirements.
  • Own key components of daily, weekly, and monthly cash forecasting, including gathering and validating inputs, analyzing variances, and recommending improvements to forecast reliability.
  • Monitor cash across countries, currencies, legal entities, and banking platforms to support liquidity decisions and timely funding.
  • Partner with local Controllers, banks, Tax, Legal, Controllership, and FP&A to resolve cash-related issues and support international Treasury activities.
  • Review daily bank activity and partner with Controllership and local Finance teams to investigate and resolve cash or reconciliation exceptions.
  • Maintain bank account and authorized-signer documentation and support account openings, closures, and administrative updates across international banking partners.
  • Administer user access and entitlements within online banking platforms and Treasury systems in accordance with security and control requirements.
  • Monitor intercompany loan balances and maintain supporting schedules, ensuring accurate records and visibility into internal funding activity.
  • Prepare and enhance Treasury reporting, providing clear insights into cash trends, forecast variances, liquidity needs, and operational drivers.
  • Identify risks or issues within international Treasury processes and determine the appropriate stakeholders and escalation path.
  • Identify and support practical improvements to Treasury processes, controls, workflows, data quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Support Treasury systems and automation initiatives, including testing, documentation, and implementation of system enhancements.
  • Support audit, compliance, and documentation requirements, ensuring adherence to internal policies and control standards.
  • Participate in Treasury projects, cross-training, and process documentation initiatives.
  • Provide backup coverage for US Treasury Operations as needed.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in Treasury, banking, or a related finance or accounting role with meaningful exposure to cash management.
  • Hands-on experience with cash positioning, liquidity management, cash forecasting, corporate banking activity, or related Treasury processes.
  • Experience supporting Treasury activities across multiple countries, currencies, legal entities, or banking environments is strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of cash management, financial statements, cash flow, and liquidity concepts.
  • Ability to analyze cash activity, identify trends or exceptions, and make practical recommendations.
  • Ability to independently investigate operational issues, identify the appropriate stakeholders, and escalate concerns when needed.
  • Experience working with treasury management systems, ERP platforms, or corporate online banking systems. Kyriba and NetSuite experience are preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas, and data analysis.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to execute accurately within established controls and deadlines.
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to manage recurring daily responsibilities across multiple countries and time zones.
  • Effective communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to work across local and global Finance teams.
  • Problem-solving skills and willingness to investigate discrepancies, clarify requirements, and resolve operational issues.
  • Ability to provide Treasury coverage during US banking hours, with occasional flexibility to support stakeholders in other global time zones.

Circana Behaviors

jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Hanwha Renewables, headquartered in Irvine, California, a member of Hanwha Group, a FORTUNE Global 500 firm that is among the eight largest business enterprises in South Korea. Hanwha Renewables designs, builds and manages renewable energy solutions. The company brings a decade of global leadership in renewable energy to North America, combining best-of-world technology, processes, and partnerships to deliver utility-grade energy solutions customized for local energy markets. Hanwha Renewables offers the full spectrum of energy solutions – from power plant development, design, construction, operations, and maintenance. With proven capabilities across the renewable energy value chain, Hanwha Renewables minimizes uncertainty and risk, and helps customers achieve a higher return on their investment in renewable energy.

POSITION OVERVIEW

The Power Marketing Analyst will support the analysis of power market trends, risk assessment, regulatory developments, and other insights that inform the company's power marketing and origination strategy for its solar and energy storage project development portfolio. The role supports the sourcing and execution of offtake opportunities for utility-scale solar, energy storage, and hybrid projects, and helps the Origination & Power Marketing team build strategic partnerships with utilities and other load-serving entities (LSEs) around Power Purchase and Energy Storage Tolling agreements, and alternative revenue structures such as Development Asset Transfers and Build-Transfer Agreements. The ideal candidate brings commercial and regulatory experience in utility-scale solar and energy storage, along with a strong understanding of market dynamics and shifting trends in energy procurement among major offtakers.

Reporting to the Senior Director of Power Marketing and Origination, this role is responsible for data analysis, market research, and coordination with cross-functional teams to help prepare proposals and optimize origination strategies. Over time, the Analyst will develop experience across:

  • The development cycle of new utility-scale solar and energy storage projects
  • New market strategy for greenfield campaigns
  • Future procurement trends of major LSEs, including through Integrated Resource Plans (IRPs)
  • Evolving contracting mechanisms in the solar and storage space
  • Targeted M&A activity

Strong analytical skills, developing market knowledge, and the ability to communicate findings clearly are essential for success in this role. This position is expected to travel up to 10% of the time.

The employee may be required to perform other job-related duties as requested by management. All duties will be assigned in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support execution of client engagement and power marketing strategies across the U.S.
  • Maintain business-tracking systems, including CRM platforms, RFP trackers, and related tools.
  • Prepare or support preparation of presentations for executive and customer briefings.
  • Monitor, track, and summarize load-serving entities' integrated resource and procurement plans.
  • Monitor and help evaluate opportunities across U.S. markets — such as RFPs for potential renewable and energy storage projects — and document and track them for future reference.
  • Coordinate proposal preparation in response to RFPs and bilateral opportunities by identifying, collecting, and organizing required information from subject matter experts across the organization.
  • Monitor public information on executed power purchase, tolling, build-transfer, and related agreements, and document relevant details in shared drive folders and trackers.
  • Monitor RTO and other market working groups for rule changes related to transmission rights, deliverability, and energy markets.
  • Monitor trade associations for relevant regulatory and market developments and share information across the team and organization as appropriate.
  • Assist in modeling and evaluating the impact of market design and topological changes — such as new generation, new storage, and transmission buildouts — on procurement opportunities and future energy prices.
  • Support forecasting of nodal/zonal and OTC energy prices for RTO and bilateral markets across long-term time horizons using fundamental and third-party models and services.
  • Participate as appropriate in standing and ad hoc internal and external meetings.
  • Communicate clearly and succinctly with audiences of different backgrounds during meetings and presentations.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree or higher in business, engineering, sustainability, finance, or a related field.
  • Minimum 1–3 years of relevant work experience in the electric utility industry's regulatory or commercial sector.
  • Familiarity with CRM applications and industry platforms such as F1, Procore, LevelTen, Aurora, NPM, or similar tools is a plus.
  • Coursework in at least one of the following areas: power system analysis, power system economics, power system operations and planning, optimization, data analysis, or object-oriented programming. If no relevant coursework, relevant work experience is also considered.
  • Working knowledge of organized and bilateral electricity markets across the U.S.; familiarity with at least one ISO/RTO market is preferred.

COMPENSATION: $90,000 - $105,000 salary

  • SSE (Security Service Edge): la parte de seguridad del modelo SASE (sin la parte de red pura): filtrado web, protección de acceso a aplicaciones y control de datos, todo desde la nube.
  • Arquitectura de seguridad perimetral: diseño de las "murallas" que protegen la red de una empresa frente a accesos externos no autorizados (firewalls, control de tráfico entrante/saliente).
  • Acceso seguro: soluciones para que empleados, proveedores o dispositivos entren a los sistemas de la empresa de forma controlada y verificada (VPN, autenticación multifactor, acceso remoto seguro).
  • Redes y seguridad en entornos Cisco: manejo de los equipos y software de red más usados en empresas grandes (switches, routers, firewalls Cisco).
  • Microsoft Azure: la nube de Microsoft, donde las empresas alojan servidores, aplicaciones y datos.
  • Windows Server: sistema operativo con el que se gestionan los servidores internos de una empresa (usuarios, archivos, aplicaciones).
  • AD/Entra ID: el directorio donde se guardan los usuarios de una empresa y sus permisos de acceso; Entra ID es la versión en la nube de Active Directory.
  • Intune: herramienta de Microsoft para gestionar y proteger de forma remota los dispositivos (portátiles, móviles) de los empleados.

Must-haves

  • Al menos 5 años de experiencia en arquitectura de seguridad perimetral y acceso seguro.
  • Experiencia sólida en diseño y despliegue de soluciones en cliente final. El rol implica presentar y ejecutar soluciones con un cliente real de alta exigencia, no trabajo aislado de laboratorio.
  • Conocimientos en redes y/o seguridad, especialmente en entornos Cisco.
  • Background técnico en entornos Microsoft (Azure, Windows Server, AD/Entra ID, Intune). Las arquitecturas combinan Cisco y Microsoft; sin este conocimiento solo se cubriría la mitad de la solución.
  • Nivel alto de comunicación, planificación y orientación a resultados. El rol implica presentar arquitecturas directamente al cliente y coordinar su ejecución; es el puente entre la técnica y el negocio.
  • Visión estratégica y de negocio. Se espera conectar decisiones técnicas con el impacto en el negocio del cliente, especialmente en un entorno bancario donde la seguridad es crítica.
  • Nivel alto de inglés. El trabajo directo con fabricantes internacionales (Cisco, Microsoft) requiere manejarse con fluidez en inglés.

Nice-to-haves

  • Certificaciones Cisco (CCNP/CCIE), VMware (VCP), Veeam (VMCE), CISSP/CISM, PMP/PRINCE2 e ITIL. Validan formalmente el conocimiento técnico y de gestión, aunque no son excluyentes.
  • Manejo de MS Project, Jira/Azure Boards, IT Glue o IT Portal. Reduce el tiempo de adaptación a las herramientas internas de planificación y documentación.
  • Experiencia en entornos corporativos complejos o áreas de seguridad estratégica. Aporta contexto valioso para un proyecto de esta envergadura, aunque no es un requisito de entrada.

About Jade Biosciences

Jade Biosciences is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on developing best-in-class therapies that address critical unmet needs in autoimmune diseases. Jade’s lead candidate, JADE101, targets the cytokine APRIL, and is currently being evaluated in a Phase 1 clinical trial for the treatment of immunoglobulin A nephropathy. Jade’s pipeline also includes JADE201, an afucosylated anti-BAFF-R monoclonal antibody, as well as JADE301, an undisclosed antibody candidate, both currently in preclinical development. Jade was launched based on assets licensed from Paragon Therapeutics, an antibody discovery engine founded by Fairmount. For more information, visit  and follow the Company on LinkedIn.

Jade Biosciences is seeking an experienced and strategic Vice President, Medical Affairs to build and lead the Company’s medical affairs function as our differentiated pipeline advances through late-stage development and toward commercialization. Reporting to the Chief Medical Officer, this individual will define and execute the medical affairs strategy across Jade’s portfolio, with an initial emphasis on JADE101 in IgA nephropathy. The successful candidate will serve as a scientific and clinical thought partner to internal teams and external stakeholders, translating rigorous target biology and clinical data into compelling medical and scientific engagement.

This is a high-visibility leadership role for a physician (MD) who combines deep therapeutic-area expertise — ideally in nephrology and/or immunology/rheumatology — with a proven track record of building medical affairs capabilities in the biopharmaceutical industry.

The opportunity

Reporting to the Senior Director, Digital Transformation, the Applied AI Engineer will design, build, deploy, and optimize AI-powered applications and solutions that create measurable business value across the organization.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on applying AI to real business challenges, not building foundation models. Working closely with business, data, and technology teams, you will take AI solutions from concept to production, delivering agents, assistants, automations, and applications that help teams work smarter and make better decisions.

You are a builder who enjoys solving complex problems, navigating ambiguity, and creating enterprise-ready solutions that people actually use. Joining WELL's growing Business Transformation team, you will help shape the future of AI across one of Canada's leading healthcare technology organizations.

This is a fully remote role based anywhere in Canada, with a preference for candidates located in Toronto or Vancouver.

Who you are

You are an experienced software engineer and builder who has developed strong applied AI capabilities. You get energized by turning ideas into solutions that people actually use. Whether starting with a whiteboard sketch, a business challenge, or an emerging opportunity, you enjoy taking ownership of the entire journey, from design and development through deployment, adoption, and continuous improvement.

You combine strong technical capabilities with curiosity, creativity, and business acumen. You ask thoughtful questions, challenge assumptions, and enjoy working closely with stakeholders to understand what they are trying to achieve before determining the best technical path forward. While AI is your toolkit, your focus is always on solving real business problems and creating measurable value.

You thrive in environments where priorities evolve, ambiguity exists, and innovation is encouraged. Rather than waiting for perfect requirements, you are comfortable navigating complexity, connecting the dots, and building practical solutions that improve efficiency, support decision-making, and automate workflows.

Most importantly, you understand that successful AI solutions require more than great prompts. They require thoughtful integration, secure access to data, testing, monitoring, governance, and ongoing iteration. You have experience delivering solutions into production environments and understand what it takes to build systems that are reliable, scalable, and trusted by users.

What's in it for you

Build what’s next. This is an opportunity to help shape how AI is applied across one of Canada's leading healthcare technology organizations. You will join a growing team that is building enterprise AI capabilities from the ground up, giving you the chance to contribute to high-impact initiatives and influence how the organization leverages AI in the years ahead.

Make an impact. You will have the opportunity to build solutions that are adopted across the business and create meaningful outcomes for teams and stakeholders. Unlike many AI roles that focus primarily on experimentation, this role offers the chance to see your work move into production, gain adoption, and deliver measurable impact.

Grow with the team. You will work alongside experienced AI, data, and technology leaders while gaining exposure to enterprise-scale AI implementation across a variety of business functions. As WELL continues to expand its AI capabilities, there will be opportunities to grow your expertise, take on increasingly complex initiatives, and help shape the future direction of the team.

You will:

  • Build AI solutions. You will design, build, deploy, and continuously improve AI-powered solutions that help teams work smarter and make better decisions. Working closely with business stakeholders, data teams, and technology partners, you will translate business needs into practical applications, intelligent agents, assistants, workflow automations, and other AI-enabled solutions.
  • Connect data and systems. You will connect AI capabilities with enterprise data, systems, APIs, and business applications, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with enterprise standards. You will partner with Data Engineering and Technology teams to establish reliable data access patterns and support long-term maintainability.
  • Optimize performance. As solutions move into production, you will be responsible for evaluating performance, monitoring effectiveness, implementing appropriate controls and guardrails, and continuously improving outcomes based on user feedback and business results.
  • Evaluate and Improve AI Performance. You will design testing and evaluation approaches to measure solution quality, accuracy, reliability, and business effectiveness. You will monitor production AI solutions and continuously improve performance based on user feedback and operational metrics. An important part of this role is the ability to implement guardrails, access controls, and monitoring to support responsible AI use.
  • Drive adoption. Along the way, you will collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to identify opportunities, demonstrate solutions, educate users, and help drive the successful adoption of AI technologies.

Here's what you bring:

  • Technical foundation. You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, solution engineering, data engineering, automation, or related technical roles. You have experience designing, building, and deploying production software and AI solutions and understand the realities of supporting those solutions after launch. You have strong programming skills in Python and experience with API, databases, cloud environments, and enterprise integrations to connect systems, data, and AI capabilities to solve business challenges.
  • AI expertise. You have hands-on experience building and deploying solutions using modern large language model platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar technologies. You have applied concepts such as retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, workflow orchestration, and agent-based architectures in working applications.
  • Delivery mindset. Beyond the technical skills, you bring a strong delivery mindset. You enjoy taking ownership, working through ambiguity, and moving solutions from concept to production. You understand how to balance innovation with practicality and are motivated by building solutions that create meaningful business outcomes. You are equally comfortable making sound technical decisions and getting hands on to implement them.
  • Stakeholder partnership. You communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and enjoy collaborating with others to understand business challenges, align priorities, and translate needs into practical technical solutions.
  • Curiosity and continuous learning. You are naturally curious, eager to learn, and energized by solving complex problems. You think beyond immediate requirements, consider long-term scalability, and are always looking for better ways to create value through technology.

Preferred qualifications

While not required, experience building AI assistants, agents, workflow automations, enterprise search, or knowledge management solutions would be an asset. Additional experience with LLMs such as OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Codex, Claude Code, and AI orchestration and automation tooling such as LangGraph, n8n, or Logic Apps, as well as AI monitoring, evaluation, and observability practices, would help you ramp up quickly. Experience working in healthcare, regulated industries, or privacy-sensitive environments is also considered an asset.

Why join us?

Healthcare is our sector, and we know that for WELL to be a winning team, we must provide an open environment to prioritize health and wellbeing and multiple resources to discuss mental, physical, and psychological needs openly. From the CEO to the newest hire, everyone comes together as part of our culture of respect, openness, support, and communication. We unite to empower each other to be the best we can be.

We recognize that the best way to serve our diverse patient communities is by reflecting that diversity. With almost 65% of our team members identifying as female and 70% of our leadership identifying as a visible minority, we are proud of our diverse, equitable and inclusive organization.

Apply now

If you share our values, want to make a difference in healthcare technology solutions, and meet 70% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply. Express your interest here.

Compensation

The salary range for this position is $150K- 170K. The salary will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and the needs of the organization. At WELL, we are committed to fair and equitable compensation and aim to provide a competitive salary that reflects the value and expertise of the successful candidate.

Director, Sales Compensation

FLSA: Status: Exempt

At our rapidly growing company, we are seeking an exceptional Director of Sales Compensation to lead the design, implementation, and stewardship of our complex commission plans. This strategic role is pivotal in ensuring our compensation programs align with our overall business objectives, empower and motivate our sales teams, and accurately reflect the unique challenges and opportunities of our consumption-based business model.

The ideal candidate is a seasoned compensation professional who thrives on corporate strategy but possesses an unyielding "roll-up-your-sleeves" attitude toward administrative accuracy.   • Strategic Planning & GTM Alignment:

    • Assess the operational feasibility of proposed plans, ensuring that what is designed strategically can be accurately administered at scale.
  • Team Leadership:
    • Directly manage, develop, and mentor a high-performing team of two compensation professionals, overseeing their daily workflows, monthly deliverables, and professional growth.

Process Automation & AI Innovation:

    • Leverage compensation tools and technology to streamline processes, automate commission calculations, and improve overall operational efficiency.
    • Actively identify opportunities to utilize Artificial Intelligence (AI) to automate manual workflows, reconcile complex datasets, and accelerate the validation of commission outputs.

Standardized Reporting & Analytics:

    • Design, build, and standardize rigorous monthly and quarterly reporting packages tailored for Finance and Sales Leadership to track commission spend, budget variances, and plan effectiveness.
    • Gather and analyze sales data, performance metrics, and revenue trends to deliver data-driven insights and actionable recommendations for future plan modifications.
  • Meticulous Administration & Audit:
    • Oversee the monthly commission cycle with an elite standard of accuracy, including a commitment to personally review every single employee's statement in detail each month.
    • Master our primary commission tool (CaptivateIQ), while maintaining the architectural readiness and willingness to transition the entire process at a moment's notice.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication:

    • Partner with Finance to establish bulletproof auditing, reconciliation, and expense forecasting workflows.

Qualifications

    • Expert-level Google Sheets / Excel capabilities are mandatory, alongside an operational willingness to manage massive commission infrastructure manually if required.
    • Familiarity with the broader tech stack: Salesforce, Adaptive, Intaact.

100% remote (Must be Based in the US) I 100% Employee Owned

Why We Started Test DoubleSoftware is broken, and we're working hard to fix it. At Test Double, our mission is to improve the way the world builds software. While the goal may seem audacious, it’s what drives us. We believe that the current state of software development is not good enough and we’re looking for others to join our cause.

Core ValuesKnowledge sharing and continuous improvement are among our core values. We're proud to support our Double Agents when they speak at conferences, blog, contribute to open source, and organize in their local software community. Another core value is that we’re owners. We own problems and solutions. And we’re all actual owners, because Test Double is 100% employee-owned through an ESOP.

Our CultureTest Double is a small, growing, and adaptable agency. We actively enlist the help of all of our developers to guide and improve our business. Those opportunities include participating in our candidate qualification process, strategic expansion with our current clients, and active involvement to support equity, diversity and inclusion.

Central to our success over 10 years as a growing company is focusing on people first. We want all of our Double Agents to feel happy, healthy, and supported. Work-life balance is paramount to achieving this goal. We provide ample opportunities for our developers to feel engaged, including employee resource groups centered around interpersonal growth, weekly team hangouts to learn a new skill, coffee chats to meet other team members, TD Connect internal events, and much more.

Improve how the world builds software by leading transformational client engagements

Test Double is seeking an exceptional Principal Product Consultant to help solve our clients’ most complex product challenges while expanding our capabilities in areas like artificial intelligence, commercialization, and organizational scaling. As a Principal Product Consultant, you'll embed with client teams as both a strategic advisor and hands-on product leader, helping organizations improve how they build and grow products while leaving every engagement better than you found it.

Your mission as a Principal Product Consultant

Partner with clients as a strategic advisorOperate as a trusted advisor to stakeholders at all levels — from product teams to executives. You’ll shape product direction, connect outcomes to business performance, and align decision-makers through clear communication of strategy, decisions, tradeoffs, and results. You’ll establish how outcomes are measured and governed across teams, products, or portfolios.

Shape compelling solutions across multiple engagements of all sizesOwn product outcomes directly when needed while also leading across teams. You’ll define strategy, guide execution, and introduce repeatable practices across discovery, delivery, and measurement that help teams operate effectively long after your engagement ends.

Support revenue growth through authentic relationshipsIdentify and drive growth opportunities — from improving a single product’s performance to shaping broader investment decisions — through authentic client partnerships. You’ll use data, experimentation, and market insight to turn ambiguous opportunities into measurable results.

Drive strategic transformation on our most challenging engagementsStep into complex environments and bring clarity to products and teams with no clear path forward. Whether improving discovery, execution, or team effectiveness, you’ll identify what’s not working and leave behind systems that sustain outcomes beyond your involvement.

Develop the next generation of empathetic collaboratorsMentor product managers and cross-functional partners through direct collaboration. You’ll model strong product thinking, improve how teams make decisions, and help others grow without becoming a bottleneck.


What you bring to Test Double

Strong product fundamentals with the ability to operate across levelsYou can define vision and strategic priorities grounded in customer and market evidence. You guide execution while connecting product decisions to validated user needs, business goals, and investment priorities.

Experience leading and coachingYou’ve driven alignment in complex environments and helped multi-team organizations improve how they operate through outcome-driven behaviors. You create clarity, build momentum, and help teams and leaders grow through direct, actionable feedback.

Proven ability to scale product systems and practicesYou’ve introduced or improved ways of working across discovery, execution, and measurement that enable teams and organizations to perform more effectively. You set standards for evidence quality, verification, and decision hygiene so the organization makes better decisions after you leave, not just the same decisions faster.

Experience operating in and building product leadership functionsYou can step into interim product leadership roles (Director or VP of Product) and guide organizations through ambiguity. You’ve established product management practices, hiring criteria, and performance expectations that scale beyond your engagement.

Ownership of product commercializationYou've owned top-line growth and commercial viability by running pricing, packaging, and business-model experiments with evidence. You’ve partnered directly with marketing and sales on positioning, differentiation, and GTM. You can re-shape pricing and packaging when AI changes cost-to-serve, value capture, or unit economics.

AI Product and Workflow FluencyYou’ve helped organizations build AI products responsibly and adapt to the operational changes AI creates. You also use AI extensively in your own product practice — building reusable workflows, decision frameworks, and experimentation systems that improve how teams research, prioritize, validate, and execute while keeping assumptions and tradeoffs visible and inspectable.

Alignment with Test Double's values and cultureYou operate with empathy, clarity, and integrity, and care about building sustainable systems that leave teams stronger than you found them.

What we offer

Compensation:

Starting offers: $170,000USD - $190,000USD

Benefits:

  • 100% remote

  • Time off: 5 weeks flexible time off (vacation and sick time) + 10 Paid Holidays, 2-week sabbatical after 5 years

  • We are not accepting submissions from recruiting agencies for this role.

Contribute to Platform Evolution
  • Partner with platform leadership to evolve the internal developer platform toward an AI-first model

  • Design and implement self-service infrastructure systems that abstract away cloud complexity
  • Build APIs, CLIs, and developer-facing tools that enable infrastructure provisioning without requiring deep cloud expertise

  • Contribute to AI-powered copilots and assistants that improve developer productivity

  • Implement reusable infrastructure patterns and opinionated defaults
  • Encode security, scalability, and compliance into platform tooling
  • Extend Infrastructure as Code practices (e.g., OpenTofu) with abstraction and validation layers
Drive Observability and Insight
  • Implement logging, metrics, and tracing across platform systems
  • Leverage AI to detect anomalies, summarize system behavior, and surface actionable insights
  • Contribute to systems that move from visibility to guided action
Iterate and Improve
  • Contribute to platform instrumentation and feedback loops
  • Use data and developer feedback to improve usability, performance, and adoption
  • Continuously refine platform capabilities based on real-world usage
Collaborate Across Teams
  • Work closely with application teams, SREs, and security engineers
  • Support platform adoption through strong technical partnership
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to engineers where needed
Why This Role Matters

Our developers should spend their time shipping features, not wrestling with YAML, Terraform, or cloud infrastructure.

In this role, you’ll help build a platform that is not only self-service, but intelligent and context-aware, enabling engineers to move faster, make better decisions, and focus on what matters most.

This is an opportunity to:
  • Operate as a senior, high-impact individual contributor on a modern platform team
  • Help evolve infrastructure into an AI-first, intelligent system
  • Build tools and systems that actively amplify developer productivity
Qualifications:

Core Experience
  • 8+ years in infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering role
  • Proven experience building or contributing to internal developer platforms
  • Deep expertise in Amazon Web Services, especially EKS, IAM, and networking
  • Strong programming skills (Python or Go), with experience building production-grade tools and services
  • Strong understanding of Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, and cloud-native architectures
AI-First and Systems Thinking
  • Experience or strong interest in integrating AI/LLMs into developer or operational workflows
  • Familiarity with APIs from providers like OpenAI or similar
  • Understanding of event-driven architectures and their role in intelligent automation
  • Ability to design adaptive, feedback-driven systems rather than static workflows
Platform and Developer Experience
  • Experience building developer tooling (CLIs, portals, SDKs)
  • Familiarity with platforms like Backstage, Port, or custom developer portals
  • Strong product mindset with a focus on usability and developer experience
Collaboration and Influence
  • Strong systems thinking and architectural design skills
  • Ability to operate independently while aligning with platform direction
  • Effective communication and cross-team collaboration skills
AI-First Platform Principles
  • From automation to intelligence - systems interpret and act, not just execute
  • Context-aware interfaces - developers interact via guided and natural workflows
  • Human-in-the-loop - automation includes safe approval and oversight
  • Observability to action - insights lead to recommendations and responses
  • Continuous learning - platforms improve through feedback and usage patterns
Why Teaching Strategies
At Teaching Strategies, our solutions and services are only as strong as the teams that create them. By bringing passion, dedication, and creativity to your job every day, there's no telling what you can do and where you can go! We provide a competitive compensation and benefits package, flexible work schedules, opportunities to engage with co-workers, access to career advancement and professional development opportunities, and the chance to make a difference in the communities we serve.
