jobs.title: Sales Operations Manager, Channel & Partnerships
jobs.excerpt: About the Revenue Operations TeamThe OpenSesame Revenue Operations team is the operational backbone and growth catalyst of the company, enabling our Go-To-Market teams to sell, serve, and scale with clarity and confidence.
jobs.description:
About the Revenue Operations Team

The OpenSesame Revenue Operations team is the operational backbone and growth catalyst of the company, enabling our Go-To-Market teams to sell, serve, and scale with clarity and confidence. We design the systems, processes, and insights that turn strategy into execution and ensure revenue flows efficiently from first conversation to renewal.

We partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Partners, Finance, and Legal to remove friction, enforce smart governance, and create a consistent, high-quality customer experience. Our work blends data, process, technology, and judgment to help the business move faster, without cutting corners.

What makes our Revenue Operations team unique:

  • We embrace automation and AI to reduce manual work, surface insights faster, and scale best practices.
  • We invest deeply in operational excellence and continuous improvement, balancing speed with discipline.
  • We are systems thinkers and problem solvers, motivated by making complex processes simpler and more scalable.
  • We measure success by business outcomes — deal velocity, forecast accuracy, won revenue and customer experience.
  • We operate with an owner’s mindset, taking accountability for results, not just activity.
  • We do the right thing, even when it requires tough conversations or slowing down a deal to protect the business.
  • We communicate with clarity and credibility, serving as trusted advisors to GTM teams and leadership.
  • We believe the best results come from tight collaboration and shared learning, supporting one another through peer problem-solving, documentation, and knowledge-sharing so the entire organization gets better together.

About the Sales Operations Manager, Channel & Partnerships role:

The Sales Operations Manager, Channel & Partnerships is the operational partner responsible for helping OpenSesame scale its partner business with greater clarity, efficiency, accountability, and predictability.

This role partners closely with Strategic Partner Managers, Partner Development, the Partner Program Manager, Revenue Operations, Sales, Finance, Business Systems, Legal, Enablement, Marketing, and Product to improve how partner-sourced, partner-influenced, reseller, OEM, referral, and co-sell motions operate from partner lead submission through quote-to-cash.

This is a manager-level individual contributor role with no direct reports. The role requires manager-level judgment, strong business partnership, analytical depth, and the ability to influence change through process, data, systems, automation, and AI-enabled workflows. This is not a reporting-only role or a tactical support desk. The right person will diagnose partner process friction, improve tool adoption, clarify ownership, strengthen partner attribution, and turn messy data into actionable insights that help the partner business grow.

Success in this role means partner leaders trust the data, Partner Sales Managers have clear operating views, partners submit leads through the right platform, quote-to-cash processes are understood, and leadership can clearly see what is working, what is at risk, and where to focus next.

Performance Objectives

Within 30 Days: Understand, Diagnose, and Prioritize

  • Build a deep understanding of OpenSesame’s partner ecosystem, including reseller, OEM, referral, partner-sourced, partner-influenced, and co-sell motions.
  • Establish strong relationships with Partner Sales Managers, Partner Development, the Partner Program Manager, Sales, Finance, Business Systems, Legal, Enablement, Marketing, Product, and RevOps.
  • Audit current partner lead submission, routing, attribution, opportunity management, handoff, reporting, and quote-to-cash processes.
  • Assess adoption and utilization of key partner tools and workflows, including Euler, Crossbeam, Salesforce, Gong, Looker, ZoomInfo, Clay, and related GTM systems.
  • Identify friction points impacting partner lead submission, partner visibility, SPM productivity, reporting accuracy, quote-to-cash execution, and forecast confidence.
  • Deliver a current-state assessment with prioritized recommendations, including quick wins and longer-term operating improvements.

Within 60 Days: Improve Process, Visibility, and Adoption

  • Refine partner lead and opportunity workflows to improve routing accuracy, attribution, pipeline visibility, and accountability.
  • Establish clearer standards for partner lead submission through Euler, including required fields, SLAs, review process, ownership, and follow-up expectations.
  • Improve use of Crossbeam to support account mapping, overlap analysis, co-sell opportunity identification, partner prioritization, and joint pipeline visibility.
  • Build or improve reporting views for Partner Sales Managers, Partner Development, Partner Program leadership, Sales leadership, Finance, and RevOps.
  • Partner with Business Systems to scope CRM, Euler, Crossbeam, and workflow improvements that reduce manual work and improve data quality.
  • Identify automation or AI-enabled opportunities to streamline partner operations, improve lead hygiene, summarize partner performance, or surface pipeline risk faster.
  • Align with Enablement and the Partner Program Manager on internal and partner-facing communication, training, and adoption reinforcement.

Beyond 90 Days: Scale Partner Operations and Strategic Impact

  • Own ongoing operational health across partner lead submission, attribution, opportunity management, reporting, and quote-to-cash workflows.
  • Build durable reporting that helps leadership understand partner pipeline quality, conversion, revenue contribution, account overlap, and growth opportunities.
  • Surface insights on partner performance, partner fit, source quality, deal velocity, conversion, attribution, and partner profitability.
  • Support Partner Development with data-backed insights to identify, prioritize, and evaluate potential new partners.
  • Support Partner Sales Managers with clear views into partner account activity, pipeline, performance, whitespace, and expansion opportunities.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal, Deal Desk, and Sales to improve operational clarity across OEM and reseller quote-to-cash processes.
  • Drive measurable improvements in tool adoption, workflow efficiency, partner lead compliance, reporting accuracy, and partner pipeline visibility.
  • Be viewed by Partner leadership as a trusted operating partner who brings clarity, urgency, and practical solutions.

Ongoing Responsibilities

Partner Pipeline, Attribution & Rules of Engagement

  • Own operational visibility into partner-sourced, partner-influenced, reseller, OEM, referral, and co-sell pipeline.
  • Improve partner lead submission, routing, tracking, and attribution across Euler, Crossbeam, Salesforce, and related systems.
  • Support and operationalize partner attribution rules, including source, influence, referral, reseller, OEM, and co-sell motions.
  • Help maintain partner rules of engagement, including lead submission requirements, ownership, AE/SPM handoff expectations, response SLAs, conflict resolution, and exception handling.
  • Identify attribution gaps, duplicate submissions, unclear ownership, inconsistent crediting, stale opportunities, or missing partner data.

Partner Tool Adoption, Automation & AI

  • Drive adoption of partner tools and workflows by making processes clear, useful, and easy to follow for internal teams and external partners.
  • Diagnose friction across Euler, Crossbeam, Salesforce, reporting, handoffs, and quote-to-cash workflows.
  • Partner with Business Systems, Analytics, and Enablement to scope, test, and roll out system or workflow improvements.
  • Identify opportunities to use automation and AI-enabled workflows to reduce manual work, improve data quality, and surface insights faster.
  • Explore use cases such as partner performance summaries, lead quality checks, account overlap insights, partner QBR prep, pipeline risk alerts, quote-to-cash prompts, and executive reporting.

Reporting, Analytics & Strategic Insights

  • Build and maintain reporting that helps Partner leadership understand what is working, what is at risk, and where to focus.
  • Analyze partner pipeline, conversion, sales cycle, win rates, deal velocity, source quality, attribution, account overlap, and revenue contribution.
  • Support partner QBRs, business reviews, annual planning, and performance discussions with clear, data-backed insights.
  • Translate messy or incomplete data into executive-ready recommendations: what changed, why it changed, what is at risk, and what action is recommended.

Partner Program, Planning & Growth Support

  • Support the Partner Program Manager with operational infrastructure for partner tiers, program rules, incentives, enablement, compliance, and performance measurement.
  • Support Partner Development with analysis to identify and prioritize prospective partners based on fit, account overlap, market opportunity, and revenue potential.
  • Support Partner Sales Managers in managing and expanding partner relationships through account visibility, pipeline insights, partner activity reporting, and process clarity.
  • Build visibility across the partner lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, enablement, activation, pipeline creation, revenue contribution, and expansion.

Quote-to-Cash & Cross-Functional Operations

  • Build operational understanding of quote-to-cash requirements across OEM, reseller, referral, and other partner motions.
  • Partner with Finance, Legal, Deal Desk, Business Systems, and Sales to clarify requirements, reduce friction, and improve handoffs.
  • Improve visibility into partner deal economics, including discounts, reseller margins, referral fees, OEM terms, payment obligations, and revenue recognition considerations where applicable.
  • Translate business needs into clear requirements for process, reporting, systems, and enablement improvements.

You might notice we don’t have the typical list of requirements and buzzwords here. That’s intentional.

We’re looking for proven examples from your career that show you can do this job, that you’ve built systems, driven alignment, and created impact at scale. When you look back a year from now, you’ll know you’ve made OpenSesame better, faster, and stronger because of your leadership.

Although it should go without saying (but it doesn’t), OpenSesame is an equal opportunity employer and we strive to create a welcoming, inclusive environment that celebrates diversity.

We use AI. For real. Every team at OpenSesame works with AI tools daily, not as a buzzword, but as practice. You'll build fluency that most companies are still talking about adopting, with hands-on training and clear guardrails to experiment responsibly. AI amplifies your creativity and judgment. It doesn't replace them. The skills you build here travel with you.

Location: This position can be based anywhere in the US. We operate as a remote-first company, and invest in mandatory all-company meetings several times a year in addition to required team travel as necessary.

Performance Driven: We're looking for self-starters with a track record of delivering excellent results, but we're highly selective about who we hire. We don't focus on typical job requirements, instead, we're interested in specific examples from your past experiences. All positions can be based anywhere in the US, and require up to 15 days of travel per year, with senior management and leadership teams requiring up to 35 days.

Compensation: On-target earnings for this role range between $135,000 and $150,000 per year, depending on experience, which includes base salary and variable incentive compensation based on performance. At OpenSesame, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to employees upon hire, including ISOs, health insurance, 401(k) matching, and paid time off. We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, relying on market data to determine compensation and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience.

Benefits: Benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible PTO, 401(k) matching, incentive stock options, volunteer time off, Employee Resource Groups, and a generous professional development program with dedicated annual time off for learning and growth.

Equal Employment Opportunity: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.

Pay Transparency: At OpenSesame, we prioritize pay transparency, fairness, and equity to create a positive and inclusive work environment, regularly reviewing our compensation practices to align with our values and goals. We provide competitive and fair compensation to our employees based on their skills, experience, and performance.

CPRA (California Candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our privacy policy or the California Attorney General's website.

EDGE Engineering and Science is seeking a multi-disciplinary National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) Project Manager who will work independently to prepare environmental documents, primarily Environmental Assessments (EA), Environmental Impact Statements (EIS), and related technical studies related to linear infrastructure (e.g., pipelines and fiber optics), marine and coastal infrastructure, and coastal restoration. You will work directly with federal agencies, clients, and other members of the NEPA Practice at EDGE to develop legally defensible documentation. Additional tasks will include participation in public meetings, coordination of agency and internal team project deadlines, training junior staff, and various other tasks as available.

Today’s businesses are facing the most comprehensive and complicated suite of environmental regulations on record. At EDGE, we provide our clients the insight and expertise to achieve their business objectives amidst this complex landscape. We stand apart from other consulting firms by putting the client’s needs at the forefront of everything we do, delivering innovative and responsive solutions across multiple practice areas.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct NEPA impact analyses for a wide range of public projects and develop the appropriate level of NEPA documentation.
  • Manage the preparation of legally sound NEPA documents (i.e., EISs, EAs, and categorical exclusions) and other environmental compliance documents (e.g., biological assessments).
  • Participate in the authorship of various sections of the applicable NEPA document.
  • When needed, oversee the preparation of NEPA documents prepared by subconsultants and provide QA/QC for deliverables.
  • Coordinate with local/state/federal agencies and the public in helping clients meet compliance requirements, effectively communicate project details, and record stakeholder input, including developing presentations and facilitating agency and public meetings.
  • Stay updated on the latest developments and best practices in NEPA law, regulation, policy, and guidance.
  • Collaborates with Project Managers, Project Teams, clients, and other stakeholders to integrate environmental considerations into project planning and execution.
  • Provide technical support for environmental permitting processes.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in environmental sciences, geology, planning, or similar. Master’s degree preferred.
  • A minimum of 7-10 years of NEPA experience, or comparable writing and document development experience.
  • A deep understanding of NEPA and the intersection of NEPA with other environmental laws such as the Clean Water Act, the Endangered Species Act, and the National Historical Preservation Act.
  • Ability to effectively manage time to meet deliverable targets and deadlines, work well under time constraints, balance multiple priorities, and track progression of various documents concurrently.
  • Excellent research, analytical, writing, oral communication and organizational skills.
  • Willingness to travel as needed for client events, conferences, and other business-related engagements

EDGE strives to hire and retain the best and brightest candidates available in the marketplace. To be selected for this position, the candidate must possess the interpersonal skills and oral and written communication skills necessary for positive internal, client, and contractor relationships. Solid technical writing skills and problem-solving abilities are a must. The candidate must demonstrate a passion for environmental consulting, technical excellence and quality, and a commitment to lifelong learning and growth.

Why EDGE?

  • Work That Matters. We help businesses around the world meet the environmental challenges they face. Our work not only helps the companies we serve, it ensures the products of our clients’ businesses continue to drive the economy and positively impacts the future of our planet.
  • National Reach. Local Management. We have the people and the resources to serve clients across the United States, but our small company feel is what makes us unique. Every individual within our company has the opportunity to give input on projects, allowing employees to grow their knowledge and experience and EDGE to provide the best solutions to our customers.
  • Engaging Projects. The diverse needs of our clients ensure your work is always of interest and provide opportunities for innovation at every level of the company. Our employees enjoy greater responsibility and develop a breadth of experience not common with other entry- to mid-level career opportunities in our field.
  • Career Growth Opportunities. At least one member of our corporate leadership is involved in every major project, allowing for a close relationship between management and employees. We encourage collaboration and ingenuity and reward success by promoting from within.
  • Comprehensive Benefits Plan. We offer a full suite of benefits including health, dental and vision insurance, retirement savings plans with employer contributions, paid time off and more. Enjoy a career that also offers peace of mind when you join the EDGE team.

Benefits

EDGE places high value on the health and well-being of its employees and offers the following benefits:

  • Comprehensive employee benefits including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance.
  • Employer matched 401(k) plan.
  • Annual performance bonus program.
  • Student loan repayment assistance after 12 months of employment for employees who graduated within 6 years of start date.
  • Competitive maternity leave.

Please Note: EDGE will not sponsor an employment visa (e.g., H‐1B visa, OPT, etc.) to fill this position.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewGR8 Global is a firm forged by an affinity of top 100 accounting firms in the United States with the objective of coming together and redefining the workplace while providing additional value to our partners.
jobs.description:
Overview

GR8 Global is a firm forged by an affinity of top 100 accounting firms in the United States with the objective of coming together and redefining the workplace while providing additional value to our partners. We believe that there is a huge pool of talent outside of the US. Our mission is to bring together the best talent and match them with excellent work opportunities based on their core competencies, skill sets, and overall experience and exposure in the different areas of audit, accounting, and similar financial-related areas. We prioritize creating a positive and inclusive workplace culture where all talents are valued and developed.

The Transactional Accountant is responsible for providing Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable and other transactions processing, Payroll processing, accounting review and reconciliation and reporting support to the team and multiple Clients. This position is responsible for learning all aspects of the practice through rotational assignments and provides support as required and includes servicing non-profit or for profit organizations with a focus on the Cannabis Industry.

Responsibilities

• Effectively complete rotational assignments in each area of Outsourced Accounting and Fractional (OAFC) Practice, including Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Payroll, Reconciliation, Compliance and Financial Reporting.

• Working with Accounting Manager, develop a plan and measurable goals for each rotational assignment, ensuring a thorough understanding and ability to deliver effective results in each segment.

Highlights may include:

Accounts Payable:

• Code invoices to appropriate GL account

• Process Client vendor invoices received for payment

• Download and code credit card transactions

• Input data into accounting system

• Review and reconcile vendor invoice and A/P ledgers monthly. Identify and track down missing items and address discrepancies.

• Prepare new vendor setup for accounts and files based on Client needs and systems

• Administer W-9s for vendor records

• Learn and master Practice tools, such as Bill.com

Accounts Receivable:

• Post customer payments timely and accurately in multiple Client accounting systems (recommended that this function and the above are assigned to different staff members when possible)

• Prepares Client Invoices for their customers

• Download and enter revenues from 3rd party applications or banks into accounting system

• Conducts reviews and monitors open receivables

Payroll:

• Process multiple Clients’ payroll weekly, biweekly or semi-monthly as required by Client. Manage set up and processing of all payroll deductions including benefits, tax and wage garnishment obligations.

• Set up and maintain accurate employee records using the Client’s system or payroll vendor. Maintain online or paper file system according to Client needs.

• Download payroll transactions if processed by 3rd party vendor for tracking and reporting.

• Prepare required periodic and year-end reporting to state and federal agencies on behalf of Clients.

• Ensure accurate and timely year-end reporting of W-2s to employees

• Learn and master Practice tools, such as ADP RUN and ADP WorkforceNOW systems.

Financial Reporting:

• Assist with the preparation of monthly financial statements and reports for clients and Boards of Directors as assigned.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting or equivalent training required.

• Previous payroll, payables, receivables and reconciliation experience desired

• Strong technology skills using Microsoft Office 2010 or later (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook at a minimum, more applications preferred)

• Experience with accounting systems, QuickBooks(desktop and online versions) and Intacct preferred

• Additional technology requirements will be communicated to candidates selected for this position and must be met on an ongoing basis.

• Strong interpersonal and relationship building skills

• Team player with a positive ”can-do” approach

• Time management skills

• Ability to work independently, with minimal supervision

• Able to learn new technology skills and systems and apply them quickly

• Timely, consistent and accurate delivery of assignments

• Demonstrated understanding of accounting practices and regulations and ability to apply them accurately

• Ability to plan and implement system and process changes effectively and accurately

• Demonstrated Client-centric approach

WFH TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Minimum Internet Speed: 50-100 Mbps

• Dedicated Home Office Area: Private, quiet workspace

• Business Continuity Plan: Power and Internet Backup is a MUST

What’s in it for you:

  • A people-centered culture with fun included among our core firm values.
  • A robust training and development program designed to help you discover your distinct abilities and use them to grow yourself and the firm.

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

A day in the life:

The Paid Advertising Specialist is responsible for supporting the execution and performance of paid advertising campaigns across their book of business, partnering closely with the lead Strategist or independently owning end-to-end strategy for a select group of core clients. The Paid Advertising Specialist is an attentive learner, eager to problem solve, and hungry to grow their technical, strategic, and analytical skills. They have great communication skills and collaborate well with their lead Strategists. They are known for their reliability and attention to detail, resulting in high-quality work delivered on time. They are actively involved in supporting reporting, optimizations, and routine campaign management. They are a self-starter when it comes to their responsibilities and manage their workflow efficiently and effectively.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Maintain flawless execution across all paid advertising platforms (Meta, Google, TikTok, etc.), ensuring accurate setup, tracking, naming conventions, and rigorous QA with zero revenue-impacting errors.
  • Operate with high ownership and autonomy, independently managing timelines, budgets, pacing, and day-to-day performance without the need for reminders or constant oversight.
  • Execute and optimize paid advertising programs end-to-end, including ad builds, optimizations, reporting, pacing, and ongoing performance monitoring.
  • Demonstrate strong strategic thinking, proactively identifying growth opportunities, forming test hypotheses, and recommending data-backed optimizations aligned to client goals.
  • Maintain a client-first mindset, consistently incorporating client objectives, constraints, and brand nuances into executional and strategic decision-making.
  • Show calm, solutions-oriented problem solving, especially during performance volatility, technical issues, or major campaign pivots.
  • Ensure accurate budget pacing and adherence to planned spend, proactively flagging risks or opportunities before issues arise.
  • Own the upkeep and execution of client testing roadmaps, including project management of next steps and prioritization of experiments.
  • Deliver on-time launches and updates for all campaigns and key deliverables.
  • Autonomously prepare and present performance reports and recaps, using clear data storytelling to communicate insights and next steps.
  • Leverage Power Digital’s Nova ecosystem, including Power Circuit and nova Creative Affinity, to inform strategy, execution, and reporting.
  • Add value beyond execution by introducing new ideas, efficiencies, frameworks, or process improvements that enhance team operations or client outcomes.
  • Utilize AI technologies to improve efficiency, performance analysis, and operational workflows where applicable.

Role Requirements:

1-2 years of digital marketing; Agency experience a plus1+ years of experience with Direct Response marketing specifically in E-Commerce; Lead Gen and B2B a plus1+ years experience with Meta or Google Ads for direct response campaigns; additional platforms a plus (TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Pinterest Ads, etc)1+ years experience leading paid advertising strategy for direct response marketing efforts1+ years experience with Google Analytics, Shopify; other technical platforms a plus1 year experience client facing and handling communicationsExcellent Excel skills with clear understanding of advanced Excel featuresExcellent data analytics skillsHighly dependable, self-starter, high energy, positive attitude with good organization, and time management skillsEntrepreneurial spirit with a passion for problem-solving, continued learning, and personal development

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Managing a full workload indicated by $20K revenue/employee
  • 90% Client Retention, evaluated biannually

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Strategically Manage and Communicate Performance Insights
  • Execute and Optimize Paid Advertising Campaigns Across Channels
  • Leverage Tools and Technology for Efficiency and Innovation

Power Digital’s people and culture are at the core of our success, which is why diversity in our team’s backgrounds and experiences are paramount. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and our employees are people with different strengths, experiences, and backgrounds, who strive to make an impact inside and outside of the workplace. Diversity not only includes race and gender identity, but also age, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, religion and many other parts of one’s identity. All of our employees' points of view are key to our success, and inclusion is everyone's responsibility.

**We support 100% remote, in-office, or hybrid work styles for anyone legally eligible to work in the U.S.

A day in the life:

The Group Director, Core is Power Digital's senior client relationship and revenue leader for a portfolio of primarily small business, founder-led clients. Your clients are often making their first serious investment in outside marketing help — the founder is usually the client, the budget is real money out of their own pocket, and a single underperforming month can feel existential in a way it rarely does at the enterprise level. You manage a higher-volume portfolio than almost any other Group Director role, and you run it the way a disciplined fund manager runs a broad, diversified book: fewer swings for the fences on any single account, more rigor in the system that keeps every account healthy. You are the executive a founder calls directly — there's no committee and no VP layer between you and the person who built the business — and the leader an Account Director never wants to let down. The roles you consistently play day-to-day are: portfolio growth owner, talent multiplier, tech forward leader and AI systems thinker.

At Power, retention is the floor, not the job. You are commercially driven first: you personally own executive relationships and expansion revenue for the top of your portfolio, and you hold your team to the same standard. In Core, that means running a scalable, standardized system — foundational packages, repeatable playbooks, and efficient triage — rather than bespoke strategy for every account, because the portfolio is wider and the margin for one-off customization is thinner than at any other tier. You coach Account Directors and their teams to operate as AI-Native Growth Directors — faster, sharper, and less buried in manual work than the role has ever required before. You decide which AI tools and workflows the division adopts. Your influence runs beyond Client Experience: you shape your Division's go-to-market position, you're a thought partner to your Managing Director and VP, and you represent Power Digital in market on how small, founder-led businesses can grow with limited resources.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own net revenue retention and expansion MRR for the division; treat expansion as the primary commercial lever of the role and own the division's monthly service expansion target
  • Personally own executive relationships across the top 10-20% of the portfolio by MRR — direct relationship, not delegated
  • Run quarterly, relationship-focused executive check-ins with top-tier accounts and 1x1 check-ins with every priority account
  • Maintain an accurate, self-owned retention forecast on a weekly basis — accountable for the accuracy of the division's retention data
  • Track vertical-specific signal such as founder engagement and responsiveness, service package utilization, and time-to-first-win on foundational packages, since a disengaged founder or a stalled quick win is often the earliest warning sign of churn at this tier
  • Diagnose risk early and install fixes, not just responses; lead or co-lead quarterly plans for the top 10% of the portfolio, weighted toward strategic outcomes over metrics recaps
  • Partner with Account Directors to build value-based, consultative business cases — expansion should drive value, not be sold
  • Identify and lead common Core expansion paths, including upsell from foundational packages into additional service lines, and efficient, template-driven expansion offers built for speed rather than custom-built proposals
  • Work with Account Directors to keep the Salesforce pipeline current and accurate — stages, forecast, and next steps updated weekly
  • Serve as the frontline for product and vertical innovation, feeding client signal into Power Circuit
  • Build and evolve vertical-relevant reporting frameworks for Core, including metrics such as time-to-first-win, founder engagement/response rate, and package-level utilization, built to work at scale across a high-volume portfolio
  • Play a key leadership role in final-round pitches for prospective clients where support is needed
  • Bring vertical point of view and executive credibility to new business
  • Partner with Sales to sharpen positioning, collateral, and win rate for the division's go-to-market
  • Directly manage Account Directors and oversee the pod that supports them
  • Coach every direct report to operate as an AI-Native Growth Director, not a task manager — faster diagnosis, more client-facing time, less manual reporting
  • Evaluate the team on Pulse sentiment, health scores, and expansion weekly — not just activity
  • Raise the floor on AI adoption — no one on the team operates the old way
  • Own hiring, staffing, capacity, and career pathing for the division; facilitate DAPs and career progression conversations
  • Practice radical candor; deliver timely, actionable feedback that accelerates careers
  • Identify and develop key talent for future Sr. Account Director & Group Director roles
  • Lead training on vertical-specific and AI-native tools, processes, and strategies
  • Vibe-codes prototypes to automate repeatable tasks, surface better insights, and test hypotheses quickly
  • Designs AI workflows for the team — builds the system, not just uses the tools; models AI-forward behavior
  • Runs Omega and Iris across the full portfolio and acts on the patterns they surface
  • Decides which AI tools and workflows get adopted, when, and how across the division
  • Owns division-level AI quality tradeoffs — where AI accelerates output, and where it must never touch client-facing work unreviewed
  • Builds and evolves Power Circuit solutions specific to the division with AI-assisted research; runs a monthly audit to confirm adoption
  • Collaborates with the innovation team on enhancements and optimizations that better serve the division's clients
  • Consulted on the division P&L and accountable for the profitability of the portfolio
  • Forecast the four pillars — Churn, Service Expansion, New Business, Efficiency — in partnership with the MD and VP
  • Use the P&L and strategic growth bets to build the business case for headcount and investment; drive efficiency through technology, AI, and process improvement
  • Own resolution of every escalation in the direct portfolio
  • Partner with Data Intelligence, Media Planning, and Activation teams to keep strategy and execution connected
  • Represent Power Digital in market — speaking, content, and client-facing points of view
  • Become the internal knowledge hub other leaders turn to for vertical and division expertise

Role Requirements

  • Department leadership and management experience required — has led Account Directors or senior marketers as direct reports
  • 10+ years of leadership experience in a digital marketing agency, with small business or founder-led client work at the AD level or above
  • Experience managing a P&L for profitable growth
  • Deep marketing fluency across a high-volume, standardized-service portfolio — foundational packages, repeatable playbooks, and time-to-value; understands where a scaled service model breaks down for an individual account and how to fix it without abandoning the system
  • Channel and program strategy expertise across a standardized service catalog — has built or overseen scalable, template-driven marketing programs, not bespoke enterprise strategy, without sacrificing quality
  • Measurement expertise: keeping reporting simple, fast, and founder-legible — time-to-value and quick-win ROI — and how to translate marketing performance into terms a first-time marketing buyer can act on, without over-engineering the analysis
  • Familiarity with the realities of founder-led decision-making — budget sensitivity tied to personal cash flow, fast decision cycles, and low tolerance for jargon or delay
  • Has presented to and pushed back on a founder or owner when the data supported it — can hold a direct, plain-language conversation about performance and expectations without an intermediary layer
  • Expertise in contract negotiation, client retention, and client growth
  • Proven track record delivering high NPS and retention metrics across a high-volume portfolio
  • Extensive knowledge of owned, earned, and paid marketing channels appropriate for small business budgets — content, SEO, paid search, paid social, and programmatic
  • Familiarity with Core-specific platforms and tools: standardized reporting and dashboarding tools built for scale, CRM systems, and lightweight marketing automation suited to small business budgets
  • Operational discipline — able to run a consistent, efficient system across many accounts rather than reinventing the approach for each one
  • Entrepreneurial spirit — energized by building, not just operating; contributes to product and go-to-market strategy, not just client management

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Primary: Meet or exceed a 60% Expansion-to-Churn Ratio (ETCR) on a trailing 3-month average

Secondary Expectations:

  • 103% net revenue retention (trailing 6-month average)
  • 100% MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue) Growth target achievement (set annually)
  • $125K in monthly service expansion pipeline creation across the division
  • +90% employee retention rate
  • Portfolio NPS at or above 8 (trailing 12 months)

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Division Business & Team Leadership
  • New Business & Service Expansion Leadership
  • Product Quality, AI & Systems Development
  • Client Portfolio Ownership

  • Base salary + commission opportunities
  • Robust Medical, Dental, Vision insurance plans with up to 100% employer contribution towards employee monthly premium
  • 401(k) plan - 4% employer contribution matching
  • Unlimited Time Off available on day one
  • Up to 4 hours per quarter for paid Volunteer Time Off (VTO) towards philanthropic endeavors
  • Fully flex work environment: full-remote, in-office, or hybrid
  • A one time $100 USD Work From Home (WFH) stipend automatically added to your first paycheck
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • 12 observed United States national holidays + 2 mental health recharge days per year
  • Unlimited opportunities for growth & leadership within a rapidly growing firm

You’ll partner closely with Revenue Enablement, Client Partnerships, Client Experience, and Business Development teams to solve business challenges, improve revenue processes, and help teams use Salesforce and data more effectively. jobs.description:
Every time you pay with a card online, tell an AI agent to book your flight, or trust an app with your data, something has to make that safe - invisibly, instantly, at scale. That’s VGS.

As a payments infrastructure platform powering enterprise merchants and agentic commerce, we enable high-growth enterprises to collect, tokenize and send sensitive data - including PII and Payment Data - while offloading the associated risk. Very Good Security (VGS) is the global leader in payment tokenization - securing over 8 billion payment tokens and powering over 80 billion API calls annually. Our modern tokenization platform operates as the silent backbone for critical transactions and elite brands, allowing our clients to innovate without constraint. We partner with the world’s largest card payment networks and cloud providers. And power some of the most recognizable AI companies, payment wallets, and enterprise retailers in the world.

We’re a rapidly growing Series C company, backed by top-tier investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Visa, Goldman Sachs, and Vertex Ventures.

Role Overview
The Director, Strategic Partnerships – Payments & Product will lead the expansion of VGS's strategic partner ecosystem - building relationships with card networks, investors, cloud providers, and emerging payments infrastructure players that directly shape our product strategy and platform capabilities.

This role blends external partner engagement with internal product collaboration. You’ll help shape our product roadmap by bringing ecosystem insights and partnership-led opportunities to life - whether through expanding our card network services, accelerating agentic tokens, or other innovative initiatives.

What you will be doing at VGS (Responsibilities)...

  • Lead and develop a team of Strategic Partnerships professionals, including direct reports, setting clear priorities, coaching performance, and building the team’s capabilities as VGS’s partnership portfolio and strategic mandate expand.

  • Own and grow a portfolio of VGS’s most strategic partnerships across payments and commerce technology, including card networks, investors, cloud and infrastructure providers, AI platforms, wallets, processors, and other ecosystem partners.

  • Develop and execute partnership strategies that advance VGS’s company and product priorities, identifying where external partners can accelerate growth, strengthen product differentiation, or open new markets and distribution channels.

  • Lead complex, product-oriented partnerships that require deep coordination across Product, Engineering, Legal, Sales, and Executive Leadership, translating strategic opportunities into executable commercial and technical plans.

  • Source, evaluate, prioritize, and develop new strategic partnerships, with a focus on opportunities that can materially influence VGS’s product roadmap, competitive positioning, or long-term growth.

  • Lead negotiations for strategic commercial and product agreements, including defining partnership structures, economics, go-to-market models, technical commitments, and mutual success criteria.

  • Drive partnerships from initial strategy and business case through negotiation, launch, commercialization, and ongoing relationship management.

  • Build senior-level relationships with partner executives and serve as a trusted strategic counterpart, identifying opportunities to expand the partnership and proactively addressing risks or areas of misalignment.

  • Establish clear goals, operating rhythms, and success metrics for key partnerships, holding both VGS and partners accountable for execution and measurable outcomes.

  • Act as the voice of strategic partners within VGS, bringing external market insights, partner priorities, and ecosystem developments into product and company decision-making.

  • Influence VGS’s broader corporate and product strategy by developing a point of view on the evolution of tokenization, payments infrastructure, agentic commerce, AI, and next-generation commerce technologies.

  • Identify emerging ecosystem shifts and translate them into actionable recommendations for VGS, including potential new products, partnerships, distribution models, and strategic initiatives.

  • Represent VGS externally with senior leaders across the payments and technology ecosystem, strengthening VGS’s position as a strategic infrastructure partner for the next generation of commerce.

What we are looking for from you (Requirements)...

  • 10+ years of experience in strategic partnerships, fintech BD, product strategy, or payments consulting

  • Understanding of the payments ecosystem—issuers, processors, card networks, wallets, and commerce platforms

  • Ability to connect technical product functionality with partner and market needs

  • Demonstrated success managing complex partnerships and cross-functional projects

  • Comfortable in ambiguous, fast-paced environments with shifting priorities and emerging technologies

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a strategic mindset and a bias toward execution

    • Nice to Have

  • Experience working closely with product or engineering teams in a platform company or fintech infrastructure provider, especially in an innovative and fast paced startup environment

  • Familiarity with tokenization, payment flows, reconciliation processes, or data compliance frameworks

  • Technical literacy (e.g., comfortable discussing APIs, SDKs, and integration workflows)

What you get from us...

• Competitive health benefits
• VGS stock options
• 401k plan, with employer matching 4% and immediate vesting (available only for US employees)
• Life & disability insurance
• Pre-tax flexible spending accounts, dependent and healthcare FSA (available only for US employees)

You will work with data engineering, data scientists, analytics, customer success and the retailers themselves. What you build are data products, and the measure of one is what a retailer does differently because of it.

This is a hands-on role. You will set direction and priorities as we roll out to hundreds of new stores, but you are also expected to know the systems well enough to be a partner in an engineering design conversation, pull your own numbers when something looks wrong, and hold a strong position in the discussions with customers.

  • You communicate complicated things crisply to people who do not share your context, including customers hearing an answer they did not want
  • You build things that outlast you, whether runbooks, tooling or documented decisions, because you would rather remove yourself as a dependency than be indispensable

What You Will Do

  • Own product direction for the full data path, from how a retailer's data arrives to what our reports say, and set the priorities where the two ends pull against each other
  • Own how customer data gets into Focal: imports, planograms, store metadata, cut-off configuration, and the chain-specific flows each retailer needs
  • Own what comes out and whether anyone acts on it: the metrics, the reporting APIs, the insight-generating agents, and the customer-facing dashboards a head office runs its week on
  • Run discovery with retailers and store colleagues, and turn what you learn into a product
  • Ship, then find out whether anyone used it, and act on the answer
  • Automate your own work with AI and share what you build with the rest of the product team

What You Need to Be Successful

  • Experience building for a hierarchy of users who need different things from the same data: a store manager, a regional director and a head of supply chain reading one dataset three ways, served by one configurable surface

What Would Set You Apart

Why Focal Systems

Joining Focal Systems means becoming part of a company that's truly making a difference in the retail world. Here's why you should consider us:

Overview

Individuals in a Client Success Management (CSM) role are responsible for the end-to-end success of a portfolio of clients, ensuring strong adoption of the Origami platform and measurable business outcomes. CSMs proactively guide client goals internally, orchestrating cross-functional teams across multiple workstreams to deliver a seamless client experience. Through data-driven insights, industry expertise, and proactive communication, CSMs align internal teams and client stakeholders to foster long-term value realization.

Starting base pay for this role is between $77,000 and $97,000. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, training, location, and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role will be eligible for a bonus as well as competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, wellness reimbursement, life insurance, and a 401(k) with company match. Responsibilities

  • Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally within a matrixed organization.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify patterns, and draw insights.
  • Technical aptitude with the ability to learn and explain complex software solutions.
  • Client-first mindset with a focus on delivering measurable value and outcomes.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

  • Ability to maintain professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.

jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA’s accelerated computing platform is foundational to modern HPC and AI.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA’s accelerated computing platform is foundational to modern HPC and AI. At the center of this platform are CUDA Core Libraries that enable developers to build fast, reliable, and scalable GPU-accelerated software.

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to advance the Python experience for CUDA Core Libraries. You will build Pythonic APIs, language bindings, algorithms, and runtime infrastructure on top of native C/C++ foundations. You will join the team building the foundational libraries, algorithms, and language/runtime infrastructure that make CUDA a speed-of-light experience for developers and AI coding agents alike.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Design and implement idiomatic Python APIs and bindings for foundational CUDA capabilities and GPU algorithms.

  • Develop and integrate the native C/C++ components that support Python-facing functionality.

  • Define reliable and efficient interoperability boundaries between Python, C/C++, Rust, and other languages.

  • Develop high-performance interfaces that minimize Python and native-language integration overhead.

  • Own features throughout their lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, profiling, benchmarking, documentation, release, and long-term maintenance.

  • Improve the Python developer experience through typing, packaging, examples, diagnostics, continuous integration, and compatibility testing.

  • Collaborate with C/C++, Rust, compiler, and runtime engineers on shared architecture and API decisions.

  • Work directly with users to investigate correctness, usability, compatibility, and performance issues.

What we need to see:

  • BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 8+ years of relevant software-development experience.

  • Strong production programming skills in both Python and C/C++; both are required for this role.

  • Experience building Python interfaces to native or systems-level software.

  • Understanding of systems software concepts, performance, concurrency, and API design.

  • Practical experience with parallel, heterogeneous, or GPU programming.

  • Experience developing production software or widely used libraries, including testing, profiling, benchmarking, packaging, and code review.

  • Ability to work independently, define project scope, and drive complex work to completion.

  • Clear written communication skills for API specifications, technical designs, and user documentation.

  • Comfort working in large codebases spanning Python, C/C++, build systems, packaging, and continuous-integration infrastructure.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Strong understanding of CPU/GPU architecture and performance optimization, with hands-on experience in GPU-accelerated stacks (CUDA C++/Python, PyTorch, JAX, Numba, CuPy, or similar).

  • Proficiency with modern C++ and GPU libraries such as Thrust, CUB, and libcudacxx.

  • Experience with compiler infrastructure and tooling, including LLVM, Clang, or MLIR.

  • Expertise in designing low-overhead interoperability between Python and native languages, including exposure to Rust in mixed-language stacks.

  • Demonstrated interest in developer tools, library design, and improving developer productivity.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
184,000 USD – 287,500 USD for Level 4; and 224,000 USD – 356,500 USD for Level 5.

jobs.title: Principal Market Development Manager - Environmental and Materials Science
jobs.excerpt: OverviewWaters Corporation is seeking a strategic and results-driven Market Development Manager to lead the growth of our Environmental and Materials Science business across the Americas.
jobs.description:
Overview

Waters Corporation is seeking a strategic and results-driven Market Development Manager to lead the growth of our Environmental and Materials Science business across the Americas. This role will be responsible for the development and execution of a comprehensive business plan that aligns with and supports the region’s revenue goals. The role spans the Waters total portfolio including instruments, consumables and application-specific offerings with a focus on environmental and materials science testing, regulatory compliance, and sustainability-driven market trends. This individual will serve as the regional subject matter expert on environmental and materials science markets, driving initiatives in collaboration with global marketing, sales, and technical teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own the development and execution of the Americas environmental and materials science business plan to achieve revenue and growth targets.
  • Analyze market trends, regulations, customer needs, and competitive activity to develop regional strategy.
  • Partner with corporate marketing and field sales teams to implement regionally relevant marketing campaigns, demand generation initiatives (seminars, webinars, user meetings, customer visits) and strategic messaging.
  • Identify and prioritize key growth opportunities, customer segments, and application areas (e.g., PFAS, Polymers, Microplastics, Semiconductors).
  • Support the sales team with market insights, value propositions, and tools that position Waters as a leader in environmental and materials science testing. Fully understand, maintain, and report on competitive activities and positioning.
  • Foster cross-functional collaboration with product management, ERA, TA and Wyatt teams, applications support, business development, and regulatory affairs teams.
  • Communicate business performance, key metrics, and progress toward budgeted goals to senior and executive management, providing insights and recommendations as needed.
  • Identify and build collaborative partnerships with key scientists and KOLs within Americas. Drive collaboration and knowledge sharing through the development of scientific networks.
  • Develop presentations for internal and external stakeholders as well as advocate for scientific content needed to support customers and sales strategies.
  • Lead Waters at key industry conferences, regulatory forums, and customer events as a thought leader and advocate for Waters analytical solutions.
  • Undertake domestic and overseas travel in support of the Americas Field Marketing organization.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of a bachelor’s degree in chemistry or environmental science or materials science
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in marketing, sales or business development
  • Strong understanding of environmental and materials science regulations, industry drivers and testing workflows using LC, GC and MS
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and execute business plans
  • Excellent communication, project management, and cross-functional leadership skills
  • Maintain professional internal and external relationships that meet Waters core values
  • Proactively establish and maintain effective working team relationships with all corporate departments
  • Self-motivated with the ability to flexibly respond to changing demands
  • Willingness to travel within the Americas region as needed (approximately 25%)

Company Description

Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) is a global leader in analytical instruments, separations technologies, and software, serving the life, materials, food, and environmental sciences for over 65 years. Our Company helps ensure the efficacy of medicines, the safety of food and the purity of water, and the quality and sustainability of products used every day. In over 100 countries, our 7,600+ passionate employees collaborate with customers in laboratories, manufacturing sites, and hospitals to accelerate the benefits of pioneering science.

Diversity and inclusion are fundamental to our core values at Waters Corporation. It benefits our employees, our products, our customers and our community. Waters complies with all applicable federal, state, and local laws. Qualified applicants are considered without regard to sex, race, color, ancestry, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, marital status (including civil unions), military service, veteran status, pregnancy (including childbirth and related medical conditions), genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, legally recognized disability, domestic violence victim status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Waters is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

Key Words

#Environmental # PFAS # Materials Science # Food #Business Development # Marketing

About the Role:

The Project Manager is responsible for the successful planning, execution, and delivery of projects within budget and on schedule. The Project Manager will work closely with clients, consultants, and internal teams to ensure project objectives are met.

jobs.description:
About Us

Simplilearn is the world’s #1 online Bootcamp provider, enabling learners around the globe with rigorous and highly specialized training offered in partnership with world-renowned universities and leading corporations. We focus on emerging technologies and skills, such as data science, cloud computing, programming, and more — that are transforming the global economy. Our training is hands-on and immersive, including live virtual classes, integrated labs and projects, 24x7 support, and a collaborative learning environment. Over two million professionals and 2000 corporate training organizations across 150 countries have harnessed our award-winning programs to achieve their career and business goals.

Simplilearn has collaborated with Fullstack Academy to leverage its widespread footprint in the US region and partnerships with Top US universities to grow internationally.

Position Overview

The Part-Time Instructor for Cloud Computing & DevOps plays a key role in delivering engaging and impactful learning experiences to adult learners enrolled in our online programs.
Instructors facilitate curriculum content, support student learning, and connect cloud and DevOps concepts to real-world infrastructure, automation, and deployment practices. This role involves teaching live online sessions, mentoring learners, providing feedback, and contributing to a collaborative instructional environment.
Classes are delivered 100% online in a synchronous format.

Key Responsibilities

Deliver live online training sessions covering Cloud Computing, DevOps, and Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) concepts.

Cover core topics including:

Cloud Computing Platforms

  • Cloud infrastructure fundamentals
  • Deployment and management of cloud resources
  • Hands-on use of:
    • Amazon Web Services (AWS)
    • Microsoft Azure
    • Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

DevOps Concepts & Practices

  • Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)
  • Automation and deployment workflows
  • Infrastructure monitoring and observability
  • Containerization and orchestration concepts
  • DevOps lifecycle and collaboration practices

DevOps Tools & Technologies

  • Jenkins
  • Git and GitHub workflows
  • Docker containerization
  • Kubernetes orchestration
  • Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
  • Ansible for configuration management
  • Monitoring tools such as Prometheus and Grafana

Infrastructure & Architecture

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC) concepts and implementation
  • Microservices architecture fundamentals
  • Serverless computing concepts and cloud-native design
  • Deployment automation and scalability best practices

Security & Compliance

  • Security best practices in cloud environments
  • Identity and access management concepts
  • Compliance and governance fundamentals
  • Monitoring, logging, and incident management

Provide hands-on demonstrations, labs, and guided project support.

Facilitate practical exercises, assignments, and real-world deployment scenarios.

Mentor learners and resolve technical or conceptual queries.

Conduct assessments, evaluations, and feedback sessions.

Maintain session quality metrics and learner engagement standards.

Collaborate with internal teams on curriculum updates and technical content refinement.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
  • 7+ years of professional experience in Cloud Computing, DevOps, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) roles
  • Hands-on expertise with one or more major cloud platforms:
    • Amazon Web Services (AWS)
    • Microsoft Azure
    • Google Cloud (GCP)
  • Strong understanding of DevOps concepts including:
    • Continuous Integration (CI)
    • Continuous Delivery/Deployment (CD)
    • Automation
    • Monitoring and observability
    • Container orchestration
  • Practical experience with DevOps tools such as:
    • Jenkins
    • Git/GitHub
    • Docker
    • Kubernetes
    • Terraform
    • Ansible
    • Prometheus/Grafana
  • Working knowledge of:
    • Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
    • Microservices architecture
    • Serverless computing
  • Familiarity with security and compliance best practices in cloud environments
  • Prior experience delivering online or classroom training preferred
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as:
    • AWS Certified Solutions Architect
    • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator/DevOps Engineer
    • Google Professional Cloud Architect
    • Equivalent cloud or DevOps certifications
  • Experience working in enterprise cloud migration or DevOps transformation initiatives
  • Familiarity with Agile and DevSecOps practices
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipeline optimization and automation frameworks
  • Experience mentoring engineers or technical learners

Key Competencies

  • Strong instructional and facilitation skills
  • Ability to simplify complex cloud and DevOps concepts clearly
  • Structured and professional virtual delivery approach
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset
  • Hands-on mentoring and learner support capability
  • Adaptability to evolving cloud technologies and automation practices

Student Support & Mentorship

Provide individualized student support during live sessions and scheduled office hours.

Maintain regular communication with students regarding progress, expectations, and milestones.

Respond to student and staff communications in a timely and professional manner.

Provide clear, constructive, and timely feedback on assignments, assessments, and lab activities.

Performance Monitoring

Evaluate student progress based on course deliverables and established grading rubrics.

Maintain accurate documentation of student performance and engagement.

Identify and escalate academic or learner performance concerns to the Lead Instructor or appropriate staff.

Support learner improvement plans and certification readiness initiatives when necessary.

Collaboration & Professional Conduct

Adhere to institutional policies and instructional team standards.

Foster an inclusive, respectful, and professional learning environment.

Serve as a role model and mentor for learners pursuing Cloud and DevOps careers.

Collaborate with instructional staff and program teams to improve the learner experience and program outcomes.

Represent the organization professionally when interacting with students, staff, and external stakeholders.

Work Schedule

Part-Time instructors typically work 10–15 hours per week depending on cohort schedules.

The total weekly part-time commitment is expected to be 8–12 hours.

Weekday - 06:30 PM CST - 09:30 PM CST (Monday, Wednesday and Thursday)

Weekend - 09:00 AM CST - 12:00 PM CST (Saturday and Sunday)

Flexibility for evening availability is required.

Compensation

The anticipated pay range for this position is $55 – $60 per hour, depending on qualifications and experience.

This position is classified as Part-Time, Non-Exempt, and employees will be compensated for all hours worked in accordance with applicable federal and state wage and hour laws.

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Appointment Setter
Full-Time | Fully Remote - Commission Only (Uncapped)

Own the First Call. Set the Standard. Protect the Pipeline.

Do you love going deep in conversations instead of skimming the surface?
Are you sharp at spotting real pain, not just polite interest?
Want to build a serious career in sales, not just make calls?

Who We Are

Profitable Tradie is a fast-growing coaching and consulting company helping plumbing, electrical, and other trade business owners across New Zealand, Australia, and North America.

Our mission is to turn great tradespeople into great business owners.

We do this by helping our clients scale through powerful sales and marketing, strong systems, high-performance teams, and solid financial strategy.

Our sales team is the engine that drives growth. And this role sits right at the front of it.

What You’ll Be Doing

As our Appointment Setter, you are not just making calls. You are the critical first filter in our sales process.

This role sits at the front of our revenue engine. You’ll speak with warm inbound leads generated by our marketing machine and conduct structured triage calls that uncover pain points, assess fit, and determine whether someone is truly ready to take the next step.

Your job is to protect our closers’ time and ensure that only high-quality, high-intent prospects move forward.

You will:

  • Conduct high-quality triage calls with warm inbound leads

  • Ask strategic, layered questions to deeply understand each prospect’s situation, challenges, and goals

  • Identify emotional drivers and real pain points, not just surface-level interest

  • Assess readiness, urgency, and suitability for our program

  • Clearly articulate how our solution could genuinely change their situation

  • Book qualified prospects into appointments with our senior closers

  • Maintain detailed, accurate notes inside the CRM to ensure seamless handover

  • Bring intensity, professionalism, and emotional intelligence to every interaction

This Role Is Crucial

This is not a smile and dial position.

You are triaging clients.

You are shaping the sales narrative.

You are setting the tone for the entire client journey.

The quality of your discovery directly impacts show rates, close rates, and long-term client success. When you do this role well, the entire sales team wins.

Who You Are

You enjoy going deep in conversation and asking better questions than most people think to ask. You’re naturally curious and confident navigating objections without being pushy or defensive. You’re energised by targets, structure, and accountability.

You take feedback well. You want to improve. You do not take yourself too seriously, but you take performance seriously.

You bring:

  • Strong communication skills and confidence on the phone

  • The ability to listen actively and ask layered, strategic questions

  • Emotional intelligence and composure under pressure

  • A competitive edge and hunger to hit targets

  • A genuine desire to build a long-term career in sales

This is a powerful entry point into sales with a clear pathway into a Setter role and eventually a Closing position. If you perform here, you earn the right to step up.

We provide structured training, real-time feedback, and a clear progression roadmap. The opportunity is real, but so is the standard.

This is where serious sales careers are built.

Why Join Us?

At Profitable Tradie, we don’t just talk about growth. We live it.

World-class sales training and development
A high-performance culture built on accountability and results
Clear progression pathways for those who prove themselves
A fun, driven team where energy and banter are part of the deal

We’re reviewing applications now.

Life is about moments. Is this your moment?

Forming Our Future together

FormFactor, Inc. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle — from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor’s products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America.

Rooted in our core values — Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People — we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.

Shift:

The regular hours for this position are day shift.

Job Description:

FormFactor is seeking an experienced Business Process & Continuous Improvement Lead to accelerate high-priority cross-functional transformation initiatives. As a core member of FORM Enterprise Transformation Group, this role will work alongside business leaders and subject-matter experts to map current-state processes, identify root causes, design scalable future-state workflows, implement improvements, and embed the ownership and operating mechanisms required to sustain results.

This is a hands-on delivery role, not a documentation or facilitation-only position. The successful candidate will combine structured problem solving, process design, controls, change adoption, data fluency, and implementation discipline across people, process, data, decision rights, operating cadence, and enabling technology.

Key Responsibilities:

End-to-End Process Transformation

  • Lead current-state discovery through interviews, process walkthroughs, data review, gemba observation, and end-to-end process mapping.

  • Identify root causes, bottlenecks, rework, unclear ownership, control gaps, data issues, and cross-functional handoff breakdowns.

  • Design practical and scalable future-state processes aligned with business outcomes.

  • Define roles, decision rights, handoffs, standard work, controls, operating cadence, escalation paths, and performance measures.

  • Develop sequenced implementation roadmaps that balance urgency, business continuity, and long-term scalability.

Continuous Improvement and Implementation

  • Plan and facilitate focused improvement workshops, root-cause reviews, kaizens, and design sessions.

  • Apply FormFactor 4C, Lean, Six Sigma, value-stream mapping, risk analysis, process design, and other methods selectively based on the problem.

  • Convert workshop outputs into implementable actions, owners, milestones, measures, and follow-through mechanisms.

  • Work directly with business teams to implement new workflows, management systems, controls, documentation, and routines.

  • Lead pilots and rapid prototypes, measure results, and refine solutions before scale-up.

Governance, Adoption, and Sustainment

  • Establish clear process ownership, control points, decision rights, escalation thresholds, and accountability mechanisms.

  • Ensure improvements include appropriate documentation, training, communication, adoption, and reinforcement plans.

  • Partner with the transformation analyst and functional data owners to establish dashboards and operating reviews.

  • Assess whether revised processes are operating as designed and coordinate corrective action where outcomes fall short.

  • Prepare structured handoff packages that transfer ownership, measures, standard work, and ongoing improvement responsibility to the function.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with business and operational subject-matter experts who provide domain knowledge and ultimately own adoption.

  • Collaborate with Finance, IT, data, operations, commercial, quality, supply chain, and other functions to integrate process, data, controls, and technology requirements.

  • Translate business needs into clear process and functional requirements for technical teams.

  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels and surface unresolved barriers and decisions promptly.

  • Build reusable process-improvement methods, standards, and lessons learned.

Key Deliverables:

  • Current-state and future-state end-to-end process maps

  • Root-cause analyses, gap assessments, and risk / control evaluations

  • Role charters, decision rights, handoffs, standard work, and operating cadences

  • Pilot and implementation plans with milestones, owners, and measures

  • Training, adoption, sustainment, and handoff packages

  • Reusable process-improvement methods and templates

Preferred Qualifications & Experiences:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, Information Systems, or a related discipline.

  • 8+ years of experience in business process improvement, operational excellence, business transformation, industrial engineering, internal controls, quality, supply chain, or related roles.

  • Demonstrated success mapping and redesigning complex end-to-end processes across multiple functions.

  • Hands-on experience implementing process changes, not only recommending or documenting them.

  • Strong facilitation, structured problem-solving, analytical, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Working knowledge of process governance, decision rights, controls, metrics, change adoption, and sustainment.

  • Semiconductor, semiconductor equipment, electronics, capital equipment, high-mix manufacturing, service, or logistics experience.

  • Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Green Belt, BPM, change-management, internal-controls, or related certification.

  • Experience with SIOP / IBP, capacity planning, manufacturing processes, supply chain, service operations, or technology transfer.

  • Experience using process-mining, workflow, analytics, automation, modeling, or visualization tools.

  • Experience working with ERP, CRM, planning, manufacturing execution, data warehouse, or reporting platforms.

What Success Looks Like:

Success means complex cross-functional processes become simpler, clearer, more scalable, and more reliable. Improvements are implemented in the business, supported by defined owners, decision rights, controls, data, metrics, and operating routines, and continue to perform after FORM Enterprise Transformation Group exits the engagement.

Skills:

Analytical Thinking, Business Process Improvements, Business Process Transformation, Business Transformation, Change Adoption, Data Metrics, Industrial Engineering, Internal Controls, Operational Excellence, Process Change Management, Process Governance, Stakeholder Management, Structured Problem Solving, Supply Chain
