jobs.excerpt: Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.
jobs.description:
Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.

At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


As Director of AI Product Marketing, you’ll shape how Genesys defines, differentiates, and takes its AI story to market. You’ll own Genesys’ point of view on AI in CX — and how that point of view gets told, proven, and sold.

You’ll translate what Product and Engineering are building into positioning and messaging that customers, analysts, and the field believe, while arming sales with the story, differentiation, and proof points to sell AI with confidence. Just as importantly, you’ll bring market, customer, and competitive insight back into the organization to help shape how Genesys leads in AI.

You’ll use deep AI fluency to bridge the gap between advanced technology and everyday value, turning complex capabilities into clear narratives that make work easier, decisions sharper, and experiences better. You’ll lead a team of Product Marketing professionals responsible for positioning, messaging, go-to-market strategy, launches, and adoption across the Genesys AI portfolio.

We’re looking for original thinking that comes from wrestling with the problem — not repeating what the last analyst report said. You’ll need the executive presence to work in both directions: credible with engineers and researchers, and clear enough with the C-suite to make complex ideas land in one meeting.

You’ll thrive in a fast-moving technology environment where the market, products, and priorities evolve quickly. You won’t be rattled by change. You’ll know when to hold the line, when to pivot, and how to keep teams aligned and moving as new opportunities emerge.

If you’re passionate about AI, energized by building differentiated market narratives, and skilled at turning bold ideas into commercial impact, this role puts you at the forefront of defining how AI powers the next chapter of Genesys Cloud.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own Genesys’ AI narrative and positioning, defining the story, value propositions, proof points, and differentiation we use to win in CX — and evolving them as the technology, competitive landscape, and buyer expectations change.

  • Translate technical innovation into customer value, turning complex AI capabilities into clear, compelling narratives that resonate across technical, business, executive, analyst, and field audiences.

  • Own the competitive narrative for AI in CX, identifying where Genesys can credibly lead, where competitors are setting the agenda, and how we create meaningful separation in the market.

  • Build a deep partnership with Product and Engineering, bringing market, customer, and competitive insight upstream to influence priorities and ensuring every major AI capability launches with differentiated positioning, customer proof, and a story the field can sell.

  • Establish an always-on AI go-to-market motion, testing new programs and channels to build mindshare, create pipeline, improve seller effectiveness, and accelerate customer adoption.

  • Build trusted relationships with executive stakeholders, driving alignment on priorities and ensuring AI positioning and go-to-market strategy support Genesys’ broader business objectives.

  • Partner closely across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Analyst Relations, and other teams to ensure consistent AI storytelling, aligned execution, and shared measures of success.

  • Turn customer outcomes into market proof, identifying and amplifying compelling AI success stories, including agentic AI use cases that demonstrate measurable business value.

  • Represent Genesys externally as an AI thought leader, engaging with customers, partners, analysts, media, and industry forums to strengthen Genesys’ voice and credibility in the market.

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of AI product marketers, setting a high bar for strategic thinking and craft while creating an environment that encourages growth, creativity, healthy debate, and collaboration.

  • Measure and continuously improve impact, using market feedback, seller input, customer insights, competitive intelligence, and performance data to refine positioning, messaging, and go-to-market execution.

  • 10+ years of B2B technology marketing experience, including significant product marketing leadership in enterprise software and experience building and leading high-performing teams.

  • Proven track record of owning positioning, messaging, launches, and go-to-market strategy for complex enterprise technology — ideally AI, cloud, data, developer platforms, or adjacent categories.

  • Deep fluency in AI technologies and where the field is headed — including agentic architectures, reasoning models, orchestration, and multi-agent systems — sufficient to speak credibly with engineers and researchers, challenge assumptions, and hold your own when the hard questions come.

  • Exceptional product marketing judgment and craft, with evidence of developing differentiated positioning, simplifying technically complex products, and creating narratives that changed customer, seller, or market perception.

  • Strong commercial orientation, with experience connecting product marketing strategy to outcomes such as pipeline, adoption, seller effectiveness, competitive wins, and market perception.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity and make sound decisions in fast-changing environments where the market and technology are evolving quickly.

  • Experience driving cross-functional alignment and influencing senior executives across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and other functions.

  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to move fluidly between technical depth and executive-level clarity.

About Food Banks Canada

At Food Banks Canada, our commitment stretches across the nation, tirelessly supporting and enhancing the work of over 5,500 food banks and community organizations. We invest in, advocate for, and bolster their critical efforts. Through diligent research, we delve into the root causes of food insecurity, devising actionable solutions informed by our findings as we work to create a Canada where no one goes hungry.

In 2024, Waterstone Human Capital recognized our workplace for embodying one of Canada’s Most Admired™ Corporate Cultures of the year. This distinction highlights best-in-class Canadian organizations with cultures that have helped them enhance performance. For us, performance means advancing our mission and achieving organizational goals collaboratively with a team that is happy, healthy and engaged.

Our efforts and impact are expanding, and we're opening doors for passionate, teamwork-driven professionals in search of a career that's both meaningful and captivating. Bilingualism (English/French) is an asset for all our roles at Food Banks Canada as we support Canadians across the country.

About the Role

The Manager, National Food Recovery Programs plays a key role in advancing Food Bank Canada’s mission by leading national initiatives that increase access to high-quality, nutritious food for communities across Canada. Working collaboratively with industry partners, retailers, and the food bank network, this role oversees the planning, execution, and continuous improvement of national food recovery programs, with a strong emphasis on building strategic partnerships and maximizing program impact. The ideal candidate brings strong knowledge of Canada’s food retail sector and is skilled at navigating complex relationships while communicating and presenting confidently to stakeholders at every level of an organization. Combining strategic thinking with hands-on program management, this role drives program growth through data-informed decision making, effective communication, and collaborative problem solving. Success in this position requires a relationship-focused professional who is comfortable balancing multiple priorities, managing program performance and reporting, and fostering meaningful partnerships that strengthen participation, remove barriers, and ultimately increase the amount of food recovered and shared nationwide.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Foster strategic relationships with program partners (including retailers), leading partnership meetings, identifying opportunities for collaboration and resources, and conducting partner engagement and training sessions

  • Manage the planning and execution of Food Banks Canada’s national food recovery programs, including the Retail Food Program

  • Work closely with key stakeholders to develop and manage program communication, marketing and training to maximize program knowledge, engagement, and participation

  • Provide ongoing analysis to proactively identify program risk and opportunities, and create greater efficiencies and deepen overall engagement of the network and program partners

  • Provide training and mentorship to food banks to strengthen relationships and increase engagement with their matched program partners; increasing the amount of food received

  • Lead program stewardship and recognition planning, ensuring activities are communicated and executed in a timely manner

  • Identify opportunities for incremental food recovery initiatives across Canada, developing effective strategies and programs needed to increase access to incremental nutritious food for the network

What You Will Need

  • Minimum 4 years’ program management, food procurement, relationship building and/or, fundraising/sales experience, with a track record of successful results and the proven ability to build and maintain donor/industry relationships

  • Completion of an undergraduate degree or equivalent in a related field

  • Strong knowledge of Canada’s retail sector

  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport and trust with retail partners, as well as internal stakeholders and team members

  • Excellent presentation and negotiation skills

  • Ability to effectively coordinate multiple projects, deadlines, and priorities

  • Strong general computer skills with proficiency in MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook)

  • Bilingualism (English/French) is an asset

Working Conditions

  • Full-time, Monday-Friday, with occasional evening and weekend work. This position is remote and may be based anywhere in Canada. Occasional travel within Canada will be required

  • Must have access to reliable transportation for travel and a valid driver’s license with a clean driving record

If this opportunity to work with an exciting, growing, national non-profit appeals to you, please apply with your cover letter and resume. Additional information on this role can be found in thefull job description.

This posting will remain open until the role has been filled.

We look forward to hearing from and connecting with you!

Food Banks Canada believes that diversity is the cornerstone of excellence within our team and mirrors the community we serve. 💼 Description du poste

DotWorld est un Venture Builder et SaaS Studio en forte croissance, opérant plusieurs produits SaaS par abonnement à l'international. Notre acquisition payante repose aujourd'hui largement sur Google, et notre diversification passe par Meta et TikTok. Sur ces canaux, le facteur limitant n'est pas le ciblage : c'est le débit et la qualité créative.

Aujourd'hui, le montage est assuré en interne par une seule personne, les media buyers briefent au fil de l'eau, et personne ne possède la stratégie créative ni le vivier de production. Résultat : une matrice d'angles limitée, pas de cadence tenue, pas de boucle d'apprentissage entre la performance d'une créa et le concept suivant. Et surtout, aucun liant avec les studios créatifs et les acteurs UGC.

C'est pour ça que nous créons le poste de Creative Strategist. Tu deviens le point de convergence entre nos media buyers (Google, Meta, TikTok), notre montage interne, et un écosystème de production externe que tu construis toi-même.

Ta mission : posséder la chaîne créative de bout en bout, sur l'ensemble du portefeuille et sur tous les marchés - recherche audience, angles, briefs, production, mise en ligne, analyse, itération. Livrer un flux constant, prévisible et mesuré de créas qui font baisser le CPA, dans plusieurs langues et plusieurs cultures.

👥 Description de l'équipe

Tu rejoindras l'équipe Growth & Acquisition, pilotée par Bastien BRICOUT, notre Chief Growth Officer, qui sera ton manager direct. Tu travailleras au quotidien avec nos media buyers Google, Meta et TikTok - dont Caroline AUDEBERT, notre Experte SEA - ainsi qu'avec notre monteur interne. L'équipe est full remote, orientée performance, avec une culture de l'autonomie et du résultat.

📂 Tes responsabilités

Stratégie créative et personas

  • Recherche audience structurée par marché : reviews produit, tickets support, verbatims, communautés locales, commentaires ads, retours des media buyers

Pilotage du vivier de production

  • Sourcing et casting de créateur(rice)s et acteur(rice)s UGC sur toutes les langues ciblées - le vivier est à construire, il n'existe pas encore

  • Briefs adaptés à la culture locale : script, ton, cadrage, décor, obligations et interdits

  • Négociation des tarifs, volumes, droits d'usage et durées de licence, avec les variations juridiques selon les pays

  • Sélection et cadrage des studios et prestataires créatifs, construction d'un réseau activable par zone géographique

  • Briefs de niveau exécution pour le montage interne : structure, timing des cuts, hooks visuels, sous-titres, B-roll, specs par plateforme

  • Arbitrage permanent entre montage interne, UGC et studio, selon coût, délai, langue et enjeu

Pilotage opérationnel et budget

  • Cadence hebdomadaire tenue et mesurée, pipeline visible de bout en bout

  • Budget de production dédié, avec autonomie d'engagement sous seuil

  • Asset management : rushes, modules réutilisables, versions par langue

Interface media buyers

  • Point de contact direct et permanent avec les buyers Google, Meta et TikTok

  • Traduction des besoins média en besoins créatifs, et inversement

  • Alignement du calendrier de production sur les cycles de test et les moments de scaling

  • Anticipation de la fatigue créative avant qu'elle ne se lise dans le CPA

Testing, data et itération

  • Framework de test créatif : ce qu'on isole, seuil de décision, durée, volume minimum

  • Analyse en autonomie au niveau créa, dans les plateformes et dans PostHog : hook rate, hold rate, CTR, CPA

  • Déclinaison des gagnants, transposition d'un marché à l'autre, arrêt des perdants

  • Bibliothèque d'apprentissages exploitable par toute l'équipe

L'IA comme multiplicateur

  • Accélérer la recherche d'angles et la synthèse de verbatims à grande échelle

  • Générer et itérer des variantes de scripts et de hooks en plusieurs langues

  • Produire des assets de test rapides sans mobiliser le pool de production

  • Localiser, doubler, sous-titrer sans repasser par un cycle de production complet

  • Industrialiser ton propre reporting créatif

⭐ Ton profil

Expérience

  • 3 ans minimum en creative strategy sur du paid social à budget significatif (six chiffres mensuels), en direct response - le brand awareness n'est pas notre sujet

  • Expérience internationale réelle : tu as déjà produit et fait performer des créas sur plusieurs marchés et plusieurs cultures

  • Tu as déjà constitué et piloté un vivier de production - sourcing UGC, cadrage de studios, gestion de prestataires. C'est le cœur du poste, pas un plus.

  • Idéalement, expérience en SaaS par abonnement ou app subscription

  • Un background agence est un vrai plus : multitasking et gestion de prestataires en parallèle

Compétences techniques

  • Lecture d'un compte Meta, TikTok et Demand Gen au niveau créa, et capacité à en tirer une décision d'itération

  • Tu as construit toi-même une matrice d'angles et un framework de test - pas seulement exécuté celui d'un(e) autre

  • Tu écris tes propres briefs et tes propres scripts

  • Usage avancé et quotidien de l'IA en production créative : recherche, scripts, variantes, localisation, doublage, assets de test

  • Droits d'usage et contractualisation UGC

  • Pilotage d'un budget de production et raisonnement en coût par créa

  • Autonomie analytics : tu tires ta lecture de PostHog sans passer par la data

  • Un réseau UGC déjà constitué et activable sur plusieurs langues est un vrai plus

  • Savoir monter toi-même une créa de test sans mobiliser le pool est un plus

Compétences interpersonnelles

  • Proactivité structurelle : tu vas chercher ce qu'on ne t'a pas demandé

  • Ownership : tu portes la chaîne créative de A à Z

  • Capacité à faire produire dans une langue que tu ne parles pas, avec un dispositif de contrôle qualité qui tient

  • Aisance à travailler avec des media buyers exigeants et à défendre un point de vue créatif par la donnée

  • À l'aise dans un environnement exigeant, orienté résultats

Compétences linguistiques

  • Français : natif ou courant

  • Anglais : B2 minimum

✅ Les avantages du poste

  • Création de fonction : tu construis le dispositif, tu n'hérites pas d'un existant

  • Périmètre large : portefeuille multi-produits SaaS, plusieurs marchés, plusieurs langues

  • Budget de production dédié, avec autonomie d'engagement sous seuil

  • Rattachement direct au Chief Growth Officer : boucle de décision courte, pas de politique

  • L'IA attendue comme multiplicateur, pas tolérée en marge

  • 100% remote Europe

  • Équipe Growth qui valorise l'expertise et le résultat

👣 Les défis du poste

  • Poste solo sur un portefeuille international : le vivier de production est à construire de zéro

  • Rythme d'entrée exigeant : un cycle créatif complet est attendu sur les 30 premiers jours, pas un audit qui s'étire

  • Périmètre multi-produits et multi-marchés : il faut savoir prioriser

  • Exigence forte sur les résultats chiffrés : le CPA est le juge de paix

📋 Notre processus de recrutement

  • Entretien culturel avec notre Head of HR & Finance, Matteo ESCLAPES - 1h

  • 2 prises de références, dont un(e) ancien(ne) Manager

ℹ️ A propos de DotWorld

Dotworld est un Venture Builder et SaaS Studio. Notre modèle est simple mais exigeant : nous concevons, lançons et scalons plusieurs produits SaaS en parallèle. Notre équipe, entièrement distribuée, évolue avec une culture forte : Test, Learn, Scale. Nous créons des outils concrets qui facilitent le quotidien de millions de personnes dans le monde entier. Aujourd'hui, notre activité est structurée autour de différents univers produits, allant d'outils RH à des solutions de gestion de contenus et de création design.

Notre approche Nous construisons des SaaS robustes, intuitifs et techniquement solides. Une fois les bases maîtrisées, nous les déployons à l'international grâce à un travail poussé de traduction et de localisation. L'accélération se fait ensuite par une stratégie d'acquisition performante, pilotée par nos expert(e)s SEO et SEA.

Ce modèle fonctionne - et il fonctionne fort

Plus de 50 millions de visiteur(se)s par an 0 levée de fonds : une croissance 100 % autofinancée Rentables dès la première année De 1 à 50+ collaborateur(rice)s en 4 ans

Une équipe autonome, engagée et exigeante Tout cela, nous le construisons en équipe. Notre force, ce sont des personnes autonomes, engagées, où chacun(e) a un vrai impact. 90 % de l'équipe travaille en remote, avec une culture fondée sur la confiance, la flexibilité et le respect des rythmes individuels. Nous cultivons un environnement bienveillant, stimulant et exigeant, où l'épanouissement individuel nourrit la réussite collective.

Une culture d'excellence Chez Dotworld, nous visons des standards élevés : qualité, rigueur et efficacité au service de l'impact. Nous sommes orienté(e)s résultats : la performance et le dépassement de soi nous animent au quotidien. L'amélioration continue, l'innovation et la créativité sont au cœur de notre culture. Chaque produit est affiné de manière itérative jusqu'à atteindre la meilleure version possible. Nous intégrons les technologies les plus récentes de façon réfléchie, pour offrir des solutions modernes, performantes et conçues pour durer.

Et la suite ? Nous recherchons des profils curieux, autonome, malins et enthousiastes - des personnes qui aiment faire, tester, construire, améliorer… tout en visant haut. 👉 Envie de nous rejoindre ? On a hâte d'échanger avec toi.

🌿 Environnement de travail

  • Des opportunités de développement professionnel : chez DotWorld, nous croyons que chaque employé(e) a le potentiel de se dépasser. Nous offrons des opportunités pour apprendre, grandir et influencer le futur de notre entreprise.

  • Une culture d'innovation : nous encourageons constamment nos équipes à penser en dehors des sentiers battus et à apporter de nouvelles idées.

  • Forte croissance de l'entreprise avec en conséquences des perspectives d'évolutions fortes dans les années à venir.

  • Tout est à créer : chaque idée, chaque initiative compte pour bâtir ensemble notre culture, nos projets et notre vision de demain.

👥 Diversité

DotWorld est une entreprise qui adhère pleinement au principe d'égalité des chances et d'accès à l'emploi pour tou(te)s. Nous croyons en un environnement de travail inclusif, où chacun(e) peut s'épanouir et contribuer à notre succès collectif, quelles que soient les identités ou origines de chacun(e). Nous remercions tou(te)s les candidat(e) pour leur intérêt et le temps qu'ils/elles investissent dans leur candidature.

⭐ Nos avantages RH

🗺️ Télétravail - Europe Travaille depuis n'importe quel pays d'Europe, en toute liberté et simplicité.

🌏 Télétravail - monde Change d'air et découvre le télétravail depuis un fuseau horaire différent pendant un mois.

🌴 Vacances sur mesure Prends les congés dont tu as besoin pour te ressourcer. On te fait confiance pour gérer ton temps libre.

⌛ Horaires flexibles Organise ton emploi du temps comme tu le souhaites, parce que ton équilibre pro/perso est une priorité.

🥳 2 séminaires par an Deux fois par an, on se retrouve en équipe pour des moments inspirants et fun : un au printemps et un à l'automne.

🌻 Nos valeurs

PERFORMANCE "Obsessed with Impact" Nous sommes une entreprise à haute performance. Nous ne confondons jamais le mouvement (être occupé) avec l'avancement (produire des résultats). Nous croyons que travailler avec des collègues excellents est le meilleur avantage social que nous puissions offrir. L'excellence n'est pas une option, c'est notre standard de base.

OWNERSHIP "Act like an Owner" Dans beaucoup d'entreprises, quand il y a un problème, les gens cherchent le coupable. Ici, nous cherchons la solution. "Ownership", c'est agir comme si c'était votre propre argent et votre propre entreprise. Il n'y a pas de "ce n'est pas mon job". Si tu vois un déchet par terre, tu le ramasses. Si tu vois un bug, tu t'assures que cela soit notifié.

INTEGRITY "We act with honesty, consistency, and professional courage." Dans une équipe, l'intégrité signifie que chacun est tenu responsable de sa performance, de son attitude et de l'impact de ses comportements sur le collectif. Nous nous soutenons, nous jouons collectif et nous prenons soin les uns des autres, tout en assumant que la confiance se construit par la fiabilité, la contribution et le respect des standards. L'intégrité, c'est dire les choses avec clarté et respect, même lorsque c'est inconfortable. C'est aligner ses paroles avec ses actes, accepter le feedback et comprendre que chacun doit mériter sa place sur le terrain par son engagement et son comportement. Nous croyons que la gentillesse sans exigence mène à la complaisance, et que l'exigence sans bienveillance mène à la tyrannie. L'intégrité est ce juste équilibre.

GROWTH "Always be Learning" Le monde change trop vite pour se reposer sur ses acquis. DotWorld est une école. Notre promesse est simple : tu travailleras dur, mais dans 2 ans, tu auras acquis 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle. Nous valorisons la courbe d'apprentissage (la pente) plus que l'expérience passée (le point de départ).

jobs.description:
About the Role

We at Innovaccer are looking for a Senior Manager, Platform Marketing to own the story of Gravity — our AI-native platform that makes autonomous healthcare operations possible — as distinct from the go-to-market for any single solution. Where each solution’s Head of Marketing sells a specific outcome to a specific buyer, this role owns how Innovaccer explains the platform underneath all of them: Memory, Intelligence, and Orchestrated Execution, and why that architecture is what makes autonomous operations reliable at all.

This is a technical and analyst-facing role more than a buyer-facing one for the platform narrative work itself — but it is not narrative-only. You also own one of Gravity’s swim lanes end to end, including pipeline accountability for it, the same model every solution’s Head of Marketing works under, just scoped to your swim lane rather than a full solution. You report to the Head of Gravity Marketing, and your work gives every solution’s story a credible technical foundation to stand on, while also being judged on the pipeline your own swim lane produces.

A Day in the Life

  • Own the platform narrative for Gravity — how Memory, Intelligence, and Orchestrated Execution work together to make autonomous operations reliable — and keep it current as the architecture evolves.
  • Own your assigned Gravity swim lane end to end — strategy, flight plan, and execution — and carry direct accountability for the pipeline it generates, the same standard every solution’s Head of Marketing is held to.
  • Translate platform capabilities into content and messaging for a technical audience: architecture briefs, analyst decks, technical whitepapers, and partner-facing materials.
  • Work directly with the Head of Gravity Marketing and Gravity’s Product leadership to make sure the platform story stays accurate as new capabilities ship.
  • Support analyst relations for the platform specifically — briefing analysts on Gravity’s architecture and technical differentiation, distinct from any single solution’s analyst conversations.
  • Partner with technology partners (e.g., NVIDIA) on joint technical narrative and co-marketing content tied to platform capability, not solution-specific campaigns.
  • Coordinate with each solution’s Head of Marketing so their solution-level pitches can draw on a consistent, credible platform story rather than each team explaining Gravity from scratch.
  • Support technical evaluators inside prospective customers — the people assessing whether Gravity’s architecture can actually do what solution teams are claiming it can do.
  • Track how competitors and adjacent platforms position their own AI/data infrastructure, and flag where Gravity’s technical differentiation needs to be sharpened or better explained.
  • Build the library of reusable technical proof points (architecture diagrams, benchmark data, security and governance documentation) that every solution team and the Head of Thought Leadership can draw on.

What You Need

  • Either of two backgrounds: (a) 4–6 years in management consulting followed by an MBA from a top-tier program, with a demonstrated inclination toward or exposure to healthcare — prior marketing experience specifically is not required, but your consulting or post-MBA work must include real go-to-market strategy engagements with a measurable commercial outcome, not case work alone; or (b) 6–8 years in marketing at an AI or AI-infrastructure company, with direct experience explaining technical architecture to a non-engineering audience and owning a pipeline number. Either path is a fit — we are not requiring both backgrounds.
  • A proven track record of being accountable for a pipeline or revenue outcome you helped produce — for path (a), this can come from consulting engagements tied to a client’s commercial results, not strategy recommendations alone; for path (b), from owning marketing pipeline directly. This is a hard requirement for both paths: general strategy or content experience with no pipeline outcome attached to it is not a fit for this role.
  • Genuine comfort with technical material — you don’t need to write code, but you need to understand enough of how an AI platform is architected (data, models, orchestration) to translate it accurately, not just enthusiastically.
  • Experience producing analyst-facing or technical marketing content: briefing documents, whitepapers, architecture narratives, or similar — not just campaign collateral.
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to make complex technical concepts clear without oversimplifying them into something inaccurate.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with Product and Engineering to keep the platform narrative technically accurate as the architecture evolves.
  • Healthcare industry exposure or inclination is a strong plus for either path — direct healthcare AI experience is ideal, but is not required if you can show a genuine, demonstrated interest in the space.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable operating with real ambiguity — this is a hands-on, individual-contributor role building a function that is still being defined.

We offer competitive benefits to set you up for success in and outside of work.

Here’s What We Offer

  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge and relax with 20 days of fixed time off per year, in addition to company holidays—because we believe work-life balance fuels performance.
  • Best-in-Class Parental Leave: Spend quality time with your growing family. We offer one of the industry’s most generous parental leave policies to support you during life’s most important moments.
  • Recognition & Rewards: We celebrate wins—big and small. Get rewarded with monetary incentives and company-wide recognition for your impact and dedication. Your hard work won’t go unnoticed.
  • Comprehensive Insurance Coverage: Stay covered with medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus 100% company-paid short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance. Optional perks include discounted legal aid and pet insurance.

Innovaccer Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued and empowered regardless of any characteristic protected by federal, state or local law including, without limitation, race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, medical condition, disability, age, marital status, or veteran status. jobs.description:
TELUS Health is empowering every person to live their healthiest life. Guided by our vision, we are leveraging the power of our leading edge technology and focusing on the uniqueness of each individual to create the future of health. As a global-leading health and well-being provider – encompassing physical, mental and financial health – TELUS Health is improving health outcomes for consumers, patients, healthcare professionals, employers and employees.

Join our team and what we'll accomplish together

Imagine shaping the future of retirement and benefits for millions of people across North America—and actually seeing your vision come to life.
At TELUS Health, we're modernizing Group Benefits Administration. We're not just updating technology; we're fundamentally rethinking how employers deliver benefits that truly matter to their workforce. From the latest compliance challenges to evolving U.S. market demands, we're building solutions that set the standard across the continent.

As Product Portfolio Manager, you'll own the strategic direction of our entire Group Benefits Administration portfolio—setting the vision, steering investment decisions, and partnering with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, Sales, and Delivery. You'll work across a complex, matrixed organization where your judgment directly influences which modernization initiatives move forward, where we take calculated risks, and how we stay ahead of regulatory and competitive pressures.

This is a senior role for someone who thrives at enterprise scale and wants to leave a lasting impact on how benefits are delivered across North America.

What you'll do

Portfolio Vision & Strategy

  • Define and maintain a unified portfolio vision that addresses the unique regulatory, compliance, and market needs across Canada and especially the U.S. Group Benefits landscape

  • Develop multi-year roadmaps that balance innovation, client commitments, modernization investments, and regulatory requirements

  • Make tough prioritization calls—deciding where to invest, what to standardize, and how to reduce platform fragmentation without losing market competitiveness

  • Work collaboratively with Product Managers and Architects to translate strategy into executable plans

Platform Alignment & Modernization

  • Partner closely with Engineering and Architecture leaders to ensure your portfolio strategy drives real, scalable platform improvements

  • Oversee large-scale client migrations and platform modernization initiatives—defining readiness gates, success metrics, and governance checkpoints

  • Drive consistency across products to reduce complexity while managing both short-term client needs and long-term platform health

Stakeholder Leadership

  • Serve as the senior product leader for cross-functional stakeholders—communicating complex portfolio topics to executives and enabling informed, strategic decision-making

  • Support channel and carrier partnerships by aligning product roadmaps with market opportunities and partner enablement needs

  • Position our solutions in the market, translating portfolio strategy into compelling client and partner narratives

Governance, Risk & Compliance

  • Proactively identify and manage portfolio-level risks—scalability challenges, data integrity, support models, and delivery risks

  • Monitor and communicate portfolio health metrics, including platform stability, modernization progress, and delivery risk

A typical week:

You'll likely spend time in stakeholder alignment meetings (working across distributed product, technology, and delivery teams), digging into business cases for major modernization investments, collaborating with your Architecture partner on target-state platform direction, and communicating trade-offs and priorities to senior leadership. You'll also work hands-on with product managers to review emerging roadmap items and with partners to understand market pressures and opportunities.


What you bring

Must-haves

  • 10+ years in Product Management, Product Portfolio Management, or Platform Leadership roles, ideally in enterprise, complex environments

  • Deep expertise in Group Benefits Administration, with particular strength and knowledge of the U.S. market, legislation, and compliance landscape

  • Proven track record leading multi-product portfolios with the ability to think and operate at enterprise scale

  • Experience overseeing modernization and large-scale migration programs, including managing legacy platforms, multi-tenant complexity, and change at scale

  • Strong executive-level communication skills and proven ability to influence across matrixed organizations with distributed ownership models

  • Sound judgment in prioritization and trade-off decisions—you're comfortable making tough calls and explaining the "why" to senior stakeholders

  • Working knowledge of North American regulatory and compliance environments, with demonstrated expertise in U.S. Group Benefits market requirements

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience supporting channel and carrier partnerships (partner enablement, alignment of capabilities to market opportunities)

  • Background working closely with Architecture or Technology leadership on platform strategy

  • Experience defining governance models and operating frameworks across product portfolios

  • Familiarity with employer, carrier, and partner ecosystems across both public and private sector markets

Ready to lead portfolio strategy at enterprise scale? If you're energized by complexity, thrive in stakeholder-driven environments, and want to shape the future of benefits administration across North America, let's talk.

Apply now or reach out to discuss how your experience aligns with this opportunity.

A bit about us

We’re a people-focused, customer-first, purpose-driven team who works together every day to innovate and do good. We improve lives through our technology solutions and foster a culture of innovation that empowers team members to solve complex problems and create remarkable human outcomes in a digital world.

Step into the world of Mrsool where convenience meets innovation! As one of the largest delivery platforms in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, Mrsool has captivated users with its unique and seamless experience, earning it the highest ratings among all major delivery platforms on both Apple's App Store and Google's Play Store.

Our cutting-edge technology, combined with a vast fleet of dedicated on-demand couriers, ensures fast and reliable delivery no matter how far or remote the location may be.

But don’t just take our word for it Mrsool is consistently rated among the highest of all major delivery platforms, earning top reviews on both the Apple App Store and Google Play Store. Our commitment to a flawless, personalized experience has earned the trust of millions across the region, making Mrsool the go-to delivery app for a generation that demands both convenience and excellence.

Whether it's a late-night craving, a forgotten item, or a special gift for a loved one, Mrsool is here to deliver, quite literally. We take pride in the convenience we offer, empowering you to get what you need when you need it, all at the tap of a button.

The Job in a Nutshell💡

Performance Analyst joining Mrsool’s Performance & Analytics team. In this role, you will transform business questions into clear, data-driven insights that support decision-making across multiple verticals including food delivery, services, and logistics. You will analyze performance trends, diagnose operational and business issues, build analytical models, and deliver actionable recommendations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, hands-on problem solving, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.
If you're eager to take on this rewarding opportunity, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today!

What You Will Do💡

  • Own analysis end-to-end across the business: scope the question, pull and validate the data, run the analysis, and land on a clear answer
  • Analyze business and operational performance across verticals; identify and quantify the drivers behind changes in orders, revenue, margin, and customer behavior
  • Run deep-dive investigations into performance trends and problems, separating signal from noise and diagnosing the underlying root cause rather than the symptom
  • Build financial and operational models to size opportunities and evaluate the impact of pricing, promotions, incentives, and product or operational changes
  • Conduct unit economics, profitability, cohort, retention, and trend analysis across customer segments, order types, and business initiatives
  • Pressure-test assumptions and business cases with data, and challenge conclusions that the numbers do not support
  • Translate analytical findings into clear, concise insights and concrete recommendations for stakeholders
  • Support a broad range of analytical projects and exploratory analysis as business priorities evolve

Requirements

What Are We Looking For❓

  • 3+ years of experience in an analytical role within technology, marketplace, operations, finance, or management consulting

  • Presenting: Can design and deliver engaging presentations, adapting the content and style to suit the audience, context, and medium.

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About DataCandyDataCandy powers gift card and loyalty programmes for thousands of merchants across North America.
jobs.description:
About DataCandy

DataCandy powers gift card and loyalty programmes for thousands of merchants across North America. Every activation, redemption and top-up provides valuable insight into how our clients are performing and growing.

We are looking for an Analytics Engineer to bring that data together and transform it into trusted, actionable insights that support our Customer Success and Account Management teams.

The Role

This is a hands-on, build role, where you will help establish and own DataCandy’s customer data foundation. You will centralise product, client, commercial and lifecycle data in Databricks, develop consistent business metrics, and surface meaningful insights through Salesforce to help teams identify opportunities, risks and priorities.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain reliable data pipelines and models across Salesforce, transaction, product, onboarding, renewal, pricing and support data.
  • Develop and maintain a governed Client 360 view connecting accounts, locations, products, commercial terms, adoption and revenue performance.
  • Define and document trusted metrics for GRR, NRR, churn, client health, time-to-value and renewal risk.
  • Develop automated client health scoring and renewal-risk triggers across the customer portfolio.
  • Surface clear, actionable client insights in Salesforce to support Customer Success and Account Management teams.
  • Prepare governed, high-quality datasets to support AI and agentic workflows.

What You’ll Bring

  • 2–4+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering or a related field.
  • Strong SQL skills and solid working knowledge of Python.
  • Hands-on experience with PySpark and Databricks, including Delta, Jobs and Workflows.
  • Cloud platform experience, with GCP preferred.
  • Experience with version control, code review, CI/CD and infrastructure as code.
  • Practical experience using AI coding assistants and agentic workflows.
  • Strong Excel skills for ad hoc analysis and reporting.
  • Strong written English and the ability to clearly document technical work.

Nice to Have

Experience with any of the following would be an advantage:

  • Salesforce data models
  • SaaS retention and customer health metrics
  • dbt
  • Payments, loyalty or B2B SaaS environments

Why Join DataCandy?

This role gives you the opportunity to help build a data foundation from the ground up and directly influence how the business uses data to manage and support its clients.

You will have the opportunity to design scalable solutions, automate manual processes and create data products that directly support business decision-making.

If you are excited by the opportunity to build, automate and create rather than simply maintain, we would like to hear from you.

Perks & Benefits

  • Compensation tied to market data
  • We reward for contribution
  • Flexible Time-off
  • We’re committed to career development
  • Work from home

Our Mission

By joining Paystone, you are joining a team that is future-focused and driven by our mission of creating Customer Driven Growth.

By helping our clients create better experiences for their customers, and in turn, motivating their happy customers to share their experiences with others, our platform creates the momentum for our clients to gain more happy customers. In other words, we win when our customers do.

Curious?

Good! We want all the curiosity we can muster. Innovation stems from observation and questioning, so be eager, be innovative, and be ready to raise the bar.

Come check us out!!



About Us

Paystone is a leading North American payment and software company redefining the way merchants engage their customers and grow their businesses. The company's seamlessly integrated suite of automated payment processing, customer loyalty, gift card solutions, and now reputation marketing, is used by brands such as Irving Oil, The Source, Global Pet Foods, Kernels Popcorn, and many of the MTY Food Group's restaurant brands. Paystone's solutions are used at over 30,000 locations across Canada and the United States which collectively process over 10 billion dollars a year in bankcard volume. We employ over 200 employees and serve as the technology partner of choice for hundreds of partners across North America.

**Paystone is an equal opportunity employer. Should you require any accommodations due to disability please let us know at the time you are selected for an interview.**

At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Forbes Advisor is hiring an AI Creative Lead to own the generative stack that turns approved scripts and storyboards into finished, on-brand video and static ads. This person is two things at once: a creative with a deep understanding of direct-response marketing, and a hands-on operator who lives in the AI tools daily. You run the back half of our pipeline, from character-locked stills through AI video, lip-sync, and voiceover to editor-ready footage, and you treat every step as a creative call as much as a technical one: what serves the story, what sells, and what will read as a real ad in the feed.

The role reports into the Head of Creative Production and partners with our Creative Directors and Editor/Designers. You know what makes a DR ad work, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, and you know which model(s) to use and why. You can hold character, wardrobe, and continuity across a whole spot, debug a broken render instead of re-rolling, and get renders through touchy platform filters. You have shipped AI-generated video that ran as paid creative, and you can tell real-ad output from output that just reads as AI.

We are a human-led shop that uses AI to move faster without diluting craft. You protect the craft bar rather than lowering it to what the model makes easy, and you stay current with a stack that turns over frequently, treating every tool pick as a short-term decision.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own generation end-to-end for paid social and native creative: character-locked stills, AI video, lip-sync, and clean generated voiceover, from approved script and storyboard to editor-ready footage.
  • Lock base characters first, then build a still per beat that references them, holding character, wardrobe, prop, and continuity consistency across an entire spot.
  • Pick the right model for each job (hero vs. volume, native-audio vs. img-to-video) and keep a live view of a fast-moving tool stack, pinning exact model versions at build time.
  • Scout, test, and onboard new models and tools as the stack evolves, and retire the ones that fall behind, so the team is always working with the best available.
  • Get renders through platform and category filters. Diagnose and auto-fix a broken render once, then escalate, and keep a running swipe of safe phrasings and prompt patterns that pass.
  • Operate and lightly orchestrate the tooling (fan-out, scheduling, asset movement) so many jobs run in parallel without a person babysitting each one.
  • Own the generative-side handoff into post: deliver organized, tagged, editor-ready clips into the DAM to the production team's standards.
  • Feed the shared learnings file (format, copy, render, and legal notes per job) and read it back at the next job's start so the system compounds instead of repeating mistakes.
  • Partner with the Creative Directors and copywriters to keep generated output on-voice, on-persona, and matched beat-for-beat to the script (AV sync).
  • Bring a direct-response creative eye to every job: push each render toward what sells, the hook, the pacing, the proof, and the turn to the offer, not just what looks good.
  • Operate inside compliance rails for our regulated categories: no better-drug or results claims, coverage/qualify framing, required disclosures, and honest routing. Hold generation to the same gate as the rest of the pipeline.
  • Manage generative tooling spend against render volume, and give the Head of Creative Production a real monthly cost model as volume scales.
  • Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, character references, templates, and workflow docs) that let editors and strategists self-serve the routine work.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 4+ years in creative production, motion, VFX, or content, with at least the last 1 to 2 years hands-on in generative AI video and image production for real deliverables.
  • A real grounding in direct-response creative. You understand how a DR ad is built (hook, problem, mechanism, proof, offer, and CTA) and can judge whether a cut will convert, not only whether it looks polished.
  • Demonstrated generative craft: a reel or portfolio of AI-generated or AI-assisted video and stills, with an honest account of what you made vs. what the model made, and (ideally) how it performed.
  • Deep, current fluency with the generative stack: multi-subject-consistency image models, AI video (native-audio and img-to-video), lip-sync, and AI voiceover. You have opinions on trade-offs, not just tool names.
  • Character and continuity discipline: you can hold a consistent character across many shots and beats, not just generate one good frame.
  • Prompt and troubleshooting fluency: you can diagnose why a render broke or a character drifted and fix it deliberately, rather than re-rolling until something lands.
  • Comfort building light automation/orchestration around the tools (e.g. n8n, Gumloop, or comparable) to fan out and move assets. You don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the glue.
  • A finishing eye: you know when AI output reads as a real ad vs. a tech demo, and you hold the line on craft.
  • Demonstrated speed and volume in a performance, DR, or high-output content environment. Comfortable shipping many cuts and variants a week across multiple categories.
  • Comfort working inside compliance rails (regulated-category claims, platform ad policy, partner brand guardrails).
  • Strong collaboration across Creative, Production, Post, and Buying, and clear written communication for briefs, prompt docs, and learnings.
  • Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in a start-up style operating environment where the tools change under you.

STRONG PLUSES

  • Generative video that has run as paid social or DR creative with attributable performance, not only brand or experimental work.
  • Concepting or copywriting experience on DR ads, so you can improve a script or angle, not just execute it.
  • Direct experience generating for regulated DR categories and getting their renders through platform filters.
  • Video editing or motion/VFX background (Premiere, After Effects, DaVinci) that lets you hand editors better material and speak their language.
  • Experience building reusable AI workflows for creative production: prompt libraries, character-reference systems, Claude Projects or custom GPTs, or agentic tooling that compounds team output.
  • Familiarity with DAM systems (Air, Frame.io, or comparable) and production project-management tooling.
  • Comfort reading performance dashboards (Looker, Tableau, in-platform reporting) to close the loop between what rendered and what converted.
  • A track record of picking up brand-new tools fast and forming a real point of view on them, because this stack turns over monthly.

Your Role

Our consultants guide our customers through complex data challenges to summit the task at hand. As a Data Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain pipelines and workflows that enable our customers to put their data to work. You will need to be able to create order out of chaos, transforming raw sources into clean, reliable, and scalable data streams.

Our ideal team members are humble, smart, and driven to ensure our customer’s success. This includes a passion to deliver high-quality results, while teaching our counterparts how to fish and grow the skills needed to support and expand upon the deliverables of our projects.

If this sounds like you, and you meet the requirements below, we encourage you to apply. If you know of someone else who would be a great fit, let us know.

Requirements

Prominence is looking for a Data Engineer with deep Snowflake experience and strong SQL and Python skills to help us build and optimize data pipelines in partnership with some of the nation's leading healthcare providers.

Our ideal candidate has built and operated production workloads on Snowflake — not just queried them — and understands how warehouse sizing, data modeling, and pipeline design translate directly into performance and cost. You should be able to build scalable data pipelines that ingest, transform, and deliver data from diverse sources (EHRs, claims, APIs, CRM) into analytics-ready structures in Snowflake. You should also be well versed in DevOps practices, integrating pipeline development with version control and CI/CD to support repeatable deployments across environments, change tracking, and appropriate approval gates. You'll work directly with client architects and analysts, so you should be comfortable explaining tradeoffs as well as implementing them.

More important than any single tool is the demonstrated desire and ability to tackle new and unfamiliar technical challenges.

This position is a full-time, salaried role with benefits. There is no relocation required. Candidates are required to have a suitable home office to operate from.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional experience in data engineering or related roles
  • 2+ years of hands-on Snowflake experience in a production environment, including:
    • Strong Snowflake development experience, including query profile analysis, query optimization, and debugging
    • Virtual warehouse sizing, scaling policies, and credit/cost management
    • Data loading and ingestion patterns (COPY INTO, Snowpipe, external stages, external tables)
    • Table design and performance features (clustering keys, micro-partition behavior, materialized views, Time Travel, zero-copy cloning)
    • Snowflake security model: roles, grants, and RBAC hierarchy design
  • Proficiency in Python (or another programming/scripting language such as Scala or Java)
  • Experience building transformation and orchestration logic in Snowflake using one or more of the following:
    • dbt
    • Snowflake Streams and Tasks, or Dynamic Tables
    • Snowpark (Python)
    • Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or another orchestration framework
  • Solid grounding in ETL/ELT principles, dimensional and data-vault-style modeling, and data warehousing concepts
  • Experience with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including storage and networking basics as they relate to Snowflake integrations

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience handling PHI in Snowflake: dynamic data masking, row access policies, tagging, and HIPAA-aligned account configuration
  • SnowPro certification (SnowPro Core, or SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer)
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and DevOps workflows, including schema migration tooling (schemachange, Flyway, Liquibase, or dbt-native deployment)
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code, particularly the Snowflake Terraform provider
  • Experience with Snowflake Secure Data Sharing, the Snowflake Marketplace, or reader accounts
  • Familiarity with Snowflake Cortex AI functions, Streamlit in Snowflake, or Iceberg tables
  • Experience with real-time/streaming ingestion into Snowflake (Kafka connector, Snowpipe Streaming, Kinesis, Pub/Sub)
  • Experience migrating workloads to Snowflake from legacy platforms (SQL Server, Teradata, Oracle, Netezza, Redshift)
  • Exposure to other cloud data platforms (Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift) and the ability to speak to how they compare

Success Criteria

  • Highly organized; able to manage multi-faceted work streams.
  • Self-motivated; able to manage schedules, meet deadlines, and monitor your personal work product.
  • Highly adaptable; able to acclimate quickly to new project assignments and work environments.
  • Creative; not paralyzed by problems and able to work collaboratively to find novel solutions.
  • Clear communication skills; ability to convey messaging in clear and concise written and verbal communications.
  • Ability to anticipate issues before they arise and escalate effectively.
  • Passion to mentor and guide others.

Benefits

Prominence is dedicated to hiring the best and brightest minds in healthcare, and maintaining a culture that rewards our employees for following their passion. You’ll join a team of highly motivated and passionate people who do great work for the nation’s leading healthcare organizations, including 7 of the top 10 academic medical centers. We strive to create the best working environment with the best team, so that we can continue to drive innovation in healthcare faster.

  • Our 2 nodes of business: Analytics and Epic Services - offer you a diversified career path, stability in a rapidly changing market, and opportunities for growth within Prominence.

jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a Field Application Scientist, ideally to be based in the San Diego area at SPT Labtech. You will be part of the global FAS team which serves as the key interface between the sales team, Marketing and end-users and will provide expert-level support for our liquid handling suite of products.

About us:

Based in Melbourn, near Cambridge, UK, SPT Labtech makes products that transform the way scientists work. For over two decades, our expert scientists, engineers and business innovators have provided scientists with world-leading, innovative solutions for liquid handling, sample preparation, and sample management that help accelerate research and make a real difference to human health. We work collaboratively with our customers, building trusted relationships that enable us to deliver exceptional, personalized experiences designed for real-world challenges in the lab.

Want to be part of a team that’s making a difference to human health?

About the role:

We are looking for a personable, well-organized scientist with a strong background in at least one, and interest in all of the applications in which our instruments are used. The role will require significant travel throughout the Southwest USA, with occasional travel to the East USA and our UK headquarters. The role requires working with colleagues from across multiple time zones and territories, requiring some flexibility in meeting schedules, but as our FAS team are home-based, there will be flexibility in scheduling appointments with customers and colleagues, allowing for a balance in work and personal responsibilities.

The FAS responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

Pre-Sales

  • Organize and run product demonstrations on all SPT Labtech liquid handlers.

Subject Matter and Instrument Expertise

  • Maintain a high-level operational knowledge of our liquid handling products.
  • Maintain high level of subject matter knowledge in relevant application areas.
  • Provide on-going subject matter expertise support to FAS and Territory Management teams.

Training and Support

  • Arrange and provide applications-based training to new and existing users of all SPT Labtech and Apricot liquid handling instruments.
  • Provide on-going remote and in-person applications support to end-users.
  • Develop, modify, and enhance advanced liquid handling and automation protocols to optimize client operations.

Internal Support

  • Contribute to conference strategy and attend conferences.
  • Maintain Salesforce recordkeeping.

Marketing

  • Seek and deliver a targeted amount of marketing content in the form of customer-driven applications notes, webinars, and conference-presentations, including posters
  • Participate in strategic collaborations to regularly deliver scientific content for marketing.
  • Collect customer feedback (product development, software, etc).
  • Maintain positive customer relationships.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to Associate FAS, as needed.

Skills & Attributes

  • MSc with at least five years’ practical experience or a PhD and at least two years practical experience in a Biological Science discipline, liquid handling, laboratory automation or related field in an industry or academic environment.
  • Working knowledge of NGS methods used in research, with experience using liquid handling and automation being preferable (HTS, Assay Development, or molecular or structural biology backgrounds will also be considered)
  • Experience with workflow optimization in genomics, drug discovery, and structural biology.
  • Good understanding of genomics, drug discovery, and structural biology.
  • Practical experience with genomics/molecular biology is desirable.
  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively (up to 75%), including internationally.
  • Amiable personality; excellent organizational, analytical, troubleshooting, record-keeping, and communication skills; professional demeanour.
  • Previous experience in field applications, teaching, marketing or customer service a plus.
  • Leadership ability with a demonstrated record of mentorship.
  • Ability to work efficiently and both independently and within a team structure.
  • Ability to work toward corporate goals.
  • Excellent presentation and training skills.

Our commitment to you:

You will be collaborating with talented professionals in a motivated and driven team.

We offer a competitive salary package, performance-related bonus and comprehensive, valued benefits, including private medical insurance.

We embrace diversity and inclusivity, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, physical ability, or family status. We prioritise supporting our employees' diverse needs as we strive for excellence together.

If the above resonates with you, apply with an up-to-date Resume and be a part of our journey to reshape the future of science.

Product Research & Presentations

The Strategic Solutions Architect is the builder behind Sales Engineering's demo experience. You'll develop deep, cross-platform expertise in how Alkami's demo tooling works today — across every product line — then partner directly with Sales Engineers and Sales Leadership to understand where it's falling short and where the opportunity is. From there, you own it: designing, building, and maintaining what that tooling should look like tomorrow, front end and back end.
This is a builder and strategic-thinker role, not a release-management seat. Day-to-day demo environment operations are already supported by another role; your mandate is to implement & build and own the next generation of the tooling itself. AI will be central to how you work — you'll use AI-assisted development to build and iterate quickly, and you should already be genuinely fluent with AI tools, not just aware of them.
The role is primarily behind the scenes, but not exclusively. When a deal calls for it — a prospect wants to dig into MANTL's API, Alkami's SDK, or a complex integration — you'll step in directly and go toe-to-toe with technical leaders at the financial institution. That combination of deep builder and credible technical voice in the room is what makes this role valuable.
If you want to make a direct, visible impact on Alkami's win rate — primarily by owning the tools that make every SE's job easier, and occasionally by being the technical closer a deal needs — this is that role.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Build deep, cross-platform expertise in Alkami's demo tooling — how it works today across every product line, front end and back end

  • Partner directly with Sales Engineers and sales leadership to surface pain points, gaps, and goals for improving or rebuilding demo tooling

  • Design, build, and maintain the next generation of demo tooling that closes those gaps, using AI-assisted development to move quickly

  • Step into active deals when a prospect needs deep technical depth — going toe-to-toe with technical leaders at financial institutions on MANTL's API, Alkami's SDK, or complex integrations to remove technical blockers

  • Serve as the SE org's go-to technical resource for demo tooling questions and complex configuration or capability problems

  • Identify product limitations, design pragmatic workarounds, and feed field signal back into long-term platform strategy

  • Coach and upskill Sales Engineers on technical positioning and objection handling grounded in what the tooling can and can't do

  • Quantify this role's contribution to win rate by tracking outcomes and reporting where recurring technical gaps warrant permanent product investment

  • Model and champion AI-assisted development workflows across the SE org, consistent with the team's automation standards

Recommended Experience & Education

Minimum Years of Experience

6–10 years in solutions engineering or software development roles, with demonstrated hands-on experience building tools, prototypes, or internal platforms against APIs, SDKs, or extensibility frameworks, and comfort operating in customer-facing or pre-sales settings when needed.

Education Level

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field

Knowledge, Skills, & Qualifications

Required

  • Hands-on proficiency in one or more modern languages (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Python) sufficient to build and ship both front-end and back-end tooling independently

  • Deep working knowledge of API and SDK design, authentication, and extensibility frameworks, with the ability to speak to it credibly and in depth with highly technical audiences

  • Genuine, hands-on fluency with AI-assisted development tools and workflows, with a track record of using them to build and iterate faster

  • Working proficiency in SQL and relational databases, able to construct and troubleshoot complex queries

  • Ability to synthesize input from multiple stakeholders into a coherent technical roadmap

  • Strong presentation and consultative skills in front of senior technical stakeholders, including the ability to hold your own with technical leaders (engineering, IT) at financial institutions

  • Ability to independently evaluate an existing technical stack or toolset across multiple products and make build, buy, or improve recommendations

  • Comfort stepping into an active deal on short notice to answer deep technical questions on APIs, SDKs, or integrations, then stepping back out

  • Experience partnering with Product and Engineering to escalate and prioritize technical gaps surfaced from the field

  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value narratives

Preferred

  • Experience in digital banking or financial services platforms

  • Direct experience building on an SDK or extensibility framework

  • Experience building internal tools or platforms used by other teams, rather than only customer-facing product

  • Track record standing up net-new tooling or infrastructure from scratch (a “0-to-1” builder background)

  • Exposure to competitive analysis and solution positioning strategies

About Us

Videojet Technologies, Inc. is the global leader in the manufacturing of coding, printing and marking products. This high technology product prints variable information, such as expiration dates on grocery products, packaged goods, pharmaceuticals or catalogues. Our industry is pivotal in ensuring end users consume their food, beverage and pharmaceutical products safely. As the market share leader, we have operations in over 30 countries with 4,000 employees worldwide. A wholly owned subsidiary of Veralto, Videojet is the core of the $1 billion Product Identification Platform. We offer a results-oriented, multicultural environment that promotes both diversity and inclusion throughout the organization, team-centered, customer-focused and quality-focused, guided by the successful Veralto Enterprise System. Working at Videojet gives you access to a robust career development process and exciting opportunities.

Our Core Values

We empower creativity and ground-breaking thinking to help us uncover breakthrough solutions and accelerate the pace of innovation. We believe with conviction that diversity helps us uncover more powerful customer insights and ultimately creates an advantage in the markets we serve. And we would love to have you join us!

Your Challenge

This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast-growing organization. In this role, you will support internal projects and implement technology solutions for the Digital & Technology Solutions (DTS) organization, working with Salesforce and other business applications as the technology landscape evolves in the coming years. You will partner with teams across the business to improve process efficiency, drive revenue and profitability, enhance customer support, and strengthen the technology that enables Videojet’s commercial functions.

You will support leadership-led initiatives to enhance business systems, tools, and processes. Success in this role requires the ability to evaluate technical solutions and assess their fit within Videojet’s IT infrastructure, manage product-related work while meeting project timelines, and communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders. A strong aptitude for learning and developing expertise in these systems is essential.

Your responsibilities as a DTS Business Analyst at Videojet include:

Project Coordination

  • Coordinate between local service and commercial business teams, integration systems, and global development teams to successfully launch Salesforce projects and maintain post-launch support.
  • Coordinate positive and fruitful interaction between various business stakeholders and functional teams to deliver results.
  • Guide and oversee project contributors’ work, provide feedback, and execute strategically towards business goals.
  • Be the representative of the global IT team and coordinate with the local regional businesses and DTS teams to ensure two-way communication and cooperation.

Business Support

  • Develop new and/or adapt existing SOP, standard work, and training for the local business organizations.
  • Assist in creating, monitoring, and driving KPIs to increase productivity through Salesforce reports and dashboards.
  • Be the local subject matter expert for Salesforce to drive continuous improvement, productivity, revenue growth, and cost reduction.

Systems Development

  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications while incorporating system constraints and balancing cost-reward relationships
  • Develop new features, bring in new/emerging technology, and enhance existing features to increase the functionality of business applications and other system environments
  • Create and modify logic-based business rules, email alerts, and process flows to support continuous improvement and increased automation initiatives
  • Understand the user’s experience and predict use-cases to architect and implement usable solutions across multiple organizations, systems, and tools

Systems Support

  • Provide technical & software support for local Salesforce users for Salesforce applications
  • Develop and implement reporting mechanisms for key business metrics and provide analytical support for users in order to identify and collect growth opportunities

Systems Administration

  • Develop and/or enhance Standard Work and Auditing activities revolving around data collections, data integrity, and data compliance
  • Assist the local business in the set-up, on-boarding, and training of new users and managers
  • Management of mobile-device imaging, deployments, and inventory/spare stock
  • Analysis and optimization of systems-related operating expenses and expenditures
  • Maintenance of localized customizations and functions

We are looking for a professional who has:

  • 3-5 years relevant experience and superior understanding of new, emerging, and existing technological capabilities in software and IT, and ability to apply solutions within Videojet
  • Successfully deliver results while quickly adapting to changing priorities and unforeseen challenges
  • Ability to work in a global environment, with team members and users around the world
  • Highly computer literate and internet savvy (Excel, browser, search engine, web applications and technology in general)
  • Strong deductive reasoning and quantitative analysis. Analytical approach to provide hands-on troubleshooting and issue resolution
  • Previous experience in Salesforce required. CRM and/or ERP experience desired (Oracle, Navision)
  • Experience in requirement gathering, translating requirements to functional design documents and the development and execution of tests. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
  • A focus on the user and the user experience and solid understanding of how to run user tests and perform user research
  • Some programming and/or SQL-related coding experience desired
  • Fluency in written and spoken English is required.

Role Location:

  • Hybrid or remote-based at any of the Videojet locations in India.
  • 20% travel would be required for work events, seminars, or other trade events.

Our offer

Being part of a dynamic team in which there is a high focus on delivering results and continuous improvement, but also where having fun and teamwork are very important. It's a fast-paced environment, a consultative role, where you will get to partner with people to achieve their strategic business goals.

You will work in a leading global company, with a manager who cares about you, your strengths and will help you to develop the best possible version of yourself.

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve.Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.
