jobs.title: Team Lead Customer Service (m/w/d)
jobs.excerpt: Client Enablement & Care (CEC) ist die Serviceeinheit für finanzen.
jobs.description:
Client Enablement & Care (CEC) ist die Serviceeinheit für finanzen.net zero und finanzen.net. Wir begleiten unsere Kundschaft bei allen Anliegen rund um Depot, Wertpapierhandel und unsere Produkte – von alltäglichen Fragen bis hin zu komplexen Sachverhalten und Beschwerden.

Unsere Abteilung wächst. Wir entwickeln Strukturen, optimieren Prozesse und verbinden hohe Servicequalität mit modernen Technologien. Dabei setzen wir auf klare Verantwortlichkeiten, kurze Entscheidungswege und Führungskräfte, die Veränderungen nicht nur begleiten, sondern aktiv gestalten.

Unser Anspruch: Quality First. Human Always. AI Enabled.

Als Team Lead Client Enablement & Care übernimmst du die fachliche und disziplinarische Führung eines Serviceteams mit perspektivisch 10 bis 12 Mitarbeitenden. Du berichtest direkt an den Director Client Enablement & Care und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Serviceorganisation maßgeblich mit.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Führung und Mitarbeiterentwicklung: Du übernimmst die fachliche und disziplinarische Verantwortung für dein Team. Mit klaren Erwartungen, regelmäßigem Feedback und individuellem Coaching förderst du Leistung, Eigenverantwortung und persönliche Entwicklung. Du schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem Menschen gerne Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam erfolgreich sind.

  • Operative Steuerung und Performance: Du verantwortest die qualitative und quantitative Leistung deines Teams. Anhand relevanter Kennzahlen wie Service Level, Erstlösungsquote, Qualitätsbewertungen und Zufriedenheit der Kundschaft erkennst du Entwicklungen frühzeitig, leitest Maßnahmen ab und stellst deren nachhaltige Umsetzung sicher.

  • Qualität und Wissensmanagement: Du etablierst ein gemeinsames Qualitätsverständnis und stellst sicher, dass dein Team fachlich und prozessual auf dem neuesten Stand bleibt. Gemeinsam mit unserem Quality Management entwickelst du wirksame Coaching-, Schulungs- und Feedbackformate.

  • Prozessoptimierung und Automatisierung: Du hinterfragst bestehende Abläufe, identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den relevanten Schnittstellen effiziente, skalierbare Lösungen. Dabei berücksichtigst du insbesondere die Zusammenarbeit mit der Baader Bank.

  • KI und digitale Weiterentwicklung: Du begleitest den Einsatz KI-gestützter Technologien und moderner Servicetools. Du erkennst sinnvolle Anwendungsmöglichkeiten, förderst die Akzeptanz im Team und stellst sicher, dass Technologie unsere Mitarbeitenden unterstützt, ohne die menschliche Verantwortung zu ersetzen.

  • Organisationsentwicklung und Zusammenarbeit: Du wirkst aktiv am weiteren Aufbau unserer Abteilung mit, beteiligst dich an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten und arbeitest eng mit Produktmanagement, IT, Compliance und weiteren internen sowie externen Schnittstellen zusammen.

  • Recruiting und Teamaufbau: Du begleitest die Auswahl und Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender und entwickelst eine leistungsfähige Teamstruktur, die sowohl unseren Qualitätsansprüchen als auch unserem Wachstum gerecht wird.

  • Du kannst Menschen führen und entwickeln. Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung in der fachlichen und disziplinarischen Führung von Service- oder Customer-Care-Teams mit. Du setzt klare Erwartungen, triffst Entscheidungen und verstehst es, unterschiedliche Persönlichkeiten zu motivieren und weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du kennst die Finanzwelt. Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse im Banking- oder Brokerage-Umfeld, idealerweise aus dem Service eines Online-Brokers. Wertpapierprodukte, Handelsprozesse und die Bedürfnisse privater Anlegerinnen und Anleger sind dir vertraut.

  • Du verstehst regulatorische Anforderungen. Du bist mit den grundlegenden Anforderungen an Kundenkommunikation und Beschwerdemanagement in einem regulierten Finanzumfeld vertraut. Kenntnisse der relevanten Vorgaben aus WpHG und MiFID II sowie eine entsprechende Sachkunde sind von Vorteil.

  • Du denkst analytisch und handelst lösungsorientiert. Du steuerst anhand relevanter Kennzahlen, erkennst Optimierungspotenziale und übersetzt Erkenntnisse in konkrete Maßnahmen. Erfahrung mit Ticketsystemen, idealerweise Zendesk, und der Personaleinsatzplanung ist wünschenswert.

  • Du gestaltest Veränderung. Du hast Freude daran, bestehende Strukturen weiterzuentwickeln und neue aufzubauen. Du begegnest Automatisierung und künstlicher Intelligenz mit Neugier, Pragmatismus und einem klaren Blick für ihren tatsächlichen Mehrwert.

  • Du kommunizierst klar und verbindlich. Du gibst Orientierung, sprichst auch schwierige Themen offen an und arbeitest konstruktiv mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammen. Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und gute Englischkenntnisse.

Bei uns triffst Du auf ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit über 250 Kolleg:innen, das von Vertrauen, Flexibilität und echter Zusammenarbeit geprägt ist, ergänzt durch bis zu 15 Tage Workation innerhalb der EU pro Kalenderjahr.

Deine persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung fördern wir aktiv durch Trainings, Seminare und Konferenzen in den dynamischen FinTech- und Aktien/Finanzumfeld. Dabei legen wir großen Wert auf ein offenes Miteinander, Teamspirit und gemeinsame Erfolge.

Diese Benefits erwartet Dich außerdem:

  • Moderne Office Hubs

  • Weiterbildungsangebote im Bereich Finanzmarkt/Geldanlage

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events & starke Unternehmenskultur

  • Gesundheits- & Mobilitätsangebote (Jobrad, ÖPNV-Zuschuss)

  • Attraktive finanzielle Benefits & weitere Extras

Ein Umfeld, in dem Du Dich einbringen, weiterentwickeln und wohlfühlen kannst.

Die Finanzen.net Gruppe ist ein innovatives FinTech-Unternehmen, das private und professionelle Anleger bei ihren Investitionsentscheidungen unterstützt.

Zur Gruppe gehören:

  • finanzen.net – eines der führenden Finanzinformationsportale in der DACH-Region
  • finanzen.net ZERO – ein Neobroker für kostengünstigen Wertpapierhandel
  • TraderFox – ein Anbieter von Finanzinformationen und Trading-Tools für semi-professionelle Investoren und die, die es werden wollen

Unsere Vision ist:

We strive to be the best partner for our customers on their investment journey

Anfang 2025 wurde die Finanzen Gruppe von Inflexion, einer führenden europäischen Private-Equity-Gesellschaft im Mid-Cap-Segment, übernommen. Inflexion unterstützt ambitionierte Management-Teams dabei, wachstumsstarke Unternehmen weiterzuentwickeln und nachhaltig zu skalieren.

Im Zuge der Übernahme werden die bislang eigenständig geführten Geschäftseinheiten strategisch zusammengeführt. Durch diese Neuausrichtung und die starke Innovationskraft der Gruppe entstehen neue Wachstumschancen, um die Marktposition als führende Investment-Plattform weiter auszubauen.

Um die Wachstumsstrategie und das Wertsteigerungsprogramm erfolgreich umzusetzen, suchen wir engagierte Talente, die diesen Wandel aktiv mitgestalten möchten.

Flexibilität trifft Teamgefühl. Mehrmals im Jahr treffen wir uns vor Ort für Workshops, Team Events, etc. in Karlsruhe.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Agentic AI
jobs.excerpt: Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop.
jobs.description:
Steer offers a suite of software tools for today's automotive repair shop. We combine a mix of software tools that a repair shop needs to run a highly profitable shop, in one user-friendly, cost-effective platform. Through the Steer suite, we allow the shop owner to get back to focusing on what matters, and to stop worrying about marketing and customer retention.

Steer began as an online directory for drivers to find a local mechanic. Fast forward to today, Steer has launched a complete Customer Relationship Management (CRM) marketing suite, complete with text messaging, email automation, direct mail integration, reputation management, appointment reminders, declined/recommended services, and many other features. We are always innovating and we are proud to be a leader in the automotive repair industry. In August 2024 Steer acquired AutoOps - the leader in modern, intelligent, and fully integrated scheduling software for auto repair shops. AutoOps allows customers to smoothly schedule through a shop's website and Google Business Profile.

About the Role

We're growing our world-class engineering team to usher our CRM platform into the next generation of software — and we're looking for a Principal Engineer, Agentic AI to join our Core Platform Team

Most Lead roles at "Big Tech" companies involve maintaining a single microservice or acting as a small cog in a 100-person machine. At Steer, you aren't just a contributor; you are the architectof a platform aiming for 100% market dominance. This is a high-impact role for someone who doesn't just write great code, but who can see around corners, challenge conventions, and lead entire products from vision to launch.

We are actively refactoring our existing teams to be agentic-first — meaning our engineers don't just use AI as a tool, they architect systems around autonomous, AI-driven workflows. This is not a future initiative; it is how we build today.

We’re looking for builders who bring exceptional focus, ownership, and commitment to their work. At Steer, we want engineers who are “all in” on our mission, fully engaged with their work, and invested in our shared success. This means making Steer your primary professional focus and bringing the dedication and accountability needed to deliver exceptional results.

Why Steer?

  • True Ownership: You will lead massive products from start to finish within lean, high-velocity teams.
  • Hyper-Growth & Vision: We are currently at a fraction of our total addressable market in the automotive industry. The potential for scale is massive, and you will be a leading developer shaping this space
  • Freedom to Innovate: You don't need side projects to explore new techniques. We provide the autonomy and the platform to experiment with and implement the latest tech directly into our core product.
  • AI-First & Agentic Culture: We are refactoring our teams to be agentic-first. We prioritize high-level problem-solving and AI/LLM expertise, and we actively encourage the use of AI tools to accelerate coding across any language and to power autonomous production workflows.

What You’ll Do

  • Technical Strategy & Ownership: Focus on the core components of the Steer CRM, specifically optimizing how we ingest and process data to revolutionize our automation tools.
  • Architectural Vision: Lead the design of reusable full-stack components and services that ensure our platform remains performant as we scale toward market dominance.
  • Adaptive Development: Pivot at a moment's notice based on evolving business needs, shifting focus between new integrations and core infrastructure to keep our ecosystem seamless.
  • Customer-Centric Engineering: Partner closely with Product to understand user pain points, ensuring every architectural decision adds tangible value to the auto repair shops we serve.
  • Code Excellence: Champion best practices in security, test automation, and maintainability. Conduct deep-dive code reviews that elevate the entire engineering organization.
  • Modern DevOps & Agentic Infrastructure: Influence our CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and IaC practices. Design and maintain AI-integrated, agentic-ready infrastructure that enables autonomous workflows.

What You Have

Must Have:

  • 7+ years of professional experience building complex, web-based SaaS products.
  • The “All-In” Mindset: A deep commitment to Steer’s mission and success. We look for engineers who take exceptional pride in their work, hold themselves to high standards, and demonstrate full ownership and accountability for their projects. They approach complex, seemingly impossible challenges with determination, proactively drive solutions, and are committed to delivering exceptional results in a fast-paced environment.
  • AI & LLM Integration: Hands-on experience working with LLMs and prompt engineering. You use AI to bridge gaps and accelerate development.
  • AI in Production: Proven experience deploying AI-powered features and autonomous (agentic) workflows in production-grade infrastructure.
  • AI-Driven CI/CD: Hands-on experience integrating AI tooling into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., automated code review agents, AI-assisted testing, or agentic workflow orchestration).
  • Database Expertise: Proficiency with both relational (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) databases, including schema design and query optimization.
  • Exceptional Communication: The ability to translate complex technical concepts into product outcomes and collaborate effectively with leadership.

Nice to Have:

  • Familiarity with our current stack: .NET, Node.js (TypeScript), and React.
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, CloudFormation).
  • Previous experience as a founding engineer or in an early-stage startup environment.
  • Experience building or integrating with Claude marketplace plugins (Anthropic ecosystem), including prompt chaining, tool use, or MCP integrations.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screen — 30 min with Lead Recruiter
  2. Hiring Manager Interview — 60 min with the Head of Engineering & Product
  3. Technical Interview — 60 min with a Principal Engineer
  4. Collaborative Interview — 30 min with Lead Product Manager

What We Offer

  • Equity Options: Own a piece of the company's success.
  • 100% Remote: Work from anywhere in the US.
  • 100% Employer-Paid Medical Insurance.
  • Flexible PTO: With a 15-day minimum.
  • FSA, HSA, and 401k options.
  • Learning Stipend & WFH Equipment: Everything you need for a world-class home office.
  • Innovative Culture: A seat at the table to influence the latest AI technology in a collaborative, agentic-first environment.

Why Join Steer?At Steer, we align our mission of transforming the auto repair experience for shop owners and their customers with your passion for growth, innovation, and excellence.

Here, you’ll find opportunities to expand your skills, take on career-shaping challenges, and contribute to the future of the auto repair industry, all while enjoying comprehensive benefits and flexible work arrangements to support your well-being.

Join Steer to be part of a forward-thinking, flexible, and collaborative culture where you are empowered to do meaningful and impactful work.

We value diversity and believe that forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We welcome applications from those with diverse backgrounds and industries.

Our hiring process looks beyond just credentials. The school you went to at 18 doesn't define your potential to thrive and enrich our culture. Even if you don't meet every requirement, we invite you to apply.

  • Act as a bridge between art, engineering, and production.

  • Collaborate with distributed teams and external development partners.

A forward-thinking services company at the forefront of AI-native engineering. We partner with enterprise clients to design, build, and run production systems in which AI is a first-class engineering capability, engineered into the product and into the way our teams build it. Our engineers embed deeply with customers, own the code they ship, and move work past experimentation into operational reality.


You are:


An engineer who builds across the stack: front end, APIs, services, data, and the infrastructure it runs on. You take ownership of a feature through to production, including the parts that sit outside your strongest layer, and you have shipped software that real users depend on. You can explain the design decisions behind your work and what you would do differently.

AI is part of how you work. You use AI tools daily to generate, test, debug, and document code, and you have built at least one production feature in which a model performs meaningful work. You understand what it takes for a system to hold up under production load, security review, and real users.

You'll grow into an engineer who can own an entire system, developing depth in cloud, security, data, and agentic engineering alongside senior engineers who remain hands-on in the code with you.


The Work:


You'll work as part of a client-embedded engineering team, taking real features from design through production. You will be handed problems to solve, and you will be expected to ask precise questions, make progress under ambiguity, and put working software in front of stakeholders quickly.


Build Across the Stack

  • Build and ship production features across front end, APIs, backend services, integration, and data, taking a feature end to end across every layer it touches.

  • Develop, containerize, and deploy services on a major cloud platform using Docker, Kubernetes or serverless, and managed cloud services.

Work With Data and Context:


  • Design and implement the data access your features need across relational and non-relational stores, APIs, object storage, and event platforms.

Build AI Features and Agent Workflows:


  • Integrate commercial and open models through APIs and enterprise AI platforms, using tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval, and context engineering to make them useful inside live business workflows.
  • Build agent workflows with tools, memory, and human checkpoints, and write the evaluations that measure their behavior against accuracy, latency, safety, and cost.

Engineer With AI Every Day:


  • Use AI-native development techniques throughout your own workflow, including code generation, test generation, debugging, refactoring, documentation, and code comprehension, and measure the effect on your throughput and quality.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Litify, we're powering a new era for the legal industry. Since its founding in 2016, Litify has helped law firms and corporate legal departments turn operations into impact through its leading AI-native Platform of Action.

Over 55K legal professionals and 450+ enterprise clients across plaintiff, insurance defense, immigration, and the Fortune 500 trust Litify to combine cloud-based technology, configurable AI-native workflows, agentic AI, and powerful business analytics into one open ecosystem that moves legal teams from systems of record to systems of action.

Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and recognized as an Inc. 5000 and Deloitte Technology Fast 500 fastest-growing private company, Litify is at the center of legal innovation. Headquartered in New York, we're building the last legal platform our customers will ever need.

About the TeamLawyers bill in six-minute increments, and every one of them counts. Litify Time & Billing turns that time into revenue: time entry, billing rules and rates, pre-bills and invoices, payments, e-billing, and a two-way sync with Accounting Seed. If you like problems where a rounding rule matters and an invoice has to be right every time, this is your team.

About the RoleLitify is looking for a Software Engineer to join our Time & Billing team. The code you ship decides how firms capture their time, bill their clients, and get paid. We recently integrated with an AI time-capture partner, so the work lawyers do during the day becomes time entries that flow straight into billing. That is the kind of work this team takes on, and on a small team, your part in it is visible.

We want a strong, versatile engineer who works across the stack and is eager to dig into new technologies. Our product runs on Salesforce. Prior Salesforce experience isn’t required: if you come from Java, C#, TypeScript, or a similar stack, senior engineers on the team will help you learn the platform.

AI-assisted development is how this team works. We use AI coding assistants every day to plan, write, test, and review code. We want someone who already builds this way, knows how to check what the assistant produces, works within solid guardrails, and helps teammates do the same. AI makes each of us faster, but the team still designs, reviews, and decides together.

How we work:We value speed and follow-through. If you like shipping steadily and seeing your impact in the numbers, you will fit in here.

  • We are a team of four engineers, part of a team of nine with an engineering manager, a product manager, a UX designer, and two QA engineers
  • We work in two-week agile sprints, where engineers and Product refine the work together and we estimate story points as a team
  • We track what we complete each week and look at how AI helps us deliver more
  • Features start from Figma designs and go through full QA and a package regression pass before each release
  • We ship three major releases a year as Salesforce managed packages, plus patch releases, on a set schedule rather than through continuous deployment
  • We keep meetings to a minimum and work through Jira and Slack

In this role, you will:

  • Design and build features for time capture, billing, and invoicing, from the data model to the UI
  • Help lead how the team builds with AI, from agent workflows and shared prompts to review practices
  • Build and maintain integrations, from our Accounting Seed sync to AI time-capture partners
  • Help build, test, and ship our releases
  • Go beyond the code: help shape requirements with Product, test your work end to end with QA, and refine UI details with UX
  • Contribute to project documentation and knowledge bases

To be successful in this role, you have (required):

  • 4+ years of experience with a typed back-end language (for example Java, C#, TypeScript)
  • Front-end experience with modern JavaScript, a component framework such as React, and CSS styling
  • Solid data modeling and SQL skills, including working with large data sets and designing code that scales
  • A habit of writing tests
  • Daily, hands-on experience building software with AI coding assistants
  • An ability to communicate clearly with Engineering and Product, including teammates in other time zones

Nice-to-have:

  • Prior experience developing on Salesforce (Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL), or Salesforce Administrator or Platform Developer certifications
  • Experience at a Salesforce ISV, such as releasing managed packages and passing security review
  • Legal billing knowledge, such as fee arrangements, rates, write-downs, and LEDES e-billing
  • Experience with Accounting Seed or another finance or ERP product
  • Experience building AI tooling, such as custom agents, MCP servers, or shared prompt libraries

Where you can grow:

  • Learn the Salesforce platform with support from senior engineers
  • Use professional development funds for courses, conferences, and certifications, including Salesforce certifications
  • Grow into owning an area of the product, from design through release
  • Help shape the team’s AI practices and grow into leading them
  • Build toward a senior role at a company that likes to promote from within

Disclosure:

This job is fully remote, with the exception of employees living in New York City and New Jersey. Our NYC/NJ employees adhere to our hybrid schedule, which involves working in our Manhattan office 6 days a month.

The estimated base salary for this role is $115-120k. You may also be offered a bonus and benefits.

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide.

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skill set, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.

jobs.excerpt: What You Can ExpectJoin Zoom's Security Operations Centre team in India, where your work directly shapes how we detect, respond to, and recover from threats across a complex, global technology environment.
jobs.description:
What You Can Expect

Join Zoom's Security Operations Centre team in India, where your work directly shapes how we detect, respond to, and recover from threats across a complex, global technology environment. You'll operate at the intersection of SIEM engineering, incident response, and threat hunting, bringing analytical rigor to ambiguous situations and building the detection capabilities that keep Zoom secure. At this level, you're expected to lead investigations from triage through resolution, collaborate across cloud, identity, and product security disciplines, and continuously improve the processes and tooling that power our SOC. If you're energized by fast-moving threat landscapes and thrive in a team that values both depth of expertise and open collaboration, this role offers real scope to grow and make an impact.

About the Team

Our SOC India team sits at the heart of Zoom's global security operations, working alongside detection engineering, IT, cloud security, and product security teams to protect a platform trusted by hundreds of millions of people worldwide. The team covers the full spectrum of security events, from phishing and identity threats to cloud misconfigurations and product security incidents, operating with a follow-the-sun model. We value clear thinking, rigorous documentation, and a shared commitment to continuously strengthening Zoom's security posture.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor, triage, and investigate security alerts across SIEM, EDR, email security, identity, and cloud platforms using CrowdStrike NGSIEM, Splunk, and related tooling.
  • Lead incident response from initial triage through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
  • Partner with the Incident Response team to address security incidents and provide timely support.
  • Work proactively with Cyber Threat Intelligence to gather actionable intelligence and respond effectively to incidents.
  • Collaborate closely with the Detection Engineering team to develop new detection and reduce false positives.
  • Create, tune, and manage detection rules and alerts in CrowdStrike NGSIEM and Splunk, reducing false positives and maintaining clear documentation of logic and coverage.
  • Apply AI tools to accelerate incident analysis, summarize investigations, and support detection development, validating all outputs before acting on them.
  • Investigate phishing and email threats using Proofpoint, and analyze suspicious files and URLs through sandbox platforms such as Joe Sandbox.
  • Investigate identity-based threats and suspicious authentication activity in Okta, and analyze cloud security events across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI to identify misconfigurations and attacker behavior.
  • Handle PSIRT cases related to product security, coordinating with engineering and cross-functional teams to assess impact and track remediation.
  • Read and interpret PowerShell and Python scripts, and apply scripting and automation to streamline investigation, enrichment, and reporting workflows.
  • Document incidents, detections, and playbooks to a standard that supports handover, audits, and continuous improvement, and contribute to shift handovers, metrics reporting, and SOC process improvements.

What We're Looking For

  • 3 to 6 years of hands-on experience in SOC operations, incident response, or threat hunting.
  • Practical experience with CrowdStrike NGSIEM (Falcon Next-Gen SIEM) and CrowdStrike EDR, including detection rule development, alert tuning, and host-level investigation.
  • Proficiency with Splunk SIEM, including writing searches, building alerts, and supporting detection engineering workflows.
  • Experience investigating email threats with Proofpoint Email Security and analyzing suspicious files and URLs using sandbox environments such as Joe Sandbox.
  • Hands-on experience with at least two cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI) from a security monitoring perspective, and experience investigating identity-based threats in Okta logs.
  • Working knowledge of PowerShell and Python for security scripting and automation, with a strong understanding of attacker techniques mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Experience handling PSIRT cases or product security incidents, and strong written communication skills for incident documentation and stakeholder reporting.

Ways of Working
Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.


Benefits
As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.
We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.

Our projects cover web, mobile and AI products. Many have multi-tenant setups, lots of third-party integrations and real privacy and security needs. This is a contract role, paid hourly and fully remote. It is open to people based in the countries listed in this post, with overlap into US Eastern time for client calls. If you've designed and shipped client products at an agency or consultancy, and you can explain a trade-off to a founder as clearly as to an engineer, we want to talk.

About Us
Bolder Apps is a product development studio that partners with US-based startups and established companies to build and scale innovative digital products. We specialize in AI-powered development, full-cycle product creation, and engineering team augmentation. Our mission is simple: build bolder, faster, and smarter.

Our Culture & Values (read before applying)
We move fast. We take ownership. We work with AI, not against it. And we expect everyone to bring ideas, not wait for instructions.

There are no daily checklists, no micromanagement, and no corporate politics. Instead, you'll have autonomy, trust, and a team that's always ready to help you grow. At Bolder Apps, impact matters more than titles, and curiosity matters more than seniority.

If you want a place where you can level up fast and actually see your work making a difference - welcome aboard.

Responsibilities

  • Lead technical discovery with clients. Ask the right questions, find the real constraints and turn a rough idea into a clear solution design
  • Design the system architecture for web, mobile and AI products. Services, data model, hosting and how the pieces talk to each other
  • Write the technical parts of proposals and scopes of work. Modules, user flows, acceptance criteria, edge cases and estimates the team can stand behind
  • Design integrations with third-party APIs and vendors. Plan for retries, queues, webhooks and monitoring, and keep a clean way to swap a provider later
  • Plan multi-tenant and white-label setups with proper data isolation and access control
  • Build security and privacy in from day one. Encryption, audit logs, consent, data residency and the evidence clients need for an outside audit

  • Agency, consultancy or studio background. You've designed for several clients at the same time and you can switch context without losing quality
  • You've owned the architecture of client products that went live with real users. Diagrams that never shipped don't count

Who You Are

Prowess Consulting is hiring a dynamic and forward-thinking IT Manager to lead our internal technology operations.
To be considered for this role, you must reside in one of the following states: Alabama, California, Colorado, Georgia, Iowa, Maryland, Michigan, Minnesota, Mississippi, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Oregon, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Texas, Utah, Virginia, or Washington.

  • Microsoft 365 administration: Entra ID, Exchange Online, SharePoint Online, Teams, Intune, Purview and Defender.
  • Identity and access administration: on/offboarding, access changes, group and role design, privileged access controls.
  • Endpoint fleet: procurement, build standards, configuration, patching, recovery and disposal.
  • Vendors, contracts, licensing and assets: renewals, third-party risk review, and a clear picture of what we own and what it costs.
  • Business continuity for internal systems: backup, restore testing, documented recovery expectations.
  • Security operations: vulnerability monitoring and remediation, logging, and an incident response process you have rehearsed, not just written.
  • Projects and documentation: upgrades, improvement initiatives, and standards that let someone else run this without you.

What makes this role different

Technology delivered as a service. Internal requests are merging licensing needs with DevOps-style resource design and allocation. We are looking for someone who has experience of executing with that type of a platform-centric mindset.
  • Infrastructure as code, version control and repeatable deployment as normal practice.
  • A safe, documented path for teams to run what they build, and a reasoned no when it does not fit.
Security and compliance as your own work. We hold ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certifications, work under HIPAA obligations, and handle data in scope for GDPR. Several of the controls behind those certifications live in internal technology, and this role owns them by name rather than supplying evidence for someone else to assemble.
  • You must have fluency with at least one formal control framework, and the judgement to tell a control's intent from its paperwork.
  • You should be able to demonstrate identity-centered thinking: least privilege, scoped access, risk minimization.
Fluency with AI. Utilizing AI is a key part of Prowess' current strategy and a critical part of our trajectory. Furthermore, in contrast to prevailing business environments where risk-averse IT attenuates AI adoption, we expect IT to be a facilitator, enabler, and accelerator of wise organizational adoption of AI, AI-based tools, and knowledge worker-created AI-created apps and systems.

Much of that work runs on an internal platform we are building to serve the help desk and IT side of the organization as well as the people building on it. The technology side of it belongs to this role: who may call what, which credential each connection acts as, and what is allowed to run unattended. A key function of the role is using this platform to enable end users to work in the “Frontier” style, very quickly building and operating their own apps and rolling them out to their teams securely. This role will also have a hand in where the platform goes next.

jobs.description:
Position:MULESOFT INTEGRATION ARCHITECTLocation:ELIZABETHTOWN, KY or REMOTE (US ONLY)Salary:$120-130k
We are hiring a MuleSoft Integration Architect to design how data flows between Department of Defense (DoD) customer systems and Salesforce. You will use MuleSoft's Anypoint Platform to connect external systems, APIs, and data streams to Salesforce securely and reliably. You will set integration standards and work closely with the Salesforce Architect and development team.

US Citizenship Required and this is 100% remote role.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design the integration architecture connecting Salesforce with government and third-party systems using MuleSoft Anypoint Platform
  • Apply API-led connectivity (system, process, and experience APIs) to build reusable, well-governed integrations
  • Choose the right integration pattern for each need: real-time APIs, event-driven messaging, batch, or Change Data Capture
  • Build and lead development of Mule applications, API specifications (RAML or OAS), and DataWeave transformations
  • Design for security, including authentication, encryption in transit, API policies, and protection of CUI
  • Plan for reliability with error handling, retries, monitoring, alerting, and logging
  • Establish integration standards, governance, and CI/CD pipelines for Mule applications
  • Work with system owners to define interface agreements and data mappings
  • Document integration designs and data flows to support ATO and RMF packages
  • Troubleshoot and tune integration performance in production

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Systems thinking: You understand how data moves across many systems and what happens when one fails.
  • Technical leadership: You set integration standards and guide developers to follow them.
  • Security mindset: You treat every interface as a potential risk and design accordingly.
  • Clear communication: You work with system owners and agencies to agree on interfaces and data definitions.
  • Pragmatism: You pick the simplest pattern that meets the need.
  • Ownership: You stay accountable for integrations from design through production support.

EXPERIENCE


Required
  • 7+ years of enterprise integration experience, including 4+ years with MuleSoft Anypoint Platform
  • Designing and building APIs with RAML or OpenAPI and transformations with DataWeave
  • Integrating with Salesforce using REST, SOAP, Bulk, and Streaming APIs, Platform Events, and Change Data Capture
  • Messaging and event-driven patterns (e.g., Anypoint MQ, JMS, or Kafka)
  • API security: OAuth 2.0, mutual TLS, and API policies
  • CI/CD for Mule applications (e.g., Maven, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps)

Nice to Have
  • Experience with MuleSoft Government Cloud or other FedRAMP environments
  • Experience with Salesforce Government Cloud Plus or Government Cloud Plus – Defense (IL4/IL5)
  • Experience on DoD or other federal programs
  • Familiarity with RMF, ATO packages, and CUI handling
  • Runtime Fabric or hybrid deployments
  • Salesforce development experience (Apex)

EDUCATION AND CERTIFICATIONS


Required
  • Salesforce Certified MuleSoft Platform Integration Architect (formerly MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect – Level 1)
  • CompTIA Security+ or another DoD 8140-qualifying certification (or the ability to obtain it within 6 months of hire)

Nice to Have
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
  • Salesforce Certified MuleSoft Platform Architect
  • Salesforce Certified MuleSoft Developer or MuleSoft Developer II
  • Salesforce Certified Platform Integration Architect
  • Salesforce architect certifications:
    • Platform Data Architect
    • Platform Sharing and Visibility Architect
    • Platform Integration Architect
    • Platform Identity and Access Management Architect
    • Platform Development Lifecycle and Deployment Architect

jobs.excerpt: Get to know us betterCodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms.
jobs.description:
Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

You will join the team behind a large-scale, centralized data platform built for a global consulting organization. The platform is the shared source of company data behind several of the firm's internal products, and is used daily by consultants for company research.

This is fundamentally a data engineering role combined with software engineering: you'll be designing, coding, testing, and operating production Python systems - pipelines, libraries, and services - that move, transform, and serve data at scale. This is not a role focused on configuring tools or writing one-off queries. You'll be building reliable, maintainable software that powers our data platform. The goal is a unified, enterprise-grade dataset of 300M+ company records, integrated from 10+ external and internal sources.

The platform delivers firm-level and site-level data - firmographics, technographics, and hierarchical relationships (parent company, subsidiary, site) - alongside key business metrics such as revenue, CAGR, EBITDA, headcount, M&A activity, competitors, industry classification, and web traffic. Data needs to stay accurate, well-structured, and fast to query as both the dataset and the number of consumers keep growing.

Technology stack:

  • Languages: Python, SQL

  • Data platform: Snowflake, dbt

  • Workflow orchestration: Apache Airflow (complex DAGs), running on Kubernetes

  • Data processing: Apache Spark on Azure Databricks

  • Data tooling and DBs: pandas, Polars, PyArrow, DuckDB, PySpark, PostgreSQL, Redis

  • Cloud: Azure (AKS, Blob Storage, ACR, Databricks, OpenSearch, Azure AI Search)

  • API & services: FastAPI (REST, async), API Gateway

  • Testing & code quality: pytest, mypy/pyright, ruff/black, sqlfluff, SonarQube

  • Schema validation: Pydantic

  • Dependency & environment management: uv, Poetry

  • CI/CD & infrastructure: GitHub Actions, Docker, Kubernetes

  • AI-Assisted Development: Cursor, Claude Code, ChatGPT Enterprise

  • Future direction: agentic AI systems, LangChain, Azure OpenAI integration

What else you should know:

  • Team: Data Architecture Lead, Data Engineers, DataOps Engineers, Backend Engineer, Product Owner, collaboration with Frontend Engineers and Data Science and AI Engineers

  • Distributed team across Europe and India

  • Agile, collaborative environment; given the platform's organization-wide impact, we're looking for a mature, proactive, results-driven approach

  • Code quality is enforced through testing, typing, and tooling - not just code review

We work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so it may happen that we’ll invite you to an interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.

Your role

This is a results-driven contributor role, split roughly between hands-on engineering delivery and continuous improvement of the platform.

As a part of the project team, you will be responsible for:

  1. Engineering & delivery (~70%)

  • Design, build, and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines in Python, including their orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring (Airflow)

  • Develop data transformation logic in SQL and dbt on Snowflake, and build data models that support fast, reliable querying

  • Write reusable, well-typed Python libraries and internal packages used by other engineers and analysts

  • Build Python services and APIs (FastAPI) that expose data to downstream applications, and integrate with third-party and internal APIs

  • Write unit, integration, and data-contract tests, and keep pipelines covered by automated CI

  • Profile and optimize Python code and data processing jobs for runtime, memory, and cost

  • Deploy and operate code in the cloud using containers, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD

  • Enforce access controls, secrets handling, and sensitive-data protections throughout the data lifecycle

  • Use AI coding assistants effectively while validating all generated output before it reaches production, and help build automated quality gates

  1. Continuous improvement (~30%)

  • Find and fix efficiency, reliability, cost, and correctness issues in existing pipelines, refactoring toward simpler designs

  • Replace one-off scripts and notebooks with tested, packaged, scheduled code

  • Implement data quality checks, validation, and monitoring that catch issues before consumers do

  • Create matching logic to deduplicate and connect entities across multiple data sources

  • Document data processes and system architecture, and maintain project documentation

Do we have a match?

As a Data Engineer, you must meet the following criteria:

  • Strong Python experience: data structures, typing, error handling, generators/iterators, context managers, and the standard library

  • Software engineering fundamentals: modular design, dependency management, packaging, and API design

  • Hands-on experience building and operating ETL/ELT pipelines in production, not just scripts or notebooks

  • Strong experience with Snowflake and dbt

  • Experience with Apache Airflow or similar code-based orchestration tools

  • Experience with Apache Spark, ideally on Databricks

  • Solid SQL and data modelling, sufficient to design robust database schemas and query them effectively, including PostgreSQL

  • Testing discipline across both code and data: pytest (fixtures, mocking, code that's testable by construction) and dbt data tests, with data-contract checks in CI

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD practices

  • Debugging and profiling skills - able to reason about performance, concurrency, and memory in Python

  • Experience with at least one public cloud (AWS or Azure)

  • Experience with version control systems (Git)

  • Experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, or similar on a daily basis

  • Strong communication skills and good knowledge of English (minimum C1 level).

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the following nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with Pydantic or similar schema-validation libraries

  • Python web/API frameworks (FastAPI, Flask, Django)

  • Async Python, multiprocessing, or other concurrency patterns

  • Experience with Azure AI Search or AWS OpenSearch

  • A second language: Go, Rust, Scala, or TypeScript

  • Familiarity with LLMs, Azure OpenAI, or agentic AI systems

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

  • The ability to change the project you work on

About the Role

We're looking for an experienced full-stack developer and technical architect to scope, build, and manage a custom funnel analytics dashboard for our performance marketing operations.

The dashboard will bring together data from Meta Ads, Shopify, attribution platforms, and individual sales funnels to help us understand funnel performance, identify opportunities, and make better marketing decisions.

We need someone who understands both software development and performance marketing data, particularly Meta Ads tracking, attribution, and funnel analytics.

This person must be able to independently scope projects, recommend technical solutions, and own development from planning through deployment.

Key Responsibilities

1. Funnel Dashboard Development

  • Build a custom application to track and analyze marketing funnel performance.
  • Connect advertising campaigns, creatives, landing pages, pre-landers, product pages, and checkout performance.
  • Develop dashboards for funnel-level metrics such as traffic, conversion rates, CPA, AOV, ROAS, and revenue.
  • Enable filtering and segmentation by campaign, ad set, creative, funnel, product, traffic source, and date range.
  • Build reporting to compare different funnels, landing pages, offers, and funnel variations.
  • Develop flexible reporting interfaces that allow users to drill into individual funnel performance.

2. Data Integrations & Attribution

  • Integrate Meta Ads, Shopify, Hyros, Google Ads, and other relevant data sources.
  • Build reliable data pipelines that combine advertising, funnel, and purchase data.
  • Understand Meta Marketing API, Pixel, Conversions API (CAPI), UTMs, and event tracking.
  • Connect ad-level performance to specific funnels and downstream conversions.
  • Troubleshoot attribution discrepancies and ensure accurate reporting.
  • Understand the limitations of different attribution models and reporting windows.

3. AI-Powered Funnel Analysis

  • Integrate AI models to analyze funnel performance and identify optimization opportunities.
  • Automatically identify underperforming funnel stages and conversion drop-offs.
  • Analyze performance trends across creatives, audiences, landing pages, and offers.
  • Generate AI-powered insights and recommendations based on funnel data.
  • Build natural-language reporting capabilities to answer questions about funnel performance.
  • Automate performance summaries, anomaly detection, and reporting.

4. Project Scoping & Technical Architecture

  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications.
  • Independently scope projects, estimate costs, and establish development milestones.
  • Recommend appropriate technologies, databases, and application architecture.
  • Identify integration limitations, tracking challenges, and technical dependencies.
  • Break projects into actionable development tasks.
  • Own development, QA, deployment, documentation, and maintenance.

5. Application Infrastructure

  • Build and deploy custom applications using Railway or similar platforms.
  • Develop scalable backend systems, APIs, and databases.
  • Ensure dashboard performance, data accuracy, and reliability.
  • Maintain and improve applications as reporting requirements evolve.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong full-stack development experience with React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, or similar technologies.
  • Experience building custom analytics dashboards and reporting applications.
  • Advanced SQL, database architecture, and API integration skills.
  • Deep understanding of Meta Ads tracking, attribution, and marketing performance data.
  • Experience working with funnel analytics, conversion events, and customer journeys.
  • Experience integrating OpenAI or other LLM APIs into applications.
  • Experience with Railway or comparable deployment infrastructure.
  • Proven ability to independently scope, architect, and deliver software projects.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Experience

  • DTC, e-commerce, or performance marketing agency experience.
  • Shopify, Hyros, Google Ads, and Meta Marketing API integrations.
  • Custom funnel tracking, UTM management, and event-based analytics.
  • Familiarity with tools such as GA4, Triple Whale, or Funnelish.
  • AI automation, anomaly detection, and custom business intelligence tools.

Example Projects

Build a custom dashboard that allows our marketing team to:

  1. View performance across all active marketing funnels.
  2. Connect Meta campaigns and creatives to specific pre-landers, landing pages, and offers.
  3. Analyze conversion rates and drop-offs at each stage of the funnel.
  4. Segment results by campaign, creative, audience, funnel, and product.
  5. Compare funnel performance using Meta, Shopify, and third-party attribution data.
  6. Use AI to identify trends, performance issues, and optimization opportunities.

How This Role Makes a Difference

As a Web Design Engineer you will own how Care Access shows up on the web — designing and building the landing pages, campaign sites, and brand experiences that turn interest into action. You will work across the Care Access family of brands, moving fluidly between design and production front-end code, and partnering with web designers, illustrators, marketers, product engineers, web engineers, and DevOps. Some days you are 80% dev and 20% design; other days it is the reverse; and some days you are half project manager keeping several launches on track. Prototype in the browser so decisions get made against something working rather than a static mock. Sweat the interaction detail: states, transitions, loading and error behavior, and motion.

Description

The Company:

Push is an all-in-one platform that helps businesses grow and scale their companies by simplifying HR, payroll, time tracking, and scheduling. Our purpose is to help our customers free up their time by making people management ridiculously easy, so they can focus on their passion.

Our customer base includes some of the biggest brands, such as Earls Restaurant, Cactus Club, Crumbl Cookies and more.

The Team:

We're a group of competitive, dedicated people who place a high priority on competence and efficiency, but an even higher stock in engaged and passionate team members who contribute to our culture and make an impact. As part of our rapidly growing team you will play an important and unique role in working towards our mission to help 1 million people do what they love.

Take a look at a day in the life of our team: Behind the Scenes with our Software Engineers

The Role

We’re looking for a Full Stack Developer who is comfortable building across the stack—front end, back end, and mobile. You’ll be developing core features that power Push Operations’ workforce management platform, collaborating closely with product, design, and AI teams to deliver intuitive user experiences and scalable backend systems. Proficiency in React and/or Native (or related cross-platform frameworks) is an important part of this role, as our mobile apps are central to how customers interact with Push. Kindly note this position is for an existing role which we are actively hiring for.

Location:

Recently the world has changed so we are changing with it. We’re embracing new ways of working and are constantly adapting our practices to ensure that wherever you are working from, you feel a part of the team and have everything you need to work comfortably. We are a remote-first company, Pushies can choose to work remotely or from our Downtown Vancouver office.

We are considering eligible candidates for this role from any location across Canada with a sufficient time zone overlap with our Vancouver team.

Job Duties:

  • Design, build, and maintain features across the full stack built using a variety of languages and technologies
  • Front-end: React/React Native web and mobile applications
  • Back-end: PHP (and related frameworks), Node.js, RESTful APIs, microservices
  • Data: database schemas, integrations, and optimization
  • Level up our existing systems by contributing to incremental modernization efforts
  • Level up production code by diagnosing and resolving issues, balancing against new feature delivery
  • Collaborate with designers and product managers to turn requirements into elegant, user-friendly solutions
  • Ensure high performance, security, and scalability across systems
  • Build mobile experiences with React Native or related technology, ensuring smooth integration with backend services
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code; participate in code reviews and knowledge sharing
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize performance issues across web, mobile, and back-end layers
  • Stay current with evolving tools, frameworks, and best practices for full stack and mobile development

Why Push?

  • Do what you love! It’s the key to happiness. That’s why at Push we aim to create a supportive environment to help foster your passion for work, and keep you feeling energized and happy so you can do more of what you love.
  • Grow Yourself. We want to see you win in all areas. At Push, our mantra is: you will grow professionally and personally. We drive conversations around your personal and professional goals. Let’s crush it together.
  • Make an Impact. At Push, we believe everyone is born a genius, and our responsibility is to develop that genius within. Impact is our key metric - that’s why we challenge Pushies to show up as their authentic selves while creating a legacy.

Check out our About Us video:

Additional Information

At Push, we place value on different types of experiences. If your experience looks a little different from what we’ve listed but you think you’re a good fit, we would still love to hear from you.

We celebrate diversity and promote equal opportunity. We appreciate what makes each of our team members different and encourage you to apply, no matter who you are or how you identify.

Push Operations welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all aspects of the recruitment and selection process.

Please note that we use AI to screen and assess applicants for this position. Human oversight is maintained throughout the hiring process.

﻿Salary: $90,000 - $130,000 CAD annually

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of professional experience as a Full Stack Developer
  • This is an individual contributor role focused on hands-on execution rather than architecture ownership, though we're open to expanding scope and ownership as you grow with the team
  • Proficiency with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frameworks (React, React Native, Node.js)
  • Proficiency with PHP or a related backend framework (Laravel, Symfony, or equivalent)
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, and database systems (SQL/NoSQL)
  • Experience integrating frontends and mobile apps with back-end APIs
  • Familiarity with mobile-specific challenges (app store deployments, push notifications)
  • Solid grasp of testing (unit, integration, end-to-end) and CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) is an asset

  • A passion for solving real-world problems with technology that makes a difference in people's lives

﻿Bonus Skills and Qualifications:

  • Experience with mobile analytics (Firebase, LogRocket, Mixpanel)

jobs.description:
WebCreek is looking for a Senior Software Developer with strong experience developing scalable messaging and notification systems to support a mission-critical emergency communication platform.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience building and maintaining production messaging solutions that deliver notifications across multiple channels, including SMS, email, voice, and mobile push. This role requires expertise in reliable message delivery, third-party messaging integrations, asynchronous processing, and high-volume notification systems.

This position is well suited for a senior full-stack developer who enjoys solving complex distributed systems challenges, takes ownership of features from design through production, and can build reliable communication solutions that perform consistently under demanding conditions.

What You'll Do:

  • Design, develop, and maintain multi-channel messaging capabilities for delivering emergency notifications through SMS, email, voice, and mobile push.

  • Build and maintain integrations with messaging providers such as Twilio, SendGrid, Azure Communication Services, or similar platforms.

  • Develop scalable messaging architectures using queues, background workers, asynchronous processing, and message-driven systems.

  • Implement reliable delivery mechanisms, including retries with exponential backoff, idempotency, deduplication, provider failover, and delivery status tracking.

  • Optimize messaging workflows to support high-volume notifications reaching thousands of recipients.

  • Implement and manage delivery receipts, provider webhooks, and notification tracking processes.

  • Support SMS compliance requirements, including opt-in/opt-out management, 10DLC, and toll-free registration.

  • Implement email authentication and deliverability practices, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, bounce handling, and related monitoring.

  • Develop mobile push notification capabilities using Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) and Apple Push Notification service (APNs).

  • Design data models and workflows for recipient audiences, groups, multilingual message templates, and notification delivery tracking.

  • Develop and maintain backend services using Node.js, GraphQL, MySQL, Redis, and publish/subscribe technologies such as MQTT.

  • Contribute to frontend development using Vue 3 or React to support notification management and operator-facing interfaces.

  • Integrate with third-party mass-notification systems and support directory and roster synchronization.

  • Deploy, maintain, and troubleshoot containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, and Helm.

  • Write automated unit and end-to-end tests, maintain CI workflows using GitHub Actions, and participate in code reviews.

  • Use AI coding agents to support development productivity while reviewing and validating generated code.

  • Collaborate with Engineering and product stakeholders to define technical solutions and deliver reliable, maintainable production features.

What You Bring:

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, including experience delivering and supporting at least one production software product.

  • Strong hands-on experience building and operating production messaging, notification, or alerting systems at scale.

  • Experience integrating messaging platforms such as Twilio, SendGrid, Azure Communication Services, or similar providers.

  • Strong understanding of reliable message delivery patterns, including queues, workers, retries, idempotency, deduplication, provider failover, and throughput optimization.

  • Experience developing notification systems capable of delivering messages to thousands of recipients.

  • Knowledge of SMS compliance requirements, including opt-in/opt-out processes, 10DLC, and toll-free registration.

  • Understanding of email deliverability, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, bounce handling, and delivery monitoring.

  • Experience implementing mobile push notifications using Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) and Apple Push Notification service (APNs).

  • Experience designing data models for audiences, recipient groups, multilingual templates, and delivery tracking.

  • Strong backend development experience with Node.js and GraphQL APIs; TypeScript is a plus.

  • Working proficiency with Vue 3 or React.

  • Experience with MySQL, Redis, and message-driven or publish/subscribe systems such as MQTT.

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, and troubleshooting services in containerized environments.

  • Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including TCP/UDP, TLS, WebSockets, and packet capture analysis.

  • Experience writing automated unit and end-to-end tests and working with GitHub Actions, Git, and pull-request workflows.

  • Experience using AI coding agents, such as Claude Code, as part of daily development work, with the ability to review and correct generated code.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, technical ownership, and the ability to independently deliver solutions from design through production.

  • Professional proficiency in spoken and written English.

What You'll Gain:

  • A full-time, fully remote position with a growing international company.

  • The opportunity to work on a mission-critical communication platform with real-world applications.

  • Hands-on experience developing scalable real-time audio and networked communication solutions.

  • Opportunities to collaborate with experienced engineers on complex software, networking, and embedded systems challenges.

  • A collaborative remote working environment with an international engineering team.

Location: Remote LatAm

WebCreek is an equal opportunity employer. We believe our strength comes from our people and welcome all qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, color, gender, age, or disability. If you have the skills and the passion for tech, we want you on our team.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Applied AI
jobs.excerpt: About Snowplow Snowplow is the real-time customer context layer that collects, validates, enriches, and delivers behavioral data for advanced analytics, ML, and AI agent decisioning.
jobs.description:
About Snowplow

Snowplow is the real-time customer context layer that collects, validates, enriches, and delivers behavioral data for advanced analytics, ML, and AI agent decisioning. Snowplow's event tracking is leveraged across 2M+ websites and applications globally, processing over one trillion events per month.

More than 250 companies, including Experian, AutoTrader, Strava, Condé Nast, and HelloFresh, rely on Snowplow to build a well-governed, first-party data foundation that powers their customer-facing AI agents, in-session personalization and recommendations, and real-time analytics.

This Opportunity

Snowplow is rebuilding how the company runs its own work. AI-native transformation is the operating priority for the business, and the Applied AI team owns it: the platform every team's AI work runs on, the pattern for how a function's critical workflows move onto agents, and the measurement of whether it worked. Individual AI adoption is already high across the company. The next stage is redesigning functions so that agents run the recurring work and people set the goals and judge the output.

You are the first Forward Deployed Engineer on the team, reporting to the Senior Director of Applied AI. The team is also hiring a principal engineer to own the platform and an Applied AI engineer to embed with our Growth team. The Senior Director you report to still ships code. You are the one who moves between functions. You embed with one function at a time alongside its leader and the people who do the work by hand today, map how the work actually runs, build the agentic workflow that takes it on, tune it with the experts until they trust it, and hand it back to the function to own. Then you move to the next one.

You sit with our major business functions, one at a time. The Senior Director of Applied AI and the function's leader choose each engagement, and your workflow maps are the evidence they choose from. Priorities will shift as the transformation moves, and the role is designed for that.

This is the forward deployed model applied inside our own company. You write the code, and you also do the discovery a consultant would. The function's leader owns the decision to change how their team works. You own the engineering and the pattern. You'll spend as much time listening to someone walk through a task they do by hand every week as you will writing the agents that run it, and the deliverable is a function that works differently, understands why, and can run what you built.

What you will own

  • The workflow map. You sit with the people who do the work and leave with how it actually runs today: where work enters, what moves between steps, who says yes, and what "good" means. It is the first thing you do in every engagement.
  • The case for whether to build. Before anything gets built, you bring the evidence from the map and make the case for whether the workflow is worth moving onto agents, including when the answer is that it does not need AI. The decision sits with the function's leader and the Senior Director; the evidence is yours.
  • The build. You design and build agentic workflows on Snowplow's shared factory framework, which Applied AI runs: declared queues and gates, focused agents, and a central ledger that records every agent run. Every factory you build is compatible with every other one, in any function.
  • Approval gates. You decide where the agent acts on its own, where it proposes and a person approves, and what gets recorded so anyone can see what the agent did and why. The people in the function keep the judgment. The agents take the rest.
  • Agent readiness. You make the function's knowledge, systems of record, and quality bar explicit enough for agents to work from. Often this is the real work, and the agents are the easy part.
  • The last twenty percent. Most of the work comes after the prototype: reliability, edge cases, evaluation, and a team choosing it over the way they worked before. You tune the output alongside the domain experts and encode their judgment into checks that hold after they step back.
  • The handoff. You train the function to run and evolve what you built, then leave. Where an Applied AI engineer is embedded in the function, you hand it to them. Success is a workflow still running months after you have moved on, owned by people who are not you. After the handoff you stay available: when the function sees a problem or a way to improve the workflow, you coordinate it with the embedded and platform engineers rather than taking it back, and you help build the platform those workflows run on.
  • The pattern itself. You own how a workflow moves from map to agents to handoff, written down so the next engagement starts from it. What you build also goes back into the shared framework as reference implementations. The second factory in any function should be cheaper than the first.

We would love to hear from you if you have

  • Shipped real software in someone else's stack. You are comfortable being dropped into an unfamiliar codebase, dataset, or business system and productive in it fast. You are fluent in at least one of Python, TypeScript, or Go, and you pick up the others as the work needs them.
  • Built with LLMs in production. You have designed agents or agentic workflows that run real work, with prompts, tools, evaluation, and the failure modes that come with them. You know the difference between a demo and something a team relies on every day, and you have done the unglamorous work of closing that gap.
  • An AI-native way of working you can show us. A workflow, automation, or agent you built and still use. Expect to demonstrate it during the interview process.
  • Sat with non-engineers and understood their work. You can spend a day with a sales, marketing, or customer team and come back with the actual process, including the parts nobody wrote down. Active listening matters here as much as the stack.
  • Self-direction and comfort with ambiguity. Engagements are time-boxed, functions differ, and the next one is decided by the business. You plan your own work inside an engagement and stay steady when the business changes what comes next.
  • The instinct to hand off. You would rather install a capability that keeps producing without you than become the person a team depends on.
  • Low ego. You retire your own work when a better approach shows up, including one a teammate built. Models and tools change fast, and last quarter's build may need replacing.
  • Clear communication with senior stakeholders. You can explain to a function leader what changes for their team, in their language, and hold your ground on the pattern when it matters.
  • A track record you can talk through. You have worked in a forward deployed, solutions engineering, internal tools, or consulting engineering role, or you have transformed a process end to end inside a company you worked for.

How we hire for this role

The interview process includes a working session where you walk us through how you work with AI on a real task, using your own setup. We work this way ourselves, and you are welcome to use AI when applying.

What you get in return for being awesome

  • Meaningful equity stake
  • Competitive Base Salary
  • Flexible working
  • Generous PTO
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Company Pension
  • MacBook and home office equipment allowance
  • Enhanced Family leave

jobs.excerpt: About the roleWe are seeking a proactive, technically strong Backend NestJs Developer to keep a live, business-critical microservices platform healthy while delivering meaningful improvements on top of it.
jobs.description:
About the role

We are seeking a proactive, technically strong Backend NestJs Developer to keep a live, business-critical microservices platform healthy while delivering meaningful improvements on top of it.

This is a hands-on role with a high degree of autonomy: you’ll take a bug report or change request, investigate it across the codebase, and see it through to production. You’ll balance production support with feature engineering, backed by a supportive team, and we’re embracing agentic development with AI coding agents to ship efficiently without compromising quality.

Key responsibilities

  • Resolve production issues: Triage, diagnose, and resolve issues across distributed microservices, tracing a request from the user-facing API down to the services that talk to external systems.
  • Support incident response: Investigate root causes, apply fixes, add regression tests, and document findings so issues don’t recur
  • Deliver enhancements: Build improvements to existing services, including new versions of certification programs, scorecard and scoring changes, payment adjustments, and integration updates
  • Work within the architecture: Follow established patterns and shared internal libraries in a layered service architecture, from the API gateway through the business logic services down to the adapters that integrate with external systems
  • Maintain integrations: Maintain and extend integrations with external platforms for performance data, CRM, enterprise resource planning (ERP), payment processing, email, and cloud file storage
  • Manage data changes: Write and update database migration scripts and investigate data-related production issues carefully against live data
  • Partner with QA and product: Answer testers’ questions, clarify expected behavior, help reproduce issues, and support verification so fixes and features can be signed off smoothly. Ask product clarifying questions early and confirm intent and edge cases
  • Improve observability and documentation: Contribute structured logging, masking of sensitive data, and clearer production visibility, and take part in code review while keeping documentation current as the platform grows

Required qualifications

  • Proven ability to take ownership of a problem from start to finish, from initial bug report or change request through to a tested, deployed solution
  • Production experience building and maintaining backend services with Node.js and TypeScript
  • Strong experience with NestJS (or a comparable structured backend framework), including modules, controllers, services, dependency injection, and middleware
  • Solid REST/HTTP fundamentals, including service-to-service communication, API contracts, versioning, and error handling
  • Comfortable with relational databases, writing and reviewing PostgreSQL queries, and safe migration practices
  • Experience debugging distributed systems where a single feature spans several services, reading logs and metrics to find root causes rather than symptoms
  • Sound judgment about risk, including the difference between a safe local fix and a change that calls for a rollout plan, particularly for payments, authentication, and live data
  • Experience integrating third-party systems (payment providers, CRMs, ERPs, identity providers) behind a clean internal interface
  • Understanding of authentication patterns: OAuth 2.0, JWT verification, single sign-on (SSO), and service-to-service (machine-to-machine) authentication
  • Comfortable with agentic development, using AI coding agents and tooling to investigate, build, and ship work efficiently while keeping a careful eye on quality
  • Ability to write tests that confirm fixes and prevent regressions
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including clear status updates, incident notes, pull request descriptions, and documentation others can act on

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting a platform through the transition from active build to maintenance-and-enhancement mode
  • Familiarity with adapter patterns that isolate external systems from core business logic
  • Experience with webhook-driven integrations, including verifying signatures, scoped service-to-service authorization, and safely handling repeated inbound events
  • Familiarity with containers and orchestration (Docker and Kubernetes) and services deployed on a major cloud provider such as AWS
  • Experience with observability practices such as structured logging and masking of sensitive data

All our positions are Remote and are available as Full Time Employment or B2B Contracts
