THIS OPENING IS AVAILABLE FOR CANDIDATES IN LATIN AMERICA, NOT LIMITED TO ONLY COLOMBIA.

Sonatafy Technology, headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, is an award-winning nearshore software development company with a strong reputation. They have a dedicated in-house team of engineers, offering end-to-end software solutions and supporting client development staff augmentation. Catering to companies of all sizes and industries, including some of the world's largest brands, Sonatafy Technology is a trusted provider of nearshore enterprise-level cloud and mobile application software development services.

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented QA Engineer with extensive manual and Automation experience using Playwright. You will be part of a collaborative engineering team focused on ensuring product quality through robust test automation and efficient QA practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive automated testing efforts across the platform (50%–50% manual).
  • Contribute to social media reporting initiatives.
  • Conduct thorough automation code reviews to maintain high engineering standards.

Manual Testing (≈50%)

  • Review requirements, user stories, and designs to identify gaps, edge cases, and testability concerns early in the sprint.
  • Write and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and checklists in BrowserStack Test Management.
  • Perform functional, exploratory, regression, smoke, and UAT-support testing across web and mobile.
  • Execute cross-browser and cross-device testing, including responsive layouts and real-device checks.
  • Validate APIs and back-end behavior manually (e.g., Postman) to support UI findings.
  • Reproduce, document, and triage defects with clear steps, evidence (screenshots, videos, logs), severity, and priority.
  • Partner with Product and Development during sprint ceremonies to clarify acceptance criteria and sign off on releases.

Test Automation with Playwright (≈50%)

  • Design, build, and maintain end-to-end and API automated tests using Playwright with TypeScript.
  • Apply maintainable framework patterns (Page Object Model, fixtures, reusable helpers, test data management).
  • Identify which manual test cases should be automated and convert stable, high-value scenarios into automated regression coverage.
  • Investigate and fix flaky tests using Playwright Trace Viewer, logs, screenshots, and video.
  • Integrate test suites into CI/CD pipelines with parallel execution and run cross-browser tests on BrowserStack Automate.
  • Report automation results and quality metrics (coverage, pass rate, defect trends) to the team and stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience with Playwright using TypeScript
  • Proficiency in Playwright Trace Debugging
  • Experience with BrowserStack Test Management
  • Experience with BrowserStack Automate
  • Proven ability to scope and implement automation requirements for new features
  • Strong Computer Science fundamentals
  • Experience setting up and maintaining Continuous Integration systems
  • Skilled in reporting, tracking, and triaging bugs, and solving complex technical problems
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with meticulous attention to detail
  • Solid experience in manual testing: test case design, exploratory testing, regression, and smoke testing
  • Strong knowledge of QA methodologies and test design techniques (boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning, risk-based testing)
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams and with defect tracking tools (e.g., Jira)
  • Hands-on experience with API testing, both manual (Postman or similar) and automated (Playwright API testing)
  • Comfortable with Git, code reviews, and pull request workflows
  • Advanced English, written and spoken

Nice to Haves

  • Hands-on experience with native mobile and web QA automation (Appium, WDIO)
  • Familiarity with GitLab CI/CD
  • Experience with GitHub Actions or other CI tools
  • Basic SQL for data validation
  • Exposure to accessibility testing (WCAG) and visual regression testing
  • Familiarity with performance testing tools (k6, JMeter)
  • ISTQB or similar QA certification

Why Work with Sonatafy?

At Sonatafy, you'll join a community of highly skilled engineers across Latin America supporting innovative U.S.-based teams. You'll be part of a fast-moving, client-first culture where your code has real-world impact. We offer competitive compensation, a remote-first lifestyle, and career growth opportunities across industries and technologies.

If you have reached this point and believe you are our ideal candidate, it's time to apply! To apply, please submit your resume in English.

Recruitment Scam Notice

Sonatafy recruitment communications will only come from @sonatafy.com email addresses. We do not request fees or sensitive financial information, nor do we conduct hiring solely through online forms without interviews. If you happen to receive a suspicious message, please contact us at .

Position Summary

We are seeking a Full-Stack Developer to build and evolve an AI-powered software development environment using Kiro (or similar agentic AI platforms). In this role you will be a hands-on engineer who implements the platform’s core components, reusable frameworks, and AI-assisted workflows, enabling Product, Design, Engineering, and Business teams to collaboratively build applications faster and with consistent quality. You will work within the architectural direction set by the platform’s architects and contribute to technical decisions, while owning the delivery of features end to end.

Key Responsibilities

Agentic Development Platform

  • Build and maintain components of an enterprise-grade agentic development environment using Kiro or similar platforms.
  • Implement multi-agent workflows that support requirements generation, design, code generation, testing, and documentation.
  • Contribute to scalable development patterns and reusable frameworks for application delivery.

Rapid Prototyping & AI-Assisted Development

  • Develop MVPs and proofs of concept, working closely with Product and Design partners.
  • Turn business requirements and natural language inputs into user stories, technical designs, UI prototypes, and working applications.
  • Iterate on and refine concepts through AI-assisted development cycles, gathering stakeholder feedback along the way.

Full-Stack Engineering & Reusability

  • Build and maintain reusable assets, including:
    • Application templates and starter kits
    • Angular component libraries
    • NestJS/Node.js service frameworks
    • AI agent workflows and prompt libraries
  • Apply and promote consistent architecture and coding standards across teams.
  • Write clean, well-tested, and well-documented code, and participate actively in code reviews.

AI Agent Integration

  • Implement and tune workflows involving requirements, design, code generation, testing, and documentation agents.
  • Integrate LLM-based tools into the software delivery lifecycle, including CI/CD pipelines.
  • Evaluate AI-generated output for correctness, security, and maintainability, and improve prompts and workflows based on results.

Adoption & Quality

  • Support adoption of AI-native development practices across Product, Design, and Engineering teams.
  • Help implement governance, security, quality controls, and validation processes for AI-generated artifacts.
  • Contribute to workshops, demos, and documentation, and mentor mid-level and junior developers.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional full-stack development experience, with strong hands-on expertise in NestJS, TypeScript, and Angular.
  • Solid understanding of software architecture, REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and cloud-native application development.
  • Experience building or contributing to developer platforms, internal tools, accelerators, or platform engineering solutions.
  • Track record of delivering rapid prototypes, MVPs, or innovation initiatives.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD, DevOps practices, and automated testing frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end).
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Product, Design, and Engineering stakeholders and communicate technical concepts clearly.
  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools, agentic AI platforms, or multi-agent frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Kiro.
  • Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, MCP (Model Context Protocol) architectures, or AI orchestration platforms.
  • Background in Developer Experience (DevEx), Platform Engineering, or Internal Developer Platforms (IDP).
  • Experience building or contributing to enterprise design systems and reusable UI libraries.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or contributing to AI adoption and innovation programs.

All our positions are Remote and are available as Full Time Employment or B2B Contracts

jobs.title: Sr/Staff Frontend Engineer | Web Products
jobs.excerpt: Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country.
jobs.description:
Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs.

We’re seeking a Senior or Staff Frontend Engineer to join our web application engineering team!

Our Culture @ Machinify

We embrace complex challenges with curiosity, having genuine interest and drive to understand the hard problems at hand and how to move the needle forward. Our engineers empower each other to take action, learn deeply about our customers' needs and unlock innovation with a strong sense of product ownership. We build with our users in mind, thoughtfully shipping outcomes, not just features. The technology we build shapes real healthcare decisions, demanding a high bar for engineering excellence and what we ship carries real weight. We pressure-test new AI tools, shape how they're used, and set the example for what disciplined, AI-driven engineering looks like...fast, but always under structured human oversight.

The Role

The ideal candidate brings a range of skills across web application development, with a passion for building user-centric, high-performance UI platforms. As a primary contributor to frontend development, you'll lead new feature work and shape architectural patterns in collaboration with backend-services engineers to optimally serve the user interface. You work alongside AI coding agents as a core part of how you deliver, directing and reviewing their output while holding the bar on quality. You bring strong experience in application design and system architecture, along with a proven ability to drive adoption of new languages, tools, and agentic development practices across a team. Above all, you excel at transforming complex requirements into scalable, responsive interfaces that deliver an exceptional user experience.

Every day offers a chance to work on something intellectually stimulating! We've built a team of strong programmers and problem solvers! You'll join a highly visible engineering team trusted to solve complex, high-stakes problems using the best of AI, data and software systems. You're responsible for writing code that has a significant impact on our customers and future product lines. Our team partners cross-functionally to influence product direction, work directly with customers, and own systems positively impacting millions of lives, where your technical decisions truly matter.

Click here to learn more about our customer-facing product lines.

Does this sound like the right opportunity to explore?... Lets connect!

What You'll Do

  • Deepen your understanding of the healthcare claims and payments domain
  • Developer Coach/Multiplier - an experienced frontend engineer who not only ships production-grade UI, but also contributes to setting standards, mentors others, and elevates the team's overall frontend maturity
  • Frontend voice in cross-team planning and the glue in cross-functional execution
  • Develop new applications and contribute toward UI and potentially middle-layer development
  • Own projects aligned with our product development strategy
  • Design and implement solutions that achieve a delightful and intuitive user experience
  • Balance customer-facing features and technical debt cleanup to keep the software suite sustainable
  • Bring agentic engineering practices into the team's day-to-day work and help the team adopt them effectively
  • Collaborate with team and external stakeholders such as Product Managers, Backend Engineers, the UX team, and our customers

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of production-ready application development experience with high-traffic users
  • Proven experience developing thoughtful UI system design and architecture with extensibility in mind
  • Proficiency in modern JavaScript, TypeScript, and CSS/HTML
  • Expert at reading and understanding complex enterprise-grade code, quickly contributing to it, and suggesting improvements
  • The ability to write a Technical Design Document (TDD) that a staff peer trusts and a product lead can understand — turning ambiguous product intent into concrete frontend architecture
  • A product and user-driven mindset. You connect your technical decisions to the people using what you build, and you care about the outcome, not just the implementation
  • Excellent debugging skills, using dev tools and source code with an emphasis on identifying root cause and proactively preventing future bugs
  • Proficiency integrating web APIs or microservices into the UI in partnership with backend developers
  • Experience implementing best practices for incorporating AI into user flows
  • Hands-on experience with agentic engineering tools and workflows in a real production setting
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills with your engineering peers, senior PM, ML/DS partners, and leadership. You care more about the system landing than about being right
  • Familiarity with standard development tools and processes like GitHub Workflows, Git, and JIRA
  • Comfort with complexity and the curiosity to define the path forward, not wait for one
  • BS or MS in Computer Science (or equivalent experience)
  • Excitement to make an impact in rewiring US healthcare!

What We Offer

  • Work from anywhere in the US! Machinify is digital-first.
  • Top Medical/Dental/Vision offerings
  • FSA/HSA
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Competitive salary, 401(k) with company match
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Additional health and wellness benefits and perks
  • Flexible and trusting environment where you’ll feel empowered to do your best work

How We Evaluate Talent

Our interview process is designed to evaluate candidates across our engineering career ladder. The level, title, and compensation range we're able to offer are determined by your overall performance and the competencies you demonstrate throughout the process which allows us to place each candidate at the level that best reflects their experience and abilities!

The salary for this position is based on an array of factors unique to each candidate: Such as years and depth of experience, set skills, certifications, etc. We are hiring for different levels, and our Recruiting team will let you know if you qualify for a different role/range. Salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes meaningful equity, excellent healthcare, flexible time off, and other benefits and perks.

Pay Range: $200,000-250,000 ~

Equal Employment Opportunity at Machinify

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Machinify is an employment at will employer. We participate in E-Verify as required by applicable law. In accordance with applicable state laws, we do not inquire about salary history during the recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruitment process, please let our recruiters know. See our Candidate Privacy Notice at:

jobs.excerpt: About EthosEthos (Nasdaq: $LIFE) is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale.
jobs.description:
About Ethos

Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE) is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.

About the role

Ethos is looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to serve as a technical leader for our SRE organization in the US. In this role, you will help set the technical direction for how Ethos builds, runs, and scales production systems, from our core AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure to the internal platforms and toolchains that power our AI initiatives.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role with organization-wide scope. You will design and build critical infrastructure yourself, lead cross-team initiatives from conception to delivery, and raise the reliability bar across engineering by partnering closely with product teams, up to and including submitting PRs to their codebases. You will work alongside SRE leadership in the US and Bangalore to shape the roadmap, and you will be a go-to technical authority for reliability, scalability, security, and cost-efficiency.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Strategy

  • Set Direction: Define and drive the multi-quarter technical strategy for reliability, infrastructure, and platform tooling, in partnership with SRE and engineering leadership and aligned with company OKRs.
  • Architecture: Lead the design of complex, cross-cutting infrastructure systems. Author and review technical specifications and architecture proposals to ensure consistency, resilience, and long-term maintainability.
  • Influence Without Authority: Motivate product engineering teams to adopt reliability best practices, and act as a trusted advisor on production readiness when new services are designed and brought online.
  • Mentorship: Grow the technical skills of SREs across our US and Bangalore teams through design reviews, pairing, and code review, and help raise the hiring bar by participating in interviews.

Reliability & Performance Engineering

  • Service Standards: Establish the framework for how teams define, measure, and act on SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets. Help teams instrument and monitor them.
  • Incident Excellence: Serve as a senior technical leader during high-severity incidents. Drive a culture of rigorous, blameless post-mortems and ensure follow-up work actually reduces recurrence.
  • Resilience: Lead capacity planning, disaster recovery, and failure-mode testing so our systems degrade gracefully and recover quickly.
  • Observability: Evolve our monitoring and alerting strategy so failures are detected before they impact customers and on-call is sustainable.

Infrastructure & AI Platform Tooling

  • Scalable Systems: Design, build, and operate our AWS cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), Kubernetes, and GitOps workflows (ArgoCD, Atlantis).
  • AI Gateway & Governance: Architect and build governed gateways for AI model routing, including model access controls, audit trails, and secure data connectors (such as MCP) that prevent sensitive data exposure.
  • Security & Compliance: Ensure infrastructure, including AI prototyping environments, meets security and regulatory requirements through automated scanning, PII guardrails, and scoped data access.

Efficiency & Cost Optimization

  • FinOps: Lead initiatives to optimize cloud spend across the organization, including right-sizing, spot instance utilization, and cost attribution.
  • AI Cost Management: Design metering and budgeting for LLM token usage, and build cost-aware routing so workloads use the most efficient model for the job.
  • Visibility: Establish clear cost metrics and partner with engineering teams on architectures that are both performant and cost-effective.

Developer Productivity

  • Paved Roads: Build internal tools, CI/CD pipelines, and self-service platforms that make the reliable path the easy path for product engineering teams.
  • Toil Elimination: Identify systemic sources of toil across engineering and automate them away.

Qualifications and Skills:

  • Experience: 10+ years of full-time software engineering experience in relevant roles (SRE, Infrastructure, Platform, DevOps, or Backend SWE), including significant time operating production systems at scale.
  • Staff-Level Impact: A track record of leading complex, multi-team infrastructure or reliability initiatives from ambiguity to delivery, and of influencing technical direction beyond your immediate team.
  • Software Engineering: Strong coding skills in Golang, Python, or TypeScript, and a commitment to engineering best practices: design patterns, code reviews, and testing.
  • Cloud & Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on experience with AWS, Kubernetes, and Terraform. Experience building Kubernetes operators is a plus.
  • Systems Knowledge: Strong understanding of distributed systems, PostgreSQL, CI/CD systems, and observability tooling such as DataDog.
  • Reliability Practice: Hands-on experience implementing SLIs/SLOs, leading incident response, and running effective post-mortems.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication. You can write a clear design doc, explain trade-offs to executives, and build consensus across teams.
  • Mindset: A strong desire to remove toil from systems, and the judgment to balance reliability, velocity, and cost.

Nice to Have

  • Experience building or operating LLM toolchains, such as AI gateways, model routing (e.g., Bedrock, Anthropic), and governance frameworks, including PII scanning and audit trails for model interactions.
  • Demonstrated experience leading cloud cost optimization or building usage metering systems.
  • Experience in regulated industries (insurance, fintech, healthcare) or with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2.
  • Experience collaborating with globally distributed teams.

Our Tech Stack

  • Languages: TypeScript, Golang, Python
  • Infrastructure: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, Atlantis
  • Observability & Tools: DataDog, GitHub Actions, PostgreSQL
  • AI Platform: Anthropic, Bedrock, MCP

The US national base salary range for this full-time position is $156,000 - $275,000. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position across all US locations. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areSamsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara’s Machine Learning, AI, Analytics & Data (MAAD) team builds the intelligence and technology that helps our go-to-market teams work faster, make better decisions, and spend more time with customers.

As the Director, GTM AI Engineering you’ll run our AI Engineering team for GTM. You’ll work closely with Data Science, Analytics, and Data Engineering to serve Sales, Customer Success, Support, Enablement, and GTM leadership. This is a hands-on Director role. Expect to spend about 70% of your time building (prototyping agents, writing code, designing evals) and about 30% leading the team, setting strategy, and influencing stakeholders.

You’ll build intelligent workflow experiences. That ranges from AI agents and copilots that take manual work off sellers’ plates, to signals for propensity and prioritization, to the data, evaluation, and measurement foundations that make these products reliable and trusted.

The ideal candidate is AI-native. You already run your own work through agents every day, you’ve shipped AI products to production, and you get as excited about a seller’s first “wow, this saved me an hour” moment as you do about a clean architecture.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.

In this role, you will:

  • Build hands-on. Prototype, ship, and iterate on AI agents, copilots, and workflow automations for GTM teams, from the first demo to a production system people rely on.
  • Build the platform, not just the apps. Own the architecture of the shared GTM AI platform: orchestration, LLM and tool gateways, identity and access, and the MCP and SDK contracts that let the GTM web app, Salesforce, Slack, desktop, and Claude plugins share one set of governed capabilities.
  • Make evals a first-class discipline. Design evaluation frameworks for agent and LLM behavior, including golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, human review loops, and regression suites, and run them in development and production. Use transcript analysis and eval results to find failures, guide what to fix first, and show quality improving over time.
  • Lead with AI day to day. Use agents, coding assistants, and agent harnesses in your own daily work, and build the shared tooling, patterns, and harnesses that make the whole team faster.
  • Stay ahead of the curve. Track new models, agent frameworks, MCP and tool ecosystems, and context engineering, and turn them into practical recommendations for Samsara's GTM use cases: what to adopt, what to test, and what to ignore. Make clear build-versus-buy calls on vendor tools, not just models.
  • Drive adoption with the field. Be the go-to advocate for AI across Sales, CS, and Support. Run demos, earn credibility with reps and frontline managers, collect real feedback, and turn skeptics into power users.
  • Set the strategy. Own the technical and product strategy for GTM AI, including the data foundations, instrumentation, governance, and observability these products depend on. Decide which prototypes move onto the shared platform, which merge, and which retire. Own model routing across vendors and the per-user spend controls that keep AI cost in line with value. Influence senior leaders on AI priorities, investment, and the operating model.
  • Ship revenue-critical intelligence. Own the forecasting, propensity, and CRM data-quality work that sales leadership acts on, and keep it calibrated, validated, and clear about its limits. Be comfortable across data and analytics engineering, and act as a business leader when the work calls for it.
  • Partner across GTM, Product, and Engineering. Work with Sales, Customer Success, Support, Enablement, Operations, Product, and Engineering leaders to find high-value opportunities, define success metrics, and turn them into durable products.
  • Build for trust. Put a pragmatic responsible-AI approach in place: safety, privacy, reliability, and human-in-the-loop workflows with clear approval and escalation paths. Agents that act on CRM and customer data run with per-user, least-privilege permissions, and changes to systems of record get human approval first.
  • Automatically included
    • All Roles: Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
    • People Manager Roles: Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing AI Engineering team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 10+ years across software engineering, machine learning, data science, or data platforms, including meaningful leadership experience. You still write code regularly.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant work experience.
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping LLM applications and agentic workflows to production, including tool use, retrieval, context engineering, and production reliability.
  • Production full-stack and cloud engineering experience (for example Python or TypeScript, AWS, and Databricks), including owning systems that other teams depend on.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and running evaluation frameworks for LLM or agent systems, and using them to drive quality decisions.
  • Daily, fluent use of AI agents and coding assistants in your own work, and a point of view on how they change the way teams build.
  • A track record of shipping internal or customer-facing AI/ML products with measurable business impact.
  • Experience with predictive modeling, experimentation, analytics, and data engineering foundations.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to turn ambiguous business problems into simple, valuable solutions.
  • Excellent communication with both executives and frontline users. You can demo to a sales floor and present to a VP on the same day.
  • A people-first leadership style with a track record of hiring, developing, and keeping strong technical talent.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience building AI or decisioning products for Sales, Customer Success, Support, Marketing, or other GTM functions, ideally in a fast-growing enterprise SaaS environment.
  • Experience with CRM, customer data, support, and knowledge-management systems (such as Salesforce, Gong, Gainsight, Zendesk, and Databricks), and connecting agents to them (for example, through MCP servers or similar integrations).
  • Experience with agent SDKs and harnesses (such as Claude Code / Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, or similar) and LLM observability tooling, eval tooling such as Braintrust or MLflow, and model APIs from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google.
  • Experience operating AI products at scale, including cost management, monitoring, and governance.
  • A visible habit of learning in public, such as writing, talks, open-source work, or internal “what’s new in AI” sessions.

  • Retrieval & RAG - grounding generation in each brand's rules, assets, and visual language, with strict isolation between clients

  • Evaluation & experimentation - systematic measurement (RAGAS or similar), A/B testing, and regression gates, so quality is proven rather than assumed

  • Data extraction & OCR - pipelines that pull structure out of documents, decks, scans, and imagery; OCR and vision models for reading, understanding, and tagging whatever a client hands us

  • Automation - end-to-end pipelines that run without babysitting: classify, extract, propose, verify - humans review outcomes instead of doing the work by hand

  • Model training - fine-tuning LLMs and neural networks where prompting hits its ceiling, running models locally or hosted depending on what the job needs

You build systems that make AI predictable, controllable, and production-ready — especially in visual domains.

jobs.excerpt: About Feanix BioFeanix is rebuilding animal breeding from the genome up.
jobs.description:
About Feanix Bio

Feanix is rebuilding animal breeding from the genome up.

We’re a YC-backed startup using whole-genome sequencing and custom ML models to help dairy farmers make better breeding and herd management decisions. Our technology is genuinely novel: we can sequence a full genome from a single hair at a fraction of traditional industry costs, our models achieve ~90% prediction accuracy on traits where existing approaches sit closer to ~30%, and we’re pioneering farm-specific genomic predictions that turn genetics into practical, actionable decisions.

That technology is translating into real adoption. In a short time, we’ve grown to serve roughly 1% of the U.S. dairy industry, with many customers in the pipeline. We started with dairy because our founders grew up on dairy farms and understand firsthand the problems we’re solving. But genetics is foundational to every agricultural industry, and dairy is only the beginning.

We’re building Feanix with a small, high-caliber team where people have meaningful ownership and work end to end. There are no unnecessary layers and very little room for busywork — just difficult problems at the intersection of biology, data, and software that haven’t been solved before.

If you’re exceptional at what you do and want your work to have a measurable impact on an entire industry, we’d love to build it with you.

About The Role

Feanix’s main product Autopilot is a farm decision system. We ingest farm data, configure our models around each operation's economics and goals, and generate farm-specific decisions for every animal in the herd — which to breed, which to cull, which to sell. Autopilot produces those decisions overnight and delivers them into the herd-management software the farm already runs.

Today we work with 30 of the roughly 150 largest dairies in the country, ~250,000+ cows. Over the next 5 months we need to grow to 50 farms, and within 12 months to half of that market, while launching new offerings beyond what we ship today.Most of the software behind that system currently is supported by a small team of engineers. This role exists to increase the stability, efficiency and speed of that team and system.

You would lead infrastructure at Feanix — you'd own the foundation the other engineers build on and your success would be measured in their throughput: how fast they learn whether a change is safe, and how fast they find out something didn't run. We've added the basics — observability, testing and release tooling as we've grown. What's missing is someone owning it end to end.

The job is the whole delivery ecosystem — everything between an engineer's commit and decisions landing on a farm: the environments a change is proven in, the gates it passes, how it rolls out, and how we know it arrived. Today a change can't be exercised end to end against realistic farm data before it reaches production, which shapes how cautiously (or indeed how riskily) everyone works. The reliability half isn't the usual one, we don't run a low-latency service, we run pipelines overnight, so what matters is whether a run started, finished, finished in time, and landed on the farm.

What You'll Own

Roughly half this role is CI, test and release engineering; a quarter is observability; a quarter is access control, cost, and consolidating our infrastructure as code. Work on a Windows fleet is a small slice.

  • Alerting and service-level objectives for the farm pipeline. What “decisions on the farm by time T” means per herd, instrumented and alerted. A run that never started, never finished, or finished late should reach a person before anyone on the farm notices.
  • The release path. Building out a path where staging runs on every commit and software engineers get quick feedback if the change was right.
  • Infrastructure as code, end to end. Agentic coding has not eliminated infrastructure as code, it has enhanced the speed it can be developed and changed.
  • Cost. There's a rough baseline today. You'd turn it into a real one, own the cost curve per herd, act on obvious waste, and help engineers estimate what something will cost before it ships rather than after.
  • Test infrastructure other engineers depend on, including for the third-party herd software and the machines that move files to and from farms. You'd make that boundary testable. You wouldn't own the automation itself.

How We Work

Python end to end, on AWS. A FastAPI service and Celery workers on ECS Fargate, PostgreSQL and S3 behind them, OpenTofu and GitHub Actions for everything that provisions and ships it. Bursty and GPU work runs on managed compute rather than a cluster we operate — the split is chosen per workload and it's deliberate.

Like everyone else, we're working out how humans and agents build software together. Our engineers direct agents against real work and build the harnesses that check that work. About half our recent commits are co-authored with agents. Quality comes from what happens around the code: specs, tests, verification. Nobody has this fully figured out, and that includes us.

Infrastructure as code is still the rule: changes are reviewed, versioned, and applied through CI, not typed into a console. So the question isn't whether agents write infrastructure, it's how agent-written infrastructure clears that bar. What does review mean when the author produced three hundred lines in a minute? Which checks have to be machine-enforced because a human reading a plan will miss the one line that matters? We care more that you verify agent output than that you use it. Bring yours and argue them out with us.

What You Bring

  • Strong OpenTofu or Terraform, and real AWS depth — ECS/Fargate, IAM, S3, networking
  • Test and release engineering: CI design, test environments with real databases, staged rollouts, and regression testing of pipeline outputs, not only unit tests
  • Operational judgment — alerting that pages on the right thing, service objectives that reflect what a customer actually experiences
  • Comfort with heterogeneous compute, without needing to unify it
  • Strong Python; GitHub Actions and OIDC
  • Security fundamentals and the judgment to apply them proportionately at this stage
  • Daily, load-bearing use of coding agents, and a real position on where they break down

You might be a fit if you've built the release path for a team that was shipping without one, and you measure yourself by whether other engineers got faster. If overnight pipelines with hard delivery windows interest you more than another request-latency problem. If you have opinions about how agent-written infrastructure should be reviewed — and you've changed your mind about some of them.

You might not be if your first quarter would involve introducing Kubernetes or a new orchestration platform, or if the part of the estate that reaches machines on farms reads as beneath the role rather than as the interesting constraint.

Preferred Qualifications

You've likely held a title like infrastructure engineer, release engineer, SRE, or ops. That title matters less to us than two other things: that you think creatively about how agents are changing this job, and that you're motivated by supporting other people through your own technical work.

  • Having supported a small team through a period of rapid growth
  • Fleet management for software running on machines you don't control
  • Compliance readiness (SOC 2 or similar) — useful, not expected
  • Agriculture or biology experience isn't required, but an interest doesn't hurt

Ultimately, we care far more about demonstrated ability, curiosity, and problem-solving than pedigree or conventional career paths.

Logistics

  • Remote, with 10am–2pm Pacific core hours regardless of where you're based
  • West-coast based candidates preferred!
  • Travel 15–20%, including visits to commercial dairies and time with the team at our headquarters in Scotts Valley, CA
  • Engineers share an on-call and triage rotation — weekly, with a written handbook, and weekend work requires explicit sign-off rather than being assumed. Building the alerting that makes on-call survivable is part of this job.

jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

🤝 Respeito pelas pessoas — valorizamos diferentes perspectivas, cultivamos diálogos abertos e contribuímos para o crescimento uns dos outros.

💡 Coragem para inovar — questionamos o convencional, propomos soluções e temos iniciativa para transformar desafios em novas possibilidades.

🌱 Humildade para aprender — reconhecemos que nunca partimos do zero, aprendemos uns com os outros e sabemos que grandes conquistas não são construídas sozinhas.

Mais do que competências técnicas, buscamos pessoas que se identifiquem com esse jeito de fazer acontecer. Pessoas que tenham vontade de aprender, coragem para inovar, respeito para construir junto e atitude para transformar.

Quer conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Stefanini, nossa cultura e as pessoas que fazem parte dessa história?

▶️ Assista ao nosso vídeo institucional e venha construir o futuro com a gente!

🎯 Missão da posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para liderar o Centro de Excelência (COE) de Redes, atuando como referência estratégica, técnica e de desenvolvimento de pessoas nas disciplinas de redes, conectividade e segurança de rede.

O COE Leader será responsável por fortalecer as competências técnicas da equipe, promover a evolução da disciplina e garantir a excelência das entregas, atuando em parceria com o Client Face, responsável pela gestão da conta.

Idioma obrigatório: inglês fluente ou espanhol fluente, considerando a interação com clientes e equipes nearshore/LATAM.

Ser a principal referência técnica e de pessoas da disciplina de Redes, desenvolvendo profissionais, fortalecendo competências, estabelecendo padrões de excelência e apoiando a alocação dos talentos conforme as necessidades dos clientes e do negócio.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gestão de pessoas: desenvolver talentos, acompanhar planos de carreira, promover mentoria técnica, capacitação contínua e retenção de profissionais.
  • Governança técnica: definir, implementar e manter padrões, frameworks, processos e melhores práticas da disciplina.
  • Liderança do COE: organizar e conduzir a equipe, garantindo a evolução das competências e a capacidade de entrega.
  • Evolução tecnológica: estruturar o roadmap da disciplina, acompanhar tendências, incentivar certificações e promover a adoção de soluções de AIOps, automação e autocura.
  • Gestão de capacidade: apoiar o planejamento de capacidade e a alocação dos profissionais de acordo com as demandas dos clientes.
  • Relacionamento estratégico: atuar em parceria com o Client Face e stakeholders, contribuindo com a visão técnica e estratégica da disciplina.

Requisitos técnicos

  • Sólida experiência em redes, roteamento e switching: BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VLAN/STP, LAN/WAN e Wi-Fi.
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias e fabricantes como Cisco, Juniper e Aruba.
  • Experiência com SD-WAN, Datacenter (Spine-Leaf, VXLAN/EVPN, ACI) e balanceadores (F5 e Citrix ADC).
  • Conhecimento em segurança de redes: NGFW, VPN, NAC e redes em Cloud, com soluções Palo Alto, Fortinet e Check Point.
  • Experiência na liderança, gestão ou mentoria de equipes técnicas.
  • Vivência na definição de padrões, processos e governança técnica.
  • Capacidade de relacionamento e articulação com stakeholders e Client Faces.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Precificação e propostas técnicas: experiência na construção de propostas e no dimensionamento de serviços, considerando esforço, senioridade, capacidade e composição das equipes.
  • IA aplicada a redes e AIOps: experiência ou atuação prática com operação assistida, detecção de anomalias em telemetria e automação NetDevOps, utilizando ferramentas como Mist AI, Cisco AI, Ansible e Python.
  • IA Generativa: conhecimento ou experiência com LLMs e copilotos aplicados à análise de configurações e logs, análise de causa raiz (RCA), documentação e ChatOps.
  • Conhecimento em engenharia de prompts e governança de IA, considerando proteção de dados sensíveis, guardrails e validação humana.
  • Certificação profissional: possuir certificação de nível profissional em redes ou segurança, conforme uma das trilhas abaixo:
    • Roteamento e Switching: CCNP Enterprise ou JNCIP-ENT.

    • Segurança de Redes: PCNSE, Fortinet FCSS Network Security (ex-NSE 7), Check Point CCSE ou CCNP Security.

  • Idioma: inglês fluente ou espanhol fluente.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações de nível expert: CCIE, JNCIE ou Fortinet FCX.
  • Experiência com redes para clusters de IA/GPU, incluindo RoCE e InfiniBand.
  • Conhecimento em segurança de tráfego de GenAI, SASE e DLP.
  • Experiência com arquitetura Zero Trust.
  • Conhecimento em soluções DDI.
  • Experiência com IPv6.

Perfil esperado

Buscamos uma liderança com visão estratégica e forte domínio técnico, capaz de desenvolver pessoas, impulsionar a inovação e conectar as necessidades do negócio às soluções tecnológicas. É importante ter perfil colaborativo, capacidade de influência, visão de futuro e habilidade para transformar conhecimento técnico em excelência operacional e valor para os clientes.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.excerpt: You’re the kind of data scientist who gets equally energized by training a gradient boosted classifier and designing an LLM-powered agentic workflow.
jobs.description:
You’re the kind of data scientist who gets equally energized by training a gradient boosted classifier and designing an LLM-powered agentic workflow. You understand that picking the right tool — whether that’s a decision tree, a language model, or a carefully chosen heuristic — matters more than chasing the latest trend. And you’re just as comfortable explaining your approach to a non-technical stakeholder as you are digging deep into a messy dataset.

Does this sound like you? Great!

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to work across Expel, using both traditional machine learning and generative AI to solve meaningful problems. You’ll help teams develop the right metrics to measure what matters, build models that surface threats in our customers’ environments, and design AI-powered tools that make our analysts faster and smarter. Some of the most interesting work sits right at the intersection of GenAI and classical ML — and you’ll help us figure out where each approach wins.

Our team values collaboration, curiosity, and a “how can I help?” attitude. If you care about making data science accessible to everyone — and find mentorship rewarding — let’s talk.

What Expel Can Do For You

  • Provide opportunities where your decisions have a direct impact on our company and our customers
  • Give you real, hard problems at the frontier of both GenAI and traditional ML in a security context
  • Empower you to scale yourself by teaching others what responsible, non-hyped AI looks like in practice
  • Challenge you to push the boundaries of our data science, security, and technology vision
  • Offer an entertaining, small, and highly transparent environment where your voice matters

What You Can Do For Expel

  • Build and ship ML and GenAI systems — from anomaly detection models to LLM-powered analyst tools and agentic workflows — across the full lifecycle from research to production
  • Bring stakeholders along by clearly communicating the what, why, and how of your work, including successes and failures
  • Work across operations, engineering, and service delivery to ensure our AI and ML capabilities are easy to deploy, monitor, and maintain
  • Partner with subject matter experts to explore where prompt engineering, knowledge retrieval, and agentic AI can deliver real value alongside classical approaches
  • Foster an atmosphere of experimentation, continuous learning, and improvement
  • Stay current on emerging techniques, papers, and tools — and bring relevant ideas back to the team
  • Mentor and coach other data scientists and curious non-DS colleagues

What You Should Bring With You

  • 4+ years of professional data science experience building and shipping models in production
  • Solid grounding in traditional ML: classification, regression, anomaly detection, clustering, time series — using frameworks like scikit-learn or statsmodels
  • Hands-on experience with large language models, prompt engineering, and LLM application architectures including knowledge retrieval and grounding (e.g., embeddings-based search, vector stores)
  • Experience building or contributing to LLM-powered agentic systems, including tool use and orchestration with frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, utilizing core data libraries (pandas/numpy) and visual toolkits (plotly/seaborn/matplotlib) to transform complex analysis into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders and cross-functional peers
  • Solid statistical foundations: distributions, hypothesis testing, probability, and the wisdom to know when a simpler model is the right one
  • Exemplary collaboration skills that result in higher levels of team confidence and, morale, streamlining requirements gathering to drive superior output
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Passion for finding order and meaning in large, chaotic data sets
  • Domain experience in cybersecurity (anomaly detection, threat hunting, risk scoring) is a strong plus

The Details

The base salary range for this role is between $142,900 USD and $207,200 USD + bonus eligibility and equity.

We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your salary will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You’ll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We're only hiring those authorized to work in the United States.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We’ll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

$142,900—$207,200 USD
